## Captured Notes v1 (concise)

MASTER BUILD: STORY + PHILOSOPHY ARCHITECTURE

(Locked before prose begins)

1. Core Narrative Frame (what story this really is)
The true genre

This is not political nonfiction.
It is a quiet hero’s journey disguised as social clarity.

Protagonist: the reader

Antagonist: an invisible system (never personified)

False enemy: self-blame, division, old labels

Prize: agency, dignity, shared future

Transformation: from isolated participant → conscious builder

This is a coming-of-awareness story.

2. Primary Plot Arc (the spine)
ACT I — Disorientation (WHY)

“Something feels wrong, but I don’t know what.”

Emotional state: confusion, fatigue, quiet guilt

The reader believes:

“I should be doing better”

“Maybe it’s just me”

The world feels heavy but unnamed

End of Act I turn:

“This didn’t happen by accident.”

ACT II — Revelation (HOW)

“Oh. This is how the system actually works.”

Emotional state: relief → tension → clarity

The reader realizes:

systems shape outcomes

incentives matter more than intentions

power moves structurally

Old labels start to dissolve

Midpoint revelation (critical):

“Every society struggles with this when wealth detaches from work.”

This is where global truth is glimpsed, not exposed.

ACT III — Reconstruction (WHAT)

“We could build this differently.”

Emotional state: hope grounded in realism

The reader sees:

a future that feels calmer, not radical

success without domination

local power with national coherence

End of Act III turn:

“This future requires people like me.”

ACT IV — Integration (ACTION)

“I know what to do next.”

Emotional state: resolve without urgency

The reader understands:

change starts relationally

leadership is distributed

participation is enough

Final state:
The reader is no longer waiting for permission.

3. Character Arcs (symbolic, not literal)
A. The Reader (Primary Arc)

Start:

Overloaded

Self-blaming

Politically disengaged or defensive

Midpoint:

Validated

Curious

Oriented

End:

Calm

Responsible

Capable

Connected

This is a psychological maturation arc, not a political conversion.

B. The System (Antagonist Arc)

Start: unseen, unnamed, omnipresent
Middle: revealed as structural, not evil
End: demystified, therefore defeatable

The system never “loses” — it is outgrown.

C. The Future (Symbolic Arc)

Start: abstract, frightening, distant
Middle: imaginable
End: intimate and near

The future becomes something the reader can touch.

4. Symbol Systems (used consistently)
The House (primary metaphor)

Foundation = core systems (education, health, democracy)

Rooms = policies added over time

Wiring = bureaucracy

Cracks = debt, stress, inequality

One room growing = wealth concentration

Renovation = intentional redesign

Ownership = collective responsibility

Foreshadowing rule:
Cracks mentioned early are “repaired” conceptually late.

The Weight

Introduced in the Prologue

Returns in moments of stress

Lifted, not removed, at the end

The Machine / Operating System

Appears in HOW

Used to explain incentives

Replaced by “designed systems” in WHAT

Circulation vs Pooling

Money

Power

Time

Trust

Pooling is always framed as stagnation.
Circulation is framed as health.

5. Subplots (quiet, interwoven)

These are never announced. They are felt.

Subplot 1 — The Death of Old Labels

Left/right mentioned early as noise

Gradually treated as outdated maps

Never attacked — simply abandoned

Payoff: reader stops identifying with ideology.

Subplot 2 — Success Without Shame

Early fear of “limits”

Gentle reassurance

$250k / $20M appears as protection, not threat

Payoff: professionals and business owners stay engaged.

Subplot 3 — Global Truth Without Paranoia

Early hint: “countries feel similar”

Midpoint: structural constraint

Late: leadership by example

Payoff: credibility without alienation.

Subplot 4 — From Isolation to Belonging

Early loneliness

Middle recognition

Late relational action

Payoff: action feels natural, not imposed.

6. Foreshadowing Map (hooks that pay off)
Early Hook	Later Payoff
“Why does this feel so heavy?”	Weight lifted through agency
“Hard work used to mean something”	Rebuilt work–reward link
“It’s hard to fix what you can’t see”	System fully named
“Every country feels this”	US model as global example
“Someone should do something”	“That someone is you”
7. Emotional Pacing Chart (intentional)

Pages 1–10: recognition, safety

10–25: discomfort, curiosity

25–40: relief, clarity

40–55: tension (but no despair)

55–70: hope with structure

70–85: grounded future

85–100: resolve, invitation

Never leave the reader in fear for more than ~3 pages.

8. Hidden Outcomes (what this book quietly does)

Creates a shared language across ideologies

Makes readers immune to simplistic propaganda

Trains systems thinking without jargon

Seeds organizers without calling them that

Builds trust before asking for action

This is why it can last generations.

9. Lock Point (what we freeze before writing)

Before writing a single chapter, we lock:

Metaphor system (primary + secondary)

Plot arcs (reader/system/future)

Foreshadowing hooks

Emotional pacing

Where the global truth stops in the book

Where action begins

Once these are frozen, writing becomes execution, not exploration.

10. Next step (choose one)

To continue cleanly, we should do one of these next:

Lock the central metaphor system formally (House vs alternatives)

Build a chapter-by-chapter beat sheet with emotional + thematic notes

Draft a foreshadowing index (exact lines/themes to plant early)

Map book chapters → website deep dives at a concept level

My recommendation:
👉 #2: Chapter-by-chapter beat sheet (this turns architecture into a write-ready spine)

What you’re really deciding now is **the form of the spell**.

Because make no mistake: if this works the way you want it to, this book is not just informative — it’s **initiatory**. People finish it *changed*, not convinced.

Below is **Book Outline v1**, but more importantly, it’s an **approach** that explains *why* this structure keeps people reading, why youth reread it, and why it feeds endlessly into the website without ever feeling complete.

---

# First: the narrative approach (this is the key)

### The book is not:

* a policy book
* a manifesto
* a political argument

### The book *is*:

> **A guided awakening story about realizing you are inside a system — and learning you can rebuild it.**

The reader is the protagonist.
The system is the unseen antagonist.
The future is the prize.

We never say that out loud — we *let them feel it*.

---

# Core storytelling strategy (why people won’t put it down)

We use **three intertwined techniques**:

### 1. Progressive revelation

You never explain everything at once.
Each chapter *unlocks* the next realization.

The reader keeps thinking:

> “Wait… that explains something else too.”

### 2. Emotional pacing (very intentional)

The book **breathes**:

* calm → unsettling → relief → clarity → tension → hope → resolve

You *never* leave them in despair for more than a few pages.

### 3. Metaphor as infrastructure

We rely on **one central metaphor system**, with variations:

* the house
* the road
* the machine
* the game
* the operating system
* the current / tide
* the weight you didn’t know you were carrying

This makes abstract systems *felt*.

---

# The unifying metaphor (recommendation)

> **“We inherited a house that worked — and kept adding rooms without checking the foundation.”**

Everything can map to this:

* debt = cracks in the walls
* stress = the hum you hear at night
* bureaucracy = wires no one remembers installing
* politics = arguing over paint while the roof leaks
* wealth concentration = one room growing while others collapse

This metaphor grows with the reader.

---

# Book Outline v1

*(~100 pages, ~18–20 short chapters, fast-moving)*

---

## PROLOGUE — *The Weight You Didn’t Put There*

**Mood:** intimate, quiet, disarming
**Purpose:** hook without ideology

You start here:

* A normal moment: driving, working late, lying awake
* A feeling: *“Why does this feel so hard when I’m doing everything right?”*
* You do **not** answer it yet

End with:

> “If you’ve ever felt this, this book is for you.”

---

## PART I — WHY

*Realizing something is wrong — and it’s not you*

### Chapter 1 — *Hard Work Used to Mean Something*

**Mood:** nostalgia → confusion
**Metaphor:** the deal we were promised

* No politics
* No blame
* Just the quiet observation that effort and stability have drifted apart

Cliffhanger:

> “That didn’t happen by accident.”

---

### Chapter 2 — *The Invisible Cost of Living*

**Mood:** unsettling
**Metaphor:** water rising, slowly

* Time, stress, debt, attention
* Costs that don’t show up on receipts
* Why everyone feels tired at once

End with:

> “When costs become invisible, people blame themselves.”

---

### Chapter 3 — *Why Everyone Feels Unrepresented*

**Mood:** recognition → relief
**Metaphor:** shouting through glass

* Not left vs right
* But distance vs voice
* Complexity as a barrier

End with:

> “It’s hard to fix a system you can’t see.”

---

### Chapter 4 — *The System You Were Born Into*

**Mood:** curiosity
**Metaphor:** a machine already running

* You didn’t choose it
* You don’t control it
* But it shapes you

This is where readers lean forward.

---

## PART II — HOW

*Seeing the machine clearly*

### Chapter 5 — *Systems, Not Villains*

**Mood:** relief
**Metaphor:** a crooked table

* Why blaming people never fixes structure
* Incentives over intentions

This is where ideology melts away.

---

### Chapter 6 — *How Power Actually Moves*

**Mood:** tension (but controlled)
**Metaphor:** gravity

* Power flows toward concentration
* Always has
* Always will unless designed otherwise

You **do not** go global yet. Just hint.

---

### Chapter 7 — *Why Every Country Feels the Same Right Now*

**Mood:** unsettling, expansive
**Metaphor:** tides, not borders

This is the **only glimpse** of global truth:

* Nations constrained by money
* Workers everywhere feeling pressure
* Different flags, same gravity

End with:

> “Any future worth building has to account for this.”

---

### Chapter 8 — *The Problem With Old Labels*

**Mood:** freeing
**Metaphor:** outdated maps

* Why left/right no longer describe reality
* Why people argue past each other

This primes them for something new.

---

### Chapter 9 — *What Actually Makes a System Stable*

**Mood:** clarity
**Metaphor:** load-bearing beams

* Education
* Health
* Trust
* Local power
* Predictability

You’re laying the foundation.

---

## PART III — WHAT

*Imagining a future that works*

### Chapter 10 — *A System Built for the Working Majority*

**Mood:** hopeful
**Metaphor:** rebuilding with intention

* No policy soup
* Just principles

You introduce the **90% frame** here.

---

### Chapter 11 — *Success Without Control*

**Mood:** calming
**Metaphor:** tall trees, shared sunlight

This is where you introduce:

* $250k individuals
* $20M businesses

Framed as **freedom from distortion**, not limits.

---

### Chapter 12 — *Local Power, National Purpose*

**Mood:** grounding
**Metaphor:** roots and canopy

* Local decision-making
* National representation on the world stage
* Decentralization without chaos

---

### Chapter 13 — *Work, Wealth, and Dignity*

**Mood:** restorative
**Metaphor:** circulation vs pooling

* Wealth moving through communities
* Stability replacing anxiety

---

### Chapter 14 — *Technology Without Fear*

**Mood:** forward-looking
**Metaphor:** tools, not masters

* AI framed as shared leverage
* Not job apocalypse
* Not techno-utopia

---

### Chapter 15 — *The Future Feels Different*

**Mood:** immersive
**Metaphor:** waking up in a quieter house

You describe:

* daily life
* time
* stress levels
* family rhythms

No numbers. Just *felt reality*.

---

## PART IV — ACTION

*Stepping into responsibility*

### Chapter 16 — *Change Doesn’t Start With Power*

**Mood:** empowering
**Metaphor:** sparks

* It starts with people
* Conversations
* Trust

---

### Chapter 17 — *How Movements Actually Grow*

**Mood:** practical, calm
**Metaphor:** mycelium

* Relational organizing (never named as such)
* No shouting
* No forcing

---

### Chapter 18 — *What You Do Next*

**Mood:** resolve
**Metaphor:** picking up tools

Clear steps:

* Talk
* Share
* Learn
* Gather
* Build

End with an invitation, not a command.

---

## EPILOGUE — *The House Is Ours*

**Mood:** quiet strength

You close where you began:

* same feeling
* but now it’s lighter

Final line should feel inevitable, not dramatic.

---

# Why this works (strategically)

* Youth reread it because it *feels like discovering a secret*
* Adults trust it because it doesn’t yell at them
* Ideology never blocks entry
* The website becomes an *endless rabbit hole* of proof and play
* You can always stay ahead by deepening the drill-downs

---

# Next steps (recommended order)

1. Lock the **central metaphor system**
2. Write **Chapter 1 + Prologue** in full
3. Calibrate voice and pacing
4. Then outline the **website chapter mappings**

When you’re ready, I suggest we **write the Prologue and Chapter 1 next**, word-for-word, and tune the voice until it’s unputdownable.

Just say the word.
The core principle (this is the guardrail)

The book never names ideologies.
The website teaches them all.

This single rule protects everything.

The book:

speaks in lived experience

describes systems, incentives, outcomes

never asks the reader to identify as anything

The website:

becomes the education engine

names, compares, and dissects ideologies honestly

removes emotional shortcuts and connotations

replaces slogans with mechanisms

You are not telling people what to believe.
You are teaching them how systems behave over time.

That’s how you win trust.

2. How to introduce this gently in the book (one sentence is enough)

Somewhere in Part II (HOW), you include a line like:

“Every major political philosophy in history was built to solve a real problem. Some worked for a time. Most failed when power concentrated. Understanding why is essential — but that exploration lives beyond this book.”

That’s it.

No labels.
No judgment.
Just curiosity.

That line becomes a portal.

3. The website section: “Political Systems & Power (Education, Not Identity)”

This should be a separate, clearly framed section, something like:

Political Systems: How They Actually Worked

Key framing text at the top:

“This section exists for education — not affiliation.
Political systems are tools. Tools should be studied by how they perform, not by the identities built around them.”

This instantly lowers defenses.

4. How to structure the ideology deep dive (this is important)
Do not organize by left/right.

That reinforces identity.

Instead, organize by problems they tried to solve.

Example top-level categories
1. Systems That Prioritized Stability

Monarchies

Empires

Feudal systems

Authoritarian states

Key questions asked:

How did they maintain order?

Where did power pool?

What happened to workers?

2. Systems That Prioritized Markets

Mercantilism

Capitalism (early, industrial, financialized)

Neoliberalism

Key questions asked:

How was value created?

Who captured excess value?

When did markets stop serving labor?

3. Systems That Prioritized Equality

Social democracies

Democratic socialism

Communal systems

Cooperative economies

Key questions asked:

How was fairness enforced?

What incentives broke?

Where did bureaucracy grow?

4. Systems That Prioritized Ideology or Identity

Nationalism

Theocracies

Revolutionary movements

One-party states

Key questions asked:

How dissent was handled

How truth was managed

How power justified itself

5. Hybrid Systems (Most Real Countries)

United States (across eras)

European mixed economies

Asian state-capitalist models

Post-colonial states

Key questions asked:

What worked temporarily?

What failed structurally?

Where money replaced governance?

5. The connective tissue: money & power (this is where it gets real)

After studying systems individually, you introduce the cross-cutting truth:

“Across all systems, failure occurred when wealth detached from work and turned into political leverage.”

This becomes the unifying lens:

not capitalism vs socialism

not left vs right

but labor-linked wealth vs power-linked wealth

This is where your global monetary analysis lives.

6. The global money layer (deep, optional, devastating)

This section should be explicitly labeled something like:

Global Power & Money: Advanced Study

It includes:

reserve currencies

debt dependence

capital flight

multinational leverage

corporate sovereignty

why “countries” often aren’t the real decision-makers

This is where you can eventually use language like:

capital concentration

transnational power

financial abstraction

extraction vs production

But again:

not required

not promoted in the book

opt-in only

This protects accessibility while preserving truth.

7. How this ties back to your system (subtly but powerfully)

After studying every ideology, the reader arrives at a realization:

“This new system isn’t rejecting history — it’s integrating its lessons.”

Your system can then be framed on the website as:

capitalism that keeps wealth tied to labor

democracy that decentralizes power

governance that resists capture

technology that serves humans

incentives that reward contribution, not control

It becomes:

Post-ideological by design

That’s extremely rare — and extremely appealing.

8. Why this approach is disarming (and dangerous in the best way)

You’re doing something most movements never do:

You educate people past their own labels

You let them outgrow their ideology instead of abandon it

You don’t ask for loyalty — you earn understanding

People who finish this journey will say:

“I don’t know what label this is — I just know it makes sense.”

That’s how paradigms shift.

9. Where this leaves us (clean pause point)

At this moment, you have:

A book that persuades without naming ideology

A website that teaches ideology without demanding identity

A movement that grows through education, not outrage

A monetization model aligned with depth, not control

A future path to global analysis without alienation

When you’re ready to resume building, we can:

design the Political Systems section architecture

map ideologies to neutral analytical templates

draft the book’s ideology “glimpse” paragraph

or outline the final action chapter

ChatGPT said:

Thought for 8s
Here’s a coherent theory + institutional model for a working-class–centered United States that keeps capitalism, strengthens democracy, shrinks the role of money and parties, limits personal power, and builds universal education + healthcare—with a pragmatic transition path that uses amendments + statutes (no constitutional convention).

I’m going to give you:

The core theory (what the system is for and how it stays stable)

The model government design (institutions, elections, rights, justice, economy)

A transition plan (how to move from today’s Constitution to this system through Article V + federal/state law)

1) The theory: a Working Majority Constitutionalism
The central premise
The U.S. should be designed to maximize the bargaining power, life stability, and political equality of the working majority (the 90%)—because democracy cannot survive when most people live in precarity.

This isn’t socialism. It’s capitalism with hard democratic guardrails, where:

Markets exist and entrepreneurship thrives,

But the rules of the market are written to keep wealth from becoming political power, and

The baseline conditions of dignity (education, healthcare, basic stability) are rights, not purchases.

Three “non-negotiables” (the system’s spine)
Political equality cannot depend on money.
If money buys elections, then citizenship is unequal.

The working majority must have structural power in the economy.
Not just “protections”—actual leverage: unions, sector bargaining, worker ownership pathways, portable benefits.

Essential human capital systems are public rights.
Education is always free. Healthcare is always free at point of service.
(You can still buy extra services—private rooms, elective add-ons, etc.—but the floor is universal.)

2) The model: “The Working Majority Republic” (WMR)
A. Democracy design (remove Electoral College, reduce party dominance, equalize participation)
1) President elected by national popular vote (with majority requirement).

No Electoral College.

Use a two-round system (or ranked-choice for president) so the winner has majority legitimacy.

2) Congress elected to reflect the people, not the map.

House: multi-member districts with ranked-choice voting (RCV) → more proportional, fewer wasted votes, less extremism, less gerrymandering payoff.

Senate: keep it if you must for state equality, but strip its chokehold (see “Republican-form problems” fixes below).

3) A “Democracy Right” that guarantees equal access to voting.

Automatic voter registration, same-day registration, universal vote-by-mail option, national standards for polling access.

Election Day holiday + required paid time to vote.

4) End the money-election pipeline.

Public elections: every candidate gets equal baseline resources (public matching + vouchers + free media time).

Ban dark money and require real-time disclosure.

Strict cap on individual contributions (low enough to be irrelevant).

Corporate money: no direct or indirect election spending.

5) Parties de-emphasized without banning them.

Keep free association, but redesign incentives:

Open, nonpartisan primaries (top-4 or top-5) → general election decided by RCV.

Ballot design prioritizes candidates, not party labels (labels allowed, but visually secondary).

Debate access rules based on signature thresholds, not party gatekeeping.

B. Fixing “Republican-form” failures (minority rule, gridlock, procedural vetoes)
The core “problem set” you’re pointing to is: minority rule + veto points + party capture.

1) Neutralize the filibuster permanently.

Constitutional rule: legislation passes by majority vote in each chamber.

Keep extended debate as a time-limited tool, not a supermajority requirement.

2) Anti-gerrymandering by design.

Multi-member districts + RCV drastically reduces gerrymandering power.

Add independent redistricting commissions as a backstop.

3) Supreme Court and federal courts: reduce personal power + politicization.

18-year Supreme Court term limits, staggered appointments every 2 years.

Poverty Floor System: The Dignity & Mobility Guarantee

emergency cash

healthcare coverage

food baseline

paid training pathways

job placement

childcare support

credentialing and licensing reform

4) A “Living Wage Enforcement” backbone (stops poverty at the source)

4.2 Underpayment penalty paid into the Workers’ Fund

no child goes hungry

Student debt is a policy-created drag on productivity and family formation.

Zero out the drag on households (debt relief)

Below is a clean model you can drop into your master outline.

1) Student debt abolition: drop the “straddled debt” cleanly
Principle
If education becomes a public right going forward, then stranded education debt is an unjust transition cost borne by the working class.

What we do
Cancel past federal student debt by statute (most student debt is federal).
For privately held student loans, create a federal conversion and discharge pathway.

How we do it without breaking anything
Step A — Federal loans: direct cancellation
Congress passes a Student Debt Reconciliation Act:

cancels all federal student loan balances

refunds recent payments in a defined lookback window (optional)

removes negative credit reporting related to student loans

Why this doesn’t collapse the system:
Federal student loans are a government-created asset on the government’s own balance sheet. Canceling them is a fiscal choice, not a banking-run trigger.

Step B — Private loans: convert → cancel (or convert → restructure)
Private student loans are smaller but trickier because investors hold them.

Two safe options:

Option 1: Buyout at fair value, then discharge

A public authority offers to purchase private student loans at a haircut tied to expected repayment (not face value).

After purchase, loans are discharged.

Option 2: Convert to income-based public repayment, then sunset

Private lenders must offer conversion into a standardized public plan:

0% interest

income-based payments

automatic forgiveness at a fixed horizon

Government provides a stabilization credit to lenders to prevent disorderly losses.

“Fairness” narrative (the one people accept)

Free public higher ed + trade education

No tuition financing markets needed

2) Mortgages: move homeownership away from banks, reduce homeowner debt, avoid collapse
Principle
Homeownership should be a community wealth engine, not a permanent extraction stream.

So we use a conversion strategy, not a smash-and-grab.

The model: The American Homeownership Conversion Plan
Core mechanism
Create a public “mortgage utility” that gradually replaces private mortgage extraction with stable, low-cost, public-interest home finance.

Call it:
The Homeownership Trust (HOT)

HOT does three things:

refinances most mortgages into 0–2% fixed public mortgages

offers principal reduction under clear rules

changes homeownership so equity builds locally and predictably

Step-by-step: how it works
Step 1 — National refinance offer (voluntary, universal)
Every primary-residence homeowner can refinance into a HOT mortgage:

fixed rate (near zero)

no junk fees

standardized terms

simple underwriting

no penalty for early payment

Effect: monthly payments drop immediately for tens of millions. That’s a massive working-class stimulus without “printing chaos” because it’s structured and gradual.

Step 2 — Principal reduction without collapse (targeted and rules-based)
We don’t erase all mortgage principal overnight. We target principal reduction where it’s economically and morally justified:

underwater mortgages (owe more than the home value)

predatory loan victims

high-cost regions where price spikes created permanent rent-seeking

hardship cases tied to medical/disability shocks

How it’s funded:

a dedicated slice of the People’s Wealth Fund returns (not the principal)

a financial transaction levy

monopoly rent recovery and high-end wealth constraints

and the savings from reduced foreclosure/eviction churn and downstream costs

Step 3 — Investor and bank stability: swap, don’t destroy

Mortgage holders (banks, investors) receive:

a long-term government bond or guaranteed cashflow instrument in exchange for the mortgage asset

a stable, lower-return, government-backed instrument

That’s the trade:
Less extraction, more stability.

It’s exactly how you avoid a sudden balance sheet shock.

Step 4 — End the “mortgage wars” going forward
New mortgages default to HOT terms:

public-rate mortgages

standardized consumer protections

capped fees

no predatory adjustable-rate traps

Banks can still compete, but only if they beat the public option without exploitation.

A) First-time buyer pathway
down payment assistance

closing cost support

credit alternatives (rent history counts, utility payments count)

fixed-rate public mortgage access

B) Rent-to-own standards and anti-predatory rules
regulated contracts

equity accrual guaranteed

transparent terms

enforcement teeth

C) Tenant right of first refusal + financing support
When rental property sells:

tenants get first chance to buy

supported by public financing and/or cooperative ownership paths

3) Why this grows GDP while stabilizing society

household formation

job mobility

consumer demand

fertility (often linked to economic security)

4) Safeguards (so critics can’t shred it)

.card.compact{padding:14px}
.kicker{font-family:var(--mono);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.pills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.pill{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 10px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.callout{border-left:4px solid var(--accent);padding:12px 14px;background:rgba(125,211,252,.06);border-radius:12px}
.callout.warn{border-left-color:var(--warn);background:rgba(251,191,36,.07)}
hr{border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin:18px 0}
ul{margin:8px 0 14px 20px;color:var(--text)}
li{margin:6px 0}
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:32px}
.breadcrumb{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px}
.btnrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:10px}
.btn{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px}
.btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);text-decoration:none}
form{display:grid;gap:10px;margin-top:10px}
input, textarea{width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#0c121b;color:var(--text)}
textarea{min-height:120px;resize:vertical}
button{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(125,211,252,.12);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer}
button:hover{background:rgba(125,211,252,.18)}
.note{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.sectionlinks{display:grid;gap:10px}
.sectionlinks a{display:block;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
.sectionlinks a:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);text-decoration:none}
@media (min-width:860px){
  .hero{grid-column:span 8}
  .side{grid-column:span 4}
  .half{grid-column:span 6}
}
"""

js = """
// Minimal JS: stamp page slug into the Netlify Form and add current date.
(function(){
  const el = document.querySelector('[data-page-slug]');
  const slug = el ? el.getAttribute('data-page-slug') : '';
  const pageField = document.querySelector('input[name="page_slug"]');
  if(pageField && slug) pageField.value = slug;

  const ts = document.querySelector('input[name="submitted_at"]');
  if(ts) ts.value = new Date().toISOString();
})();
"""

def layout(title, breadcrumb, body, slug):
    return f"""<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>{title} — {site_name}</title>
  <meta name="description" content="{tagline}" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/styles.css" />
</head>
<body>
  <header>
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="brand">
        <div class="badge" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        <div>
          <div class="kicker">{site_name}</div>
          <h1>{title}</h1>
          <div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">
    {body}
  </main>

  <footer>
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="muted">© {datetime.date.today().year} {site_name}. Draft build for iterative expansion.</div>
      <div class="note">Comments are collected via Netlify Forms and are not displayed publicly until approved.</div>
    </div>
  </footer>

  <script src="/assets/site.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
"""

def thoughts_form(slug, title):
    # Netlify form "thoughts" used site-wide, includes hidden page slug and timestamp.
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>
  <h3>Leave a comment on this page</h3>
  <p class="note">Your message is submitted for review. We may publish it (with your name if provided) after approval.</p>

  <form name="thoughts" method="POST" data-netlify="true" netlify-honeypot="bot-field" action="/pages/thanks.html">
    <input type="hidden" name="form-name" value="thoughts" />
    <p style="display:none;">
      <label>Don’t fill this out if you're human: <input name="bot-field" /></label>
    </p>
    <input type="hidden" name="page_slug" value="{slug}" />
    <input type="hidden" name="page_title" value="{title}" />
    <input type="hidden" name="submitted_at" value="" />

    <div class="grid">
      <div class="card compact half" style="background:transparent;border:none;padding:0;">
        <label class="note">Name (optional)</label>
        <input name="name" placeholder="Your name" />
      </div>
      <div class="card compact half" style="background:transparent;border:none;padding:0;">
        <label class="note">Email (optional, never published)</label>
        <input name="email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
      </div>
    </div>

    <label class="note">Message</label>
    <textarea name="message" required placeholder="What should we improve, clarify, or add?"></textarea>

    <button type="submit">Submit for review</button>
  </form>
</div>
"""

# Concept pages (stubs with substantive content we have)
def concept_page(filename, title, breadcrumb, sections, slug):
    body = ""
    for sec in sections:
        body += f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{sec.get('kicker','')}</div>
  <h2>{sec.get('h2','')}</h2>
  {sec.get('html','')}
</div>
"""
    body += thoughts_form(slug, title)
    open(base+f"/pages/{filename}","w").write(layout(title, breadcrumb, body, slug))

# Impact pages with more narrative
def impact_page(filename, title, overview, sections, slug):
    body = f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">Impact Lab</div>
  <h2>Overview</h2>
  <p>{overview}</p>
  <div class="callout">
    <b>Template:</b> current system → new system change → mechanism → risks/safeguards → metrics → projections (10/25 years).
  </div>
</div>
"""
    for sec in sections:
        body += f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{sec.get('kicker','')}</div>
  <h2>{sec.get('h2','')}</h2>
  {sec.get('html','')}
</div>
"""
    body += thoughts_form(slug, title)
    open(base+f"/pages/{filename}","w").write(layout(title, f"Home / Impact Lab / {title}", body, slug))

You said:
We must collapse the finance class (Wall Street and investor class) by making this system BETTER for them from the start and over generations levels out.  How do we regulate AI in the future while not falling behind the world?  How does the new system line up on a global stage?  How does we improve our position in the world?  How do we regulate energy and move that system over time - we need to have universal high speed (equal internet access for all - we must level this playing field) 
ChatGPT said:

Thought for 14s
Here’s how to add these as new pillars in the model (and as future drill-down pages) while keeping the whole project consistent:

We “collapse” the finance class as a political force by making the new system more stable, more investable, and less crash-prone—so capital prefers it—while the rent-extraction share shrinks across generations.

We regulate AI with a risk-based framework (like the EU approach) while investing hard in compute, chips, and standards leadership so the U.S. doesn’t fall behind. 

We improve global standing by becoming the most trusted democracy + the most reliable partner + the most productive innovation economy (stable institutions, trusted tech, resilient energy, universal broadband).

Energy becomes a regulated public-utility backbone with competitive generation layered on top—reliability first, decarbonization over time, price stability always.

Universal high-speed becomes a civic right / economic infrastructure, building on existing models like NTIA’s Broadband Equity, Access, and Deployment Program, but with a stronger “universal service” mandate. 

Below is the “system design” you can drop into your outline as placeholder pages.

A) Finance Class Transition: Make it Better for Them, Shrink Extraction Over Time
The problem to solve
You don’t want a revolutionary seizure—you want a voluntary migration of capital away from speculative rent extraction and toward productive investment.

So we design an “offer they can’t refuse”:

lower upside from extraction

higher certainty, better stability, fewer crashes

new safe assets

clear long-term rules

The core mechanism: “Swap, don’t smash”
We already used this logic in mortgages: instead of nuking balance sheets, we swap extractive assets into stable public instruments.

You repeat that approach across finance:

Create a Public Stability Asset

A long-duration “National Prosperity Bond” instrument (backed by predictable revenue streams from the new system’s anti-capture mechanisms and productivity growth).

This becomes the go-to safe asset for pension funds, insurers, long-term investors.

Shrink rent-seeking returns by regulation, not chaos

Tighten leverage rules and systemic risk controls.

Ban the highest-extraction fee structures and predatory intermediaries.

Make certain forms of speculation less profitable through transaction levies and capital requirements.

Make productive investment more profitable

Tax advantages for long-horizon investment in domestic productivity: infrastructure, housing supply, advanced manufacturing, energy, broadband.

Faster permitting + de-risking for real-economy projects.

“Collapse” as political power, not annihilation
The investor class stops behaving like a parallel government when:

campaign finance capture is neutralized

monopolies are broken

data extraction is blocked

public options exist in banking, mortgages, and broadband

regulatory capture is made expensive

The money doesn’t disappear. It moves into lower-rent, higher-stability returns.

Page placeholder: /pages/finance-transition.html
Impact page: /pages/impact-finance-transition.html

B) AI Regulation Without Falling Behind
The correct frame
We don’t regulate AI by trying to predict every use-case. We regulate AI like we regulate:

aviation safety

medicines

financial systemic risk

Meaning: risk tiers, testing, auditing, and liability.

What to copy (and improve) from real-world models
The European Union’s EU AI Act uses a risk-based structure and has a staged implementation timeline. 

The U.S. has also used executive direction to push safety testing, standards work, and reporting for powerful models (see the 2023 AI Executive Order and CRS summaries). 

The Working-Majority AI Framework (site-ready)
Risk tiers

Prohibited: AI used for rights-destruction (certain mass biometric surveillance, coercive manipulation in private spaces, etc.)

High-risk: employment, housing, credit, insurance, education, sentencing, critical infrastructure

General purpose: transparency + provenance rules

Low-risk: light-touch disclosure

Mandatory safety testing for frontier models

Pre-deployment “red team” testing

Cybersecurity and model theft resistance

Biosecurity and dangerous capability screening

Reporting requirements for certain model/compute thresholds (aligns with existing U.S. direction). 

Algorithmic Due Process (non-negotiable)

If AI affects a person’s life chances (job/loan/housing/sentencing), they get:

explanation

appeal

human review

correction rights
(This matches your broader digital civil rights pillar.)

Liability rules that steer behavior

Strict liability for negligent deployment in high-risk domains

Mandatory insurance for high-risk AI operators

Executive accountability for repeated violations

National AI Standards leadership

# Helper: read/write
def read(path):
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return f.read()
def write(path, content):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(content)

# We'll expand several existing pages by inserting additional sections before the thoughts form (which is in HTML).
def insert_before_thoughts(html, addition):
    # The thoughts form begins with '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments'
    marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments'
    idx = html.find(marker)
    if idx == -1:
        return html + "\n" + addition
    return html[:idx] + addition + "\n" + html[idx:]

  <h2>{h2}</h2>
  {inner}

""".strip()

# Add new pages requested: finance-transition, ai-governance, global-stage, energy-transition, universal-broadband and their impact stubs (more than stubs—deep philosophy).
def make_new_page(filename, title, breadcrumb, slug, cards_html):
    # Use same layout template already in files; simplest: clone from an existing page and replace main content.
    # We'll fetch a template from vision.html and swap <main> inner between <main ...> and </main>.
    template = read(os.path.join(pages_dir,"vision.html"))
    # Extract head+body structure: easiest to build by pattern.
    # We'll locate <main class="wrap" data-page-slug="..."> and closing </main>
    m = re.search(r'(<main class="wrap" data-page-slug=")([^"]*)(">\s*)(.*?)(\s*</main>)', template, re.S)
    assert m
    prefix = template[:m.start(1)]
    main_open = f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n'
    main_close = "\n  </main>"
    # Replace title in <title> and <h1>
    out = template
    out = re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', out, flags=re.S)
    out = re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', out, flags=re.S)
    out = re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', out, count=1, flags=re.S)
    # Replace slug in main tag and inner html
    out = re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>',
                 main_open + cards_html + "\n" + thoughts_form(slug, title) + main_close,
                 out, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages_dir, filename), out)

# We need thoughts_form; it's embedded in existing pages. We'll quickly parse from an existing page between kicker Thoughts and closing </div></div>? 
# Easier: reuse the exact HTML from one page's thoughts form block; then replace slug/title hidden inputs.
sample = read(os.path.join(pages_dir,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = sample.find(marker)
end = sample.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thought_block = sample[start:end].strip()

def thoughts_form(slug, title):
    blk = thought_block
    # Replace hidden values in the block:
    blk = re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk = re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

import os, zipfile, shutil, re

src = "/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v2.zip"
work = "/mnt/data/wmr_site_v3"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src, "r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages = os.path.join(work, "pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

# Extract thoughts form from an existing page
sample = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = sample.find(marker)
end = sample.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts = sample[start:end]

def make_page(filename, title, breadcrumb, slug, cards):
    template = sample
    template = re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', template)
    template = re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', template)
    template = re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', template, count=1)
    main = f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n' + cards + "\n" + thoughts.replace('value="vision"', f'value="{slug}"').replace('value="Future Vision"', f'value="{title}"') + "\n</main>"
    template = re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, template, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), template)

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

import os, zipfile, shutil, re

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v5.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v6"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

# Template and thoughts block
sample = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = sample.find(marker)
end = sample.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = sample[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=sample
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

# Expand existing energy-transition, universal-broadband, finance-transition, ai-governance with more operational detail
def expand_existing(filename, additions):
    path=os.path.join(pages,filename)
    html=read(path)
    # insert before thoughts card marker in that file
    marker_local = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
    idx=html.find(marker_local)
    if idx==-1:
        return
    html_new = html[:idx] + additions + "\n" + html[idx:]
    write(path, html_new)

Your unzip workflow (simple and safe)
Since you’re going to drop all zips into a root folder and build a script, here’s a reliable pattern:

Option 1: Always deploy the latest zip only
Because each zip is a full site snapshot, the simplest approach is: use the latest zip (v6) as your root.

Option 2: Unzip sequentially into the same folder (overlay)
If you still want to layer them:

mkdir -p site_root
unzip -o wmr_site_netlify_v1.zip -d site_root
unzip -o wmr_site_netlify_v2.zip -d site_root
unzip -o wmr_site_netlify_v3.zip -d site_root
unzip -o wmr_site_netlify_v4.zip -d site_root
unzip -o wmr_site_netlify_v5.zip -d site_root
unzip -o wmr_site_netlify_v6.zip -d site_root
-o ensures later versions overwrite earlier ones cleanly.

    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v8.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v9"
if os.path.exists(work):

os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

import os, zipfile, shutil, re

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v10.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v11"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

import os, zipfile, shutil, re

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v12.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v13"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

import os, zipfile, shutil, re

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v13.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v14"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

import os, zipfile, shutil, re

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v15.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v16"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

# Retirement/Social Security/People's Wealth Fund pillar

import os, zipfile, shutil, re

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v16.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v17"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

import os, zipfile, shutil, re

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v17.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v18"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

import os, zipfile, shutil, re

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v19.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v20"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

import os, zipfile, shutil, re

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v21.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v22"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os, re, json, zipfile, shutil, hashlib, datetime

PATCH_DIR = "site_patches"
OUT_DIR = "dist_site"

VERSION_RE = re.compile(r"(?:_v(\d+))?\.zip$", re.IGNORECASE)

def version_of(name: str) -> int:
    m = re.search(r"_v(\d+)\.zip$", name, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m: return int(m.group(1))
    # treat the very first as v1 if no suffix
    if name.lower().endswith(".zip"): return 1
    return 0

def sha256(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024*1024), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

def list_zip_files(patch_dir):
    zips = [f for f in os.listdir(patch_dir) if f.lower().endswith(".zip")]
    zips.sort(key=lambda f: version_of(f))
    return zips

def apply_zip(zip_path, out_dir, overwrite_log):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "r") as z:
        for member in z.infolist():
            if member.is_dir():
                continue
            target_path = os.path.join(out_dir, member.filename)
            # track overwrites
            if os.path.exists(target_path):
                overwrite_log.append(member.filename)
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(target_path), exist_ok=True)
            with z.open(member, "r") as src, open(target_path, "wb") as dst:
                shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)

def main():
    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    # clean build
    shutil.rmtree(OUT_DIR)
    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

    zips = list_zip_files(PATCH_DIR)
    if not zips:
        raise SystemExit(f"No zip files found in {PATCH_DIR}")

    manifest = {
        "built_at": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
        "patch_dir": PATCH_DIR,
        "output_dir": OUT_DIR,
        "applied": [],
        "overwrites": {},
    }

    for f in zips:
        zp = os.path.join(PATCH_DIR, f)
        overwrites = []
        apply_zip(zp, OUT_DIR, overwrites)
        manifest["applied"].append({
            "file": f,
            "version": version_of(f),
            "sha256": sha256(zp),
        })
        if overwrites:
            manifest["overwrites"][f] = sorted(set(overwrites))

    with open(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, ".build-manifest.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fp:
        json.dump(manifest, fp, indent=2)

    print(f"Built {OUT_DIR} from {len(zips)} patches.")
    if manifest["overwrites"]:
        print("Overwrites detected. See .build-manifest.json")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os, zipfile, shutil, re

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v24.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v25"

    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()

def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

compute_py = textwrap.dedent("""
#!/usr/bin/env python3
\"\"\"Compute QoLI outputs from scenario assumptions and domain indicator definitions.

This starter script is intentionally simple:
- Loads /data/qoli/config.json, scenarios.json, households.json, and domains/*.json
- Produces /data/qoli/outputs/<household_key>.json

Replace placeholder scoring with real indicator math as the model matures.
\"\"\"
import json, os, datetime, glob

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(__file__))
DATA = os.path.join(ROOT, "data", "qoli")

def load(path):
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)

def save(path, obj):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(obj, f, indent=2)

def main():
    config = load(os.path.join(DATA, "config.json"))
    households = load(os.path.join(DATA, "households.json"))["households"]
    scenarios = load(os.path.join(DATA, "scenarios.json"))["scenarios"]

    domains = {}
    for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(DATA, "domains", "*.json")):
        d = load(p)
        domains[d["domain_key"]] = d

    # Placeholder scoring: equal weights and a simple placeholder delta for WMR
    # Replace this with real indicator aggregation + cost modeling.
    timepoints = [str(y) for y in config["timepoints_years"]]
    out_dir = os.path.join(DATA, "outputs")
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

    for hh in households:
        base = 50
        result = {
            "household_key": hh["key"],
            "generated_at": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
            "timepoints": {},
            "disclaimer": "Starter output: placeholder scoring only. Replace with computed results as indicators and assumptions are populated."
        }
        for t in timepoints:
            year = int(t)
            # illustrative placeholder: status quo slowly declines, WMR improves over time
            status = max(0, base - (year//5)*2)
            wmr = min(100, base + 5 + (year//5)*6)
            result["timepoints"][t] = {
                "status_quo": {"qoli": status, "domains": {}},
                "wmr": {"qoli": wmr, "domains": {}}
            }
        save(os.path.join(out_dir, f"{hh['key']}.json"), result)

    print("QoLI outputs generated in:", out_dir)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
""").strip()+"\n"

})();

import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, textwrap, datetime

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v26.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v27"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()

def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_head="", extra_body_end=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_head:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</head>", extra_head + "\n</head>")
    if extra_body_end:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_body_end + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

# Add true costs page with renderer
extra_head = """
<style>

  @media(min-width:900px){.tc-two{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
  .tc-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
  .tc-table th,.tc-table td{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12);padding:8px 6px;text-align:left}
  .num{font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums}
</style>
"""

tc_script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const select = document.getElementById('tc-time');
  const outEl = document.getElementById('tc-output');
  if(!select || !outEl) return;

  async function loadJson(url){
    const res = await fetch(url, {cache:'no-store'});
    return await res.json();
  }

  let sq=null, wmr=null;
  try{
    sq = await loadJson('/data/qoli/costs/status_quo.json');
    wmr = await loadJson('/data/qoli/costs/wmr.json');
  }catch(e){
    outEl.innerHTML = '<p class="note">Could not load cost ledgers yet.</p>';
    return;
  }

  function fmt(n){
    const sign = n < 0 ? '-' : '';
    const x = Math.abs(n);
    return sign + '$' + x.toLocaleString();
  }

  function renderTable(obj){
    const rows = Object.entries(obj).map(([k,v]) => `
      <tr><td>${k.replaceAll('_',' ')}</td><td class="num">${fmt(v)}</td></tr>
    `).join('');
    return `<table class="tc-table"><thead><tr><th>Line item</th><th>Annualized amount</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>`;
  }

  function sum(obj){
    return Object.values(obj).reduce((a,b)=>a + (typeof b==='number'?b:0), 0);
  }

  function render(){
    const t = select.value;
    const a = sq.timepoints[t]; const b = wmr.timepoints[t];
    if(!a || !b){ outEl.innerHTML='<p class="note">No ledger for this timepoint.</p>'; return; }

    const ah = a.household, bh = b.household;
    const asys = a.system, bsys = b.system;

    const totalA = sum(ah);
    const totalB = sum(bh);

    const delta = totalB - totalA;

    outEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="callout">
        <b>True Costs at ${t} year(s)</b><br>
        Status quo household total: <span class="num">${fmt(totalA)}</span> &nbsp; | &nbsp;
        WMR household total: <span class="num">${fmt(totalB)}</span> &nbsp; | &nbsp;
        Difference: <span class="num">${fmt(delta)}</span>
        <div class="note" style="margin-top:8px">${sq.disclaimer || ''}</div>
      </div>

      <div class="tc-two">
        <div class="card">
          <div class="kicker">Household ledger</div>
          <h2>Status quo</h2>
          ${renderTable(ah)}
        </div>
        <div class="card">
          <div class="kicker">Household ledger</div>
          <h2>Working Majority Republic</h2>
          ${renderTable(bh)}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tc-two" style="margin-top:12px">
        <div class="card">
          <div class="kicker">System ledger</div>
          <h2>Status quo</h2>
          ${renderTable(asys)}
        </div>
        <div class="card">
          <div class="kicker">System ledger</div>
          <h2>Working Majority Republic</h2>
          ${renderTable(bsys)}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  select.addEventListener('change', render);
  render();
})();
</script>
"""

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_head="", extra_body_end=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_head:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</head>", extra_head + "\n</head>")
    if extra_body_end:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_body_end + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)
