def wrap_line(value, assumption, mechanism, rationale, low=None, high=None, source_note=""):
    if low is None: low = round(value*0.85)
    if high is None: high = round(value*1.15)
    return {
        "base": value,
        "low": low,
        "high": high,
        "assumption": assumption,
        "mechanism": mechanism,
        "rationale": rationale,
        "source_note": source_note
    }

def transform(cost_obj, scenario):
    # Convert each household/system numeric into range objects + narrative logic
    for tp, block in cost_obj["timepoints"].items():
        # household
        hh = block.get("household", {})
        hh2={}
        for k,v in hh.items():
            if isinstance(v,(int,float)):
                if k=="healthcare":
                    if scenario=="status_quo":
                        hh2[k]=wrap_line(v,
                            "Employer-based coverage remains dominant; premiums and out-of-pocket rise with medical inflation.",
                            "Households pay premiums, deductibles, and surprise billing; cost shifting continues.",
                            "Healthcare spending growth historically outpaces wage growth; families absorb volatility.")
                    else:
                        hh2[k]=wrap_line(v,
                            "Universal coverage eliminates household premiums/deductibles for covered care.",
                            "Costs shift to contributions/pooled finance; household out-of-pocket collapses.",
                            "If care is guaranteed publicly, direct household payment drops sharply; remaining costs are minimal.")
                elif k=="housing":
                    hh2[k]=wrap_line(v,
                        "Housing prices/rents follow local supply constraints and market power unless reformed.",
                        "Zoning, anti-hoarding, and ownership pathways can reduce long-run burden under WMR.",
                        "Housing is the largest household cost; small percentage changes matter massively.")
                elif k=="wealth_dividend":
                    # negative values represent money returned; set low/high in magnitude
                    base=v
                    hh2[k]={
                        "base": base,
                        "low": int(base*0.6),
                        "high": int(base*1.4),
                        "assumption":"People’s Wealth Fund grows as productivity and automation gains are shared.",
                        "mechanism":"Dividend returns a portion of national surplus to contributors.",
                        "rationale":"A larger share of productivity captured by the public fund increases household returns.",
                        "source_note":"Placeholder — dividend depends on fund size and distribution rules."
                    }
                else:
                    hh2[k]=wrap_line(v,
                        "Placeholder assumption — to be refined per line item.",
                        "Policy and market structure determine this cost line.",
                        "We will replace placeholders with best-guess estimates and publish logic for each item.")
            else:
                hh2[k]=v
        block["household"]=hh2

        # system
        sys = block.get("system", {})
        sys2={}
        for k,v in sys.items():
            if isinstance(v,(int,float)):
                if k=="hidden_costs":
                    sys2[k]=wrap_line(v,
                        "Hidden costs include avoidable bankruptcies, ER overuse, incarceration, lost productivity, and disaster losses.",
                        "WMR reduces hidden costs by stabilizing housing/healthcare, reducing crime drivers, and improving resilience.",
                        "Many status quo costs do not appear on government budgets but still reduce national welfare.")
                else:
                    sys2[k]=wrap_line(v,
                        "Placeholder assumption — to be refined; includes both government and market spending.",
                        "Reforms shift spending between public and private channels without increasing total burden necessarily.",
                        "The point is to compare total system burden and stability, not just who writes the check.")
            else:
                sys2[k]=v
        block["system"]=sys2
    cost_obj["ranges"]="low/base/high"
    cost_obj["model_standard"]=[
        "Assumption + mechanism + rationale shown for each line item.",
        "Ranges are illustrative until replaced with research-backed bounds.",
        "Avoid false precision; publish uncertainty."
    ]
    return cost_obj

tc_script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const timeSel = document.getElementById('tc-time');
  const rangeSel = document.getElementById('tc-range');
  const hhSel = document.getElementById('tc-household');
  const outEl = document.getElementById('tc-output');
  if(!timeSel || !rangeSel || !hhSel || !outEl) return;

  async function loadJson(url){
    const res = await fetch(url, {cache:'no-store'});
    return await res.json();
  }

  let sq=null, wmr=null;
  try{
    sq = await loadJson('/data/qoli/costs/status_quo.json');
    wmr = await loadJson('/data/qoli/costs/wmr.json');
  }catch(e){
    outEl.innerHTML = '<p class="note">Could not load cost ledgers yet.</p>';
    return;
  }

  function fmt(n){
    const sign = n < 0 ? '-' : '';
    const x = Math.abs(n);
    return sign + '$' + x.toLocaleString();
  }

  function pick(valObj, rangeKey){
    if(typeof valObj === 'number') return valObj;
    if(!valObj || typeof valObj !== 'object') return 0;
    return (valObj[rangeKey] ?? valObj.base ?? 0);
  }

  // Placeholder household toggle adjustments:
  // renter: treat housing as rent; owner: add maintenance/insurance factor (simple multiplier for now).
  function adjustHouseholdLines(lines, hhType, rangeKey){
    const out = {};
    for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(lines)){
      let n = pick(v, rangeKey);
      if(k === 'housing'){
        if(hhType === 'owner'){ n = Math.round(n * 1.08); } // placeholder
        if(hhType === 'renter'){ n = Math.round(n * 1.00); }
      }
      out[k] = {raw:v, value:n};
    }
    return out;
  }

  function renderTable(linesAdjusted, showLogic){
    const rows = Object.entries(linesAdjusted).map(([k,obj]) => {
      const v = obj.raw;
      const logic = (showLogic && v && typeof v === 'object') ? `
        <div class="mini note" style="margin-top:6px">
          <b>Assumption:</b> ${(v.assumption||'').toString()}<br>
          <b>Mechanism:</b> ${(v.mechanism||'').toString()}<br>
          <b>Rationale:</b> ${(v.rationale||'').toString()}
        </div>` : '';
      return `
        <tr>
          <td>${k.replaceAll('_',' ')}</td>
          <td class="num">${fmt(obj.value)}${logic}</td>
        </tr>`;
    }).join('');
    return `<table class="tc-table"><thead><tr><th>Line item</th><th>Annualized amount</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>`;
  }

  function sum(linesAdjusted){
    return Object.values(linesAdjusted).reduce((a,b)=>a + (b.value||0), 0);
  }

  function renderSysTable(sys, rangeKey, showLogic){
    const rows = Object.entries(sys).map(([k,v]) => {
      const n = pick(v, rangeKey);
      const logic = (showLogic && v && typeof v === 'object') ? `
        <div class="mini note" style="margin-top:6px">
          <b>Assumption:</b> ${(v.assumption||'').toString()}<br>
          <b>Mechanism:</b> ${(v.mechanism||'').toString()}<br>
          <b>Rationale:</b> ${(v.rationale||'').toString()}
        </div>` : '';
      return `<tr><td>${k.replaceAll('_',' ')}</td><td class="num">${fmt(n)}${logic}</td></tr>`;
    }).join('');
    return `<table class="tc-table"><thead><tr><th>Line item</th><th>Annualized amount</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>`;
  }

  function sumSys(sys, rangeKey){
    return Object.values(sys).reduce((a,v)=>a + pick(v, rangeKey), 0);
  }

  function render(){
    const t = timeSel.value;
    const r = rangeSel.value; // low | base | high
    const hhType = hhSel.value; // renter | owner
    const showLogic = document.getElementById('tc-show-logic').checked;

    const a = sq.timepoints[t]; const b = wmr.timepoints[t];
    if(!a || !b){ outEl.innerHTML='<p class="note">No ledger for this timepoint.</p>'; return; }

    const ahAdj = adjustHouseholdLines(a.household, hhType, r);
    const bhAdj = adjustHouseholdLines(b.household, hhType, r);

    const totalA = sum(ahAdj);
    const totalB = sum(bhAdj);
    const delta = totalB - totalA;

    const sysA = sumSys(a.system, r);
    const sysB = sumSys(b.system, r);

    outEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="callout">
        <b>True Costs at ${t} year(s) • ${r.toUpperCase()} range • ${hhType.toUpperCase()} household</b><br>
        <span class="mini">Household totals:</span>
        Status quo <span class="num">${fmt(totalA)}</span> vs WMR <span class="num">${fmt(totalB)}</span> (Δ <span class="num">${fmt(delta)}</span>)<br>
        <span class="mini">System totals:</span>
        Status quo <span class="num">${fmt(sysA)}</span> vs WMR <span class="num">${fmt(sysB)}</span><br>
        <div class="note" style="margin-top:8px">
          These ranges and logic blocks are scaffolding. We will replace placeholders with best-guess estimates + published rationale and (later) citations.
          <a href="/pages/assumptions-and-ranges.html"><b>Read the assumptions standard</b></a>.
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tc-two">
        <div class="card">
          <div class="kicker">Household ledger</div>
          <h2>Status quo</h2>
          ${renderTable(ahAdj, showLogic)}
        </div>
        <div class="card">
          <div class="kicker">Household ledger</div>
          <h2>Working Majority Republic</h2>
          ${renderTable(bhAdj, showLogic)}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tc-two" style="margin-top:12px">
        <div class="card">
          <div class="kicker">System ledger</div>
          <h2>Status quo</h2>
          ${renderSysTable(a.system, r, showLogic)}
        </div>
        <div class="card">
          <div class="kicker">System ledger</div>
          <h2>Working Majority Republic</h2>
          ${renderSysTable(b.system, r, showLogic)}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  [timeSel, rangeSel, hhSel, document.getElementById('tc-show-logic')].forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('change', render);
  });
  render();
})();
</script>
"""

import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, datetime, math, textwrap

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v28.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v29"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")
data_dir=os.path.join(work,"data","qoli")
outputs_dir=os.path.join(data_dir,"outputs")
os.makedirs(outputs_dir, exist_ok=True)

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

# Helper scoring functions
def clamp(x, lo=0, hi=100):
    return max(lo, min(hi, x))

def linear_score(value, bad, good, higher_is_better=False):
    # Map value to 0..100. If higher_is_better=False, lower is better.
    if higher_is_better:
        if value <= bad: return 0
        if value >= good: return 100
        return 100*(value-bad)/(good-bad)
    else:
        # lower is better
        if value <= good: return 100
        if value >= bad: return 0
        return 100*(bad-value)/(bad-good)

def pick(obj, key):
    if isinstance(obj,(int,float)): return obj
    if isinstance(obj,dict):
        return obj.get(key, obj.get("base", 0))
    return 0

# Load configs
config=json.loads(read(os.path.join(data_dir,"config.json")))
domains_cfg={d["key"]: d for d in config["domains"]}

# Load costs ledgers
cost_sq=json.loads(read(os.path.join(data_dir,"costs","status_quo.json")))
cost_wmr=json.loads(read(os.path.join(data_dir,"costs","wmr.json")))

# Household baseline income placeholder (can be replaced later)
# We'll use a nominal "base income" to compute burden ratios.
BASE_INCOME = 75000  # placeholder median household income

def compute_domain_scores(cost_block, range_key, hh_type="renter"):
    """Return domain scores computed from the cost ledger block (household/system) for one scenario at one timepoint."""
    hh=cost_block["household"]
    sys=cost_block["system"]

    # Household toggle adjustment (keep consistent with UI; placeholder)
    housing = pick(hh.get("housing",0), range_key)
    if hh_type=="owner":
        housing = round(housing*1.08)

    healthcare = pick(hh.get("healthcare",0), range_key)
    utilities = pick(hh.get("utilities",0), range_key)
    transport = pick(hh.get("transport",0), range_key)
    edu_debt = pick(hh.get("education_debt",0), range_key)
    med_debt = pick(hh.get("medical_debt",0), range_key)
    taxes_fees = pick(hh.get("taxes_fees",0), range_key)
    contribution = pick(hh.get("contribution",0), range_key)
    wealth_dividend = pick(hh.get("wealth_dividend",0), range_key)  # negative reduces cost

    # total net household outflow
    total = housing + healthcare + utilities + transport + edu_debt + med_debt + taxes_fees + contribution + wealth_dividend
    burden = total / BASE_INCOME  # fraction of income spent (net)

    # Affordability: good if burden <= 0.45, bad if >= 0.85
    affordability = linear_score(burden, bad=0.85, good=0.45, higher_is_better=False)

    # Housing stability: good if housing burden <= 0.25, bad if >= 0.45
    housing_burden = housing / BASE_INCOME
    housing_score = linear_score(housing_burden, bad=0.45, good=0.25, higher_is_better=False)

    # Health: proxy using healthcare direct costs + hidden costs (lower costs imply better access + less stress)
    hidden = pick(sys.get("hidden_costs",0), range_key)
    health_proxy = (healthcare/BASE_INCOME) + (hidden/ (BASE_INCOME*2))  # scaled
    health_score = linear_score(health_proxy, bad=0.35, good=0.05, higher_is_better=False)

    # Education & mobility: proxy using education debt payment burden
    edu_burden = edu_debt/BASE_INCOME
    education_score = linear_score(edu_burden, bad=0.08, good=0.00, higher_is_better=False)

    # Infrastructure access: proxy using utilities + transport burdens (lower implies better systems)
    infra_proxy = (utilities+transport)/BASE_INCOME
    infrastructure_score = linear_score(infra_proxy, bad=0.30, good=0.14, higher_is_better=False)

    # Time & stress: proxy using total burden + transport burden (more burden implies more stress/time)
    time_proxy = burden + (transport/BASE_INCOME)
    time_score = linear_score(time_proxy, bad=1.00, good=0.55, higher_is_better=False)

    # Income & work security: placeholder uses net dividend presence and burden (better if dividend offsets costs)
    # If wealth dividend is large (more negative), score increases.
    dividend_ratio = (-wealth_dividend)/BASE_INCOME  # positive when dividend returns money
    income_work_score = clamp(50 + 200*dividend_ratio - 80*(burden-0.6))

    # Safety/justice and democratic agency: placeholders until we connect to future metrics
    safety_score = 50
    agency_score = 50

    return {
        "income_work": round(clamp(income_work_score),1),
        "affordability": round(clamp(affordability),1),
        "housing": round(clamp(housing_score),1),
        "health": round(clamp(health_score),1),
        "education": round(clamp(education_score),1),
        "safety_justice": round(clamp(safety_score),1),
        "time_stress": round(clamp(time_score),1),
        "infrastructure_access": round(clamp(infrastructure_score),1),
        "democratic_agency": round(clamp(agency_score),1),
        "_meta": {
            "base_income": BASE_INCOME,
            "net_household_outflow": round(total,2),
            "burden_fraction": round(burden,4),
            "hh_type": hh_type,
            "range": range_key
        }
    }

def compute_qoli(dom_scores):
    total_w=0.0
    acc=0.0
    for k,v in dom_scores.items():
        if k.startswith("_"): continue
        w=domains_cfg.get(k, {}).get("weight", 1.0)
        total_w += w
        acc += w * float(v)
    if total_w==0: return 0
    return round(acc/total_w,1)

# Generate outputs with domain breakdowns for each timepoint and range
timepoints=[str(y) for y in config["timepoints_years"]]
ranges=["low","base","high"]
hh_types=["renter","owner"]

output={
    "household_key":"base_working_family",
    "generated_at": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()+"Z",
    "notes":"Computed QoLI scaffold: domains derived from True Costs burdens + placeholder scores for domains not yet wired. Replace with richer indicators over time.",
    "assumptions":{
        "base_income": BASE_INCOME,
        "domain_weights":"equal (initial defensible baseline)",
        "burden_scoring_thresholds":{
            "affordability_good":0.45, "affordability_bad":0.85,
            "housing_good":0.25, "housing_bad":0.45
        }
    },
    "timepoints": {}
}

for t in timepoints:
    output["timepoints"][t]={}
    for hh_type in hh_types:
        output["timepoints"][t][hh_type]={}
        for r in ranges:
            sq_block=cost_sq["timepoints"][t]
            wmr_block=cost_wmr["timepoints"][t]
            sq_dom=compute_domain_scores(sq_block, r, hh_type)
            wmr_dom=compute_domain_scores(wmr_block, r, hh_type)
            output["timepoints"][t][hh_type][r]={
                "status_quo": {"domains": sq_dom, "qoli": compute_qoli(sq_dom)},
                "wmr": {"domains": wmr_dom, "qoli": compute_qoli(wmr_dom)}
            }

write(os.path.join(outputs_dir,"base_working_family.json"), json.dumps(output, indent=2))

# Update tools/compute_qoli.py to reflect new computation pipeline

compute_py = textwrap.dedent("""
#!/usr/bin/env python3
\"\"\"Compute QoLI outputs from the True Costs ledger.

This version:
- Loads /data/qoli/config.json
- Loads /data/qoli/costs/status_quo.json and wmr.json
- Computes domain scores primarily from cost burdens (starter wiring)
- Writes /data/qoli/outputs/base_working_family.json

As the project matures:
- Replace placeholders (safety, agency, income/work) with real indicators
- Add demographic/region household variants
- Add real vs nominal dollars and inflation assumptions
- Add citations and uncertainty ranges sourced from research
\"\"\"
import json, os, datetime

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(__file__))
DATA = os.path.join(ROOT, "data", "qoli")

def load(path):
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)

def save(path, obj):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(obj, f, indent=2)

def clamp(x, lo=0, hi=100):
    return max(lo, min(hi, x))

def pick(obj, key):
    if isinstance(obj, (int, float)): return obj
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        return obj.get(key, obj.get("base", 0))
    return 0

def linear_score(value, bad, good, higher_is_better=False):
    if higher_is_better:
        if value <= bad: return 0
        if value >= good: return 100
        return 100*(value-bad)/(good-bad)
    else:
        if value <= good: return 100
        if value >= bad: return 0
        return 100*(bad-value)/(bad-good)

def compute_domain_scores(cost_block, range_key, hh_type, base_income):
    hh = cost_block["household"]
    sys = cost_block["system"]

    housing = pick(hh.get("housing",0), range_key)
    if hh_type == "owner":
        housing = round(housing * 1.08)  # placeholder adjustment

    healthcare = pick(hh.get("healthcare",0), range_key)
    utilities = pick(hh.get("utilities",0), range_key)
    transport = pick(hh.get("transport",0), range_key)
    edu_debt = pick(hh.get("education_debt",0), range_key)
    med_debt = pick(hh.get("medical_debt",0), range_key)
    taxes_fees = pick(hh.get("taxes_fees",0), range_key)
    contribution = pick(hh.get("contribution",0), range_key)
    wealth_dividend = pick(hh.get("wealth_dividend",0), range_key)

    total = housing + healthcare + utilities + transport + edu_debt + med_debt + taxes_fees + contribution + wealth_dividend
    burden = total / base_income

    affordability = linear_score(burden, bad=0.85, good=0.45, higher_is_better=False)
    housing_burden = housing / base_income
    housing_score = linear_score(housing_burden, bad=0.45, good=0.25, higher_is_better=False)

    hidden = pick(sys.get("hidden_costs",0), range_key)
    health_proxy = (healthcare/base_income) + (hidden/(base_income*2))
    health_score = linear_score(health_proxy, bad=0.35, good=0.05, higher_is_better=False)

    edu_burden = edu_debt/base_income
    education_score = linear_score(edu_burden, bad=0.08, good=0.00, higher_is_better=False)

    infra_proxy = (utilities+transport)/base_income
    infrastructure_score = linear_score(infra_proxy, bad=0.30, good=0.14, higher_is_better=False)

    time_proxy = burden + (transport/base_income)
    time_score = linear_score(time_proxy, bad=1.00, good=0.55, higher_is_better=False)

    dividend_ratio = (-wealth_dividend)/base_income
    income_work_score = clamp(50 + 200*dividend_ratio - 80*(burden-0.6))

    # Placeholders until wired to metrics:
    safety_score = 50
    agency_score = 50

    return {
        "income_work": round(clamp(income_work_score),1),
        "affordability": round(clamp(affordability),1),
        "housing": round(clamp(housing_score),1),
        "health": round(clamp(health_score),1),
        "education": round(clamp(education_score),1),
        "safety_justice": round(clamp(safety_score),1),
        "time_stress": round(clamp(time_score),1),
        "infrastructure_access": round(clamp(infrastructure_score),1),
        "democratic_agency": round(clamp(agency_score),1),
        "_meta": {"base_income": base_income, "burden_fraction": round(burden,4), "hh_type": hh_type, "range": range_key}
    }

def compute_qoli(dom_scores, weights):
    total_w = 0.0
    acc = 0.0
    for k,v in dom_scores.items():
        if k.startswith("_"): continue
        w = weights.get(k, 1.0)
        total_w += w
        acc += w * float(v)
    return round(acc/total_w, 1) if total_w else 0

def main():
    config = load(os.path.join(DATA, "config.json"))
    sq = load(os.path.join(DATA, "costs", "status_quo.json"))
    wmr = load(os.path.join(DATA, "costs", "wmr.json"))

    base_income = 75000  # placeholder median household income
    weights = {d["key"]: d.get("weight", 1.0) for d in config["domains"]}

    timepoints = [str(y) for y in config["timepoints_years"]]
    ranges = ["low", "base", "high"]
    hh_types = ["renter", "owner"]

    out = {
        "household_key": "base_working_family",
        "generated_at": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
        "notes": "Computed QoLI scaffold from True Costs ledger + placeholders for not-yet-wired domains.",
        "assumptions": {"base_income": base_income, "weights": "equal initial baseline"},
        "timepoints": {}
    }

    for t in timepoints:
        out["timepoints"][t] = {}
        for hh_type in hh_types:
            out["timepoints"][t][hh_type] = {}
            for r in ranges:
                sq_dom = compute_domain_scores(sq["timepoints"][t], r, hh_type, base_income)
                wmr_dom = compute_domain_scores(wmr["timepoints"][t], r, hh_type, base_income)
                out["timepoints"][t][hh_type][r] = {
                    "status_quo": {"domains": sq_dom, "qoli": compute_qoli(sq_dom, weights)},
                    "wmr": {"domains": wmr_dom, "qoli": compute_qoli(wmr_dom, weights)}
                }

    save(os.path.join(DATA, "outputs", "base_working_family.json"), out)
    print("Wrote:", os.path.join(DATA, "outputs", "base_working_family.json"))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
""").strip()+"\n"

qoli_script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const timeSel = document.getElementById('qoli-time');
  const rangeSel = document.getElementById('qoli-range');
  const hhSel = document.getElementById('qoli-household');
  const outEl = document.getElementById('qoli-output');
  const domEl = document.getElementById('qoli-domains');
  if(!timeSel || !rangeSel || !hhSel || !outEl || !domEl) return;

  const dataUrl = '/data/qoli/outputs/base_working_family.json';
  let payload = null;
  try{
    const res = await fetch(dataUrl, {cache:'no-store'});
    payload = await res.json();
  }catch(e){
    outEl.innerHTML = '<p class="note">Could not load QoLI data yet.</p>';
    return;
  }

  function pill(x){ return `<span class="pill num">${x}</span>`; }

  function renderDomains(domSq, domWmr){
    const keys = Object.keys(domSq).filter(k=>!k.startsWith('_'));
    const rows = keys.map(k=>{
      const a = domSq[k]; const b = domWmr[k];
      const da = (b - a);
      const w = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, b));
      return `
        <tr>
          <td>${k.replaceAll('_',' ')}</td>
          <td class="num">${a}</td>
          <td class="num">${b}</td>
          <td class="num">${da>=0? '+'+da.toFixed(1): da.toFixed(1)}</td>
          <td><div class="bar"><i style="width:${w}%"></i></div></td>
        </tr>
      `;
    }).join('');
    domEl.innerHTML = `
      <table class="qoli-table">
        <thead><tr><th>Domain</th><th>Status quo</th><th>WMR</th><th>Δ</th><th>WMR level</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
      </table>
      <div class="note" style="margin-top:8px">
        Domains currently wired mainly to the True Costs ledger (burden-based scoring). Safety and agency are placeholders until we connect additional metrics.
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function render(){
    const t = timeSel.value;
    const r = rangeSel.value;
    const hh = hhSel.value;

    const node = payload.timepoints?.[t]?.[hh]?.[r];
    if(!node){
      outEl.innerHTML = '<p class="note">No data for this selection yet.</p>';
      domEl.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    const sq = node.status_quo.qoli;
    const wmr = node.wmr.qoli;
    const delta = (wmr - sq);

    outEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="callout">
        <b>QoLI at ${t} year(s) • ${r.toUpperCase()} range • ${hh.toUpperCase()} household</b><br>
        Status quo: ${pill(sq)} &nbsp; | &nbsp; Working Majority Republic: ${pill(wmr)} &nbsp; | &nbsp; Difference: ${pill((delta>=0? '+'+delta.toFixed(1): delta.toFixed(1)))}
        <div class="note" style="margin-top:8px">
          QoLI is computed from domain scores. This version is a scaffold: affordability, housing, health, education, infrastructure, time/stress use burden-based scoring from the ledger; other domains will be wired next.
          <a href="/pages/true-costs.html"><b>True Costs</b></a> • <a href="/pages/assumptions-and-ranges.html"><b>Assumptions</b></a>.
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    renderDomains(node.status_quo.domains, node.wmr.domains);
  }

  [timeSel, rangeSel, hhSel].forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('change', render));
  render();
})();
</script>
"""

import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, datetime, textwrap

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v29.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v30"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")
data_dir=os.path.join(work,"data","qoli")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):

# We'll replace the placeholder safety and agency score blocks by reading metrics files and calculating domain score from indicators
compute_new = textwrap.dedent("""
#!/usr/bin/env python3
\"\"\"Compute QoLI outputs from the True Costs ledger + governance metrics (scaffold).

This version:
- Loads /data/qoli/config.json
- Loads /data/qoli/costs/status_quo.json and wmr.json
- Loads /data/qoli/metrics/safety_justice.json and democratic_agency.json
- Computes:
  - affordability/housing/health/education/infrastructure/time-stress from cost burdens (starter wiring)
  - safety_justice from safety metrics indicators
  - democratic_agency from agency metrics indicators (with money_influence inverted)
- Writes /data/qoli/outputs/base_working_family.json

As the project matures:
- Replace placeholders in metrics with best-guess estimates + citations
- Add demographic/region household variants
- Add real vs nominal dollars and inflation assumptions
- Add sensitivity analysis and scenario alternative branches
\"\"\"
import json, os, datetime

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(__file__))
DATA = os.path.join(ROOT, "data", "qoli")

def load(path):
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)

def save(path, obj):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(obj, f, indent=2)

def clamp(x, lo=0, hi=100):
    return max(lo, min(hi, x))

def pick(obj, key):
    if isinstance(obj, (int, float)): return obj
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        return obj.get(key, obj.get("base", 0))
    return 0

def linear_score(value, bad, good, higher_is_better=False):
    if higher_is_better:
        if value <= bad: return 0
        if value >= good: return 100
        return 100*(value-bad)/(good-bad)
    else:
        if value <= good: return 100
        if value >= bad: return 0
        return 100*(bad-value)/(bad-good)

def mean(vals):
    vals = [v for v in vals if v is not None]
    return sum(vals)/len(vals) if vals else 0

def compute_safety_domain(metrics_block, range_key):
    # Lower violent crime + lower incarceration burden => higher score (invert)
    vcrime = pick(metrics_block.get("violent_crime_rate_index",{}), range_key)
    incar = pick(metrics_block.get("incarceration_burden_index",{}), range_key)
    trust = pick(metrics_block.get("community_trust_policing_index",{}), range_key)
    # Normalize indices already ~0-100 where higher is "worse" for vcrime/incar, and higher is better for trust.
    vcrime_score = 100 - vcrime
    incar_score = 100 - incar
    trust_score = trust
    return round(clamp(mean([vcrime_score, incar_score, trust_score])), 1)

def compute_agency_domain(metrics_block, range_key):
    participation = pick(metrics_block.get("participation_index",{}), range_key)
    visibility = pick(metrics_block.get("corruption_visibility_index",{}), range_key)
    money_infl = pick(metrics_block.get("money_influence_index",{}), range_key)
    money_score = 100 - money_infl
    return round(clamp(mean([participation, visibility, money_score])), 1)

def compute_domain_scores(cost_block, range_key, hh_type, base_income, safety_metrics_block, agency_metrics_block):
    hh = cost_block["household"]
    sys = cost_block["system"]

    housing = pick(hh.get("housing",0), range_key)
    if hh_type == "owner":
        housing = round(housing * 1.08)  # placeholder adjustment

    healthcare = pick(hh.get("healthcare",0), range_key)
    utilities = pick(hh.get("utilities",0), range_key)
    transport = pick(hh.get("transport",0), range_key)
    edu_debt = pick(hh.get("education_debt",0), range_key)
    med_debt = pick(hh.get("medical_debt",0), range_key)
    taxes_fees = pick(hh.get("taxes_fees",0), range_key)
    contribution = pick(hh.get("contribution",0), range_key)
    wealth_dividend = pick(hh.get("wealth_dividend",0), range_key)

    total = housing + healthcare + utilities + transport + edu_debt + med_debt + taxes_fees + contribution + wealth_dividend
    burden = total / base_income

    affordability = linear_score(burden, bad=0.85, good=0.45, higher_is_better=False)
    housing_burden = housing / base_income
    housing_score = linear_score(housing_burden, bad=0.45, good=0.25, higher_is_better=False)

    hidden = pick(sys.get("hidden_costs",0), range_key)
    health_proxy = (healthcare/base_income) + (hidden/(base_income*2))
    health_score = linear_score(health_proxy, bad=0.35, good=0.05, higher_is_better=False)

    edu_burden = edu_debt/base_income
    education_score = linear_score(edu_burden, bad=0.08, good=0.00, higher_is_better=False)

    infra_proxy = (utilities+transport)/base_income
    infrastructure_score = linear_score(infra_proxy, bad=0.30, good=0.14, higher_is_better=False)

    time_proxy = burden + (transport/base_income)
    time_score = linear_score(time_proxy, bad=1.00, good=0.55, higher_is_better=False)

    dividend_ratio = (-wealth_dividend)/base_income
    income_work_score = clamp(50 + 200*dividend_ratio - 80*(burden-0.6))

    safety_score = compute_safety_domain(safety_metrics_block, range_key)
    agency_score = compute_agency_domain(agency_metrics_block, range_key)

    return {
        "income_work": round(clamp(income_work_score),1),
        "affordability": round(clamp(affordability),1),
        "housing": round(clamp(housing_score),1),
        "health": round(clamp(health_score),1),
        "education": round(clamp(education_score),1),
        "safety_justice": safety_score,
        "time_stress": round(clamp(time_score),1),
        "infrastructure_access": round(clamp(infrastructure_score),1),
        "democratic_agency": agency_score,
        "_meta": {"base_income": base_income, "burden_fraction": round(burden,4), "hh_type": hh_type, "range": range_key}
    }

def compute_qoli(dom_scores, weights):
    total_w = 0.0
    acc = 0.0
    for k,v in dom_scores.items():
        if k.startswith("_"): continue
        w = weights.get(k, 1.0)
        total_w += w
        acc += w * float(v)
    return round(acc/total_w, 1) if total_w else 0

def main():
    config = load(os.path.join(DATA, "config.json"))
    sq = load(os.path.join(DATA, "costs", "status_quo.json"))
    wmr = load(os.path.join(DATA, "costs", "wmr.json"))
    safety = load(os.path.join(DATA, "metrics", "safety_justice.json"))["timepoints"]
    agency = load(os.path.join(DATA, "metrics", "democratic_agency.json"))["timepoints"]

    base_income = 75000  # placeholder median household income
    weights = {d["key"]: d.get("weight", 1.0) for d in config["domains"]}

    timepoints = [str(y) for y in config["timepoints_years"]]
    ranges = ["low", "base", "high"]
    hh_types = ["renter", "owner"]

    out = {
        "household_key": "base_working_family",
        "generated_at": datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
        "notes": "Computed QoLI scaffold from True Costs ledger + safety and democratic agency metric scaffolds.",
        "assumptions": {"base_income": base_income, "weights": "equal initial baseline"},
        "timepoints": {}
    }

    for t in timepoints:
        out["timepoints"][t] = {}
        for hh_type in hh_types:
            out["timepoints"][t][hh_type] = {}
            for r in ranges:
                sq_dom = compute_domain_scores(sq["timepoints"][t], r, hh_type, base_income, safety[t]["status_quo"], agency[t]["status_quo"])
                wmr_dom = compute_domain_scores(wmr["timepoints"][t], r, hh_type, base_income, safety[t]["wmr"], agency[t]["wmr"])
                out["timepoints"][t][hh_type][r] = {
                    "status_quo": {"domains": sq_dom, "qoli": compute_qoli(sq_dom, weights)},
                    "wmr": {"domains": wmr_dom, "qoli": compute_qoli(wmr_dom, weights)}
                }

    save(os.path.join(DATA, "outputs", "base_working_family.json"), out)
    print("Wrote:", os.path.join(DATA, "outputs", "base_working_family.json"))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
""").strip()+"\n"

write(compute_path, compute_new)

config=json.loads(read(os.path.join(data_dir,"config.json")))
sq=json.loads(read(os.path.join(data_dir,"costs","status_quo.json")))
wmr=json.loads(read(os.path.join(data_dir,"costs","wmr.json")))
safety=json.loads(read(os.path.join(metrics_dir,"safety_justice.json")))["timepoints"]
agency=json.loads(read(os.path.join(metrics_dir,"democratic_agency.json")))["timepoints"]
domains_cfg={d["key"]: d for d in config["domains"]}

def clamp(x, lo=0, hi=100): return max(lo, min(hi, x))
def pick(obj, key):
    if isinstance(obj,(int,float)): return obj
    if isinstance(obj,dict): return obj.get(key, obj.get("base",0))
    return 0
def linear_score(value, bad, good, higher_is_better=False):
    if higher_is_better:
        if value <= bad: return 0
        if value >= good: return 100
        return 100*(value-bad)/(good-bad)
    else:
        if value <= good: return 100
        if value >= bad: return 0
        return 100*(bad-value)/(bad-good)
def mean(vals): 
    vals=[v for v in vals if v is not None]
    return sum(vals)/len(vals) if vals else 0

BASE_INCOME=75000

def compute_safety_domain(block, r):
    v=pick(block.get("violent_crime_rate_index",{}), r)
    i=pick(block.get("incarceration_burden_index",{}), r)
    t=pick(block.get("community_trust_policing_index",{}), r)
    return round(clamp(mean([100-v, 100-i, t])),1)

def compute_agency_domain(block, r):
    p=pick(block.get("participation_index",{}), r)
    vis=pick(block.get("corruption_visibility_index",{}), r)
    m=pick(block.get("money_influence_index",{}), r)
    return round(clamp(mean([p, vis, 100-m])),1)

def compute_domain_scores(cost_block, r, hh_type, safety_block, agency_block):
    hh=cost_block["household"]; sys=cost_block["system"]
    housing=pick(hh.get("housing",0), r)
    if hh_type=="owner": housing=round(housing*1.08)
    healthcare=pick(hh.get("healthcare",0), r)
    utilities=pick(hh.get("utilities",0), r)
    transport=pick(hh.get("transport",0), r)
    edu=pick(hh.get("education_debt",0), r)
    med=pick(hh.get("medical_debt",0), r)
    taxes=pick(hh.get("taxes_fees",0), r)
    contrib=pick(hh.get("contribution",0), r)
    div=pick(hh.get("wealth_dividend",0), r)
    total=housing+healthcare+utilities+transport+edu+med+taxes+contrib+div
    burden=total/BASE_INCOME
    affordability=linear_score(burden, bad=0.85, good=0.45, higher_is_better=False)
    housing_score=linear_score(housing/BASE_INCOME, bad=0.45, good=0.25, higher_is_better=False)
    hidden=pick(sys.get("hidden_costs",0), r)
    health_proxy=(healthcare/BASE_INCOME)+(hidden/(BASE_INCOME*2))
    health_score=linear_score(health_proxy, bad=0.35, good=0.05, higher_is_better=False)
    education_score=linear_score(edu/BASE_INCOME, bad=0.08, good=0.00, higher_is_better=False)
    infra_proxy=(utilities+transport)/BASE_INCOME
    infra_score=linear_score(infra_proxy, bad=0.30, good=0.14, higher_is_better=False)
    time_proxy=burden+(transport/BASE_INCOME)
    time_score=linear_score(time_proxy, bad=1.00, good=0.55, higher_is_better=False)
    dividend_ratio=(-div)/BASE_INCOME
    income_work=clamp(50+200*dividend_ratio-80*(burden-0.6))
    safety_score=compute_safety_domain(safety_block, r)
    agency_score=compute_agency_domain(agency_block, r)
    return {
        "income_work": round(income_work,1),
        "affordability": round(clamp(affordability),1),
        "housing": round(clamp(housing_score),1),
        "health": round(clamp(health_score),1),
        "education": round(clamp(education_score),1),
        "safety_justice": safety_score,
        "time_stress": round(clamp(time_score),1),
        "infrastructure_access": round(clamp(infra_score),1),
        "democratic_agency": agency_score,
        "_meta":{"base_income":BASE_INCOME,"burden_fraction":round(burden,4),"hh_type":hh_type,"range":r}
    }

def compute_qoli(dom):
    total_w=0; acc=0
    for k,v in dom.items():
        if k.startswith("_"): continue
        w=domains_cfg.get(k,{}).get("weight",1.0)
        total_w += w
        acc += w*float(v)
    return round(acc/total_w,1) if total_w else 0

# Add new drilldown pages for safety and agency
def make_page_from_template(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    # reuse vision.html as template similar to prior builds
    tpl=read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    # thoughts block extraction
    start=tpl.find(marker); end=tpl.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
    thoughts_block=tpl[start:end]
    def thoughts(slug,title):
        blk=thoughts_block
        blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
        blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
        return blk
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

"""

import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, datetime, textwrap

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v30.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v31"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

# Use vision.html as master template (consistent styling)
template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

# Build Justice & Safety pillar pages

import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, datetime, textwrap

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v32.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v33"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, datetime, textwrap

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v33.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v34"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, datetime, textwrap

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v34.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v35"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

# --- v37: AI multiplier scaffolding -----------------------------------------
def _clamp(x, lo, hi):
    return max(lo, min(hi, x))

def _load_json(path):
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)

def apply_ai_multipliers(base_output, repo_root):
    \"\"\"Return AI-adjusted projection outputs for two scenarios using transparent heuristic rules.\"\"\"
    ai_path = os.path.join(repo_root, "data", "ai", "ai_capability_scenarios.json")
    rules_path = os.path.join(repo_root, "data", "qoli", "metrics", "ai_multiplier_rules.json")
    ai = _load_json(ai_path)
    rules = _load_json(rules_path)

    timepoints = ai.get("timepoints", {})
    out = {"meta": {"generated_from": "base_working_family.json", "ai_rules_version": rules.get("version","")},
           "scenarios": {}}

    for scen_key in ["status_quo","wmr"]:
        scen = rules["scenarios"][scen_key]
        caps = scen.get("caps", {"max_domain_bonus": 15, "max_domain_penalty": 20})
        out["scenarios"][scen_key] = {"description": scen.get("description",""), "horizons": {}}

        for tp, vals in timepoints.items():
            cap = vals["capability_index"]["base"]
            press = vals["automation_pressure"]["base"]

            # Start from base domain scores (copy)
            domains = dict(base_output.get("domains", {}))
            adj_rules = scen["domain_adjustments"]

            def adj(expr):
                # expr example: "-0.35 * automation_pressure"
                if "automation_pressure" in expr:
                    coef = float(expr.split("*")[0].strip())
                    return coef * press
                if "capability_index" in expr:
                    coef = float(expr.split("*")[0].strip())
                    return coef * cap
                return 0.0

            # Apply adjustments with caps
            for d, expr in adj_rules.items():
                delta = adj(expr)
                if delta >= 0:
                    delta = _clamp(delta, 0, caps.get("max_domain_bonus", 15))
                else:
                    delta = _clamp(delta, -caps.get("max_domain_penalty", 20), 0)
                if d in domains:
                    domains[d] = _clamp(domains[d] + delta, 0, 100)
                else:
                    # if domain missing, ignore
                    pass

            # Recompute total QoLI as average of present domains
            if domains:
                qoli = sum(domains.values()) / len(domains)
            else:
                qoli = base_output.get("qoli", 0)

            out["scenarios"][scen_key]["horizons"][tp] = {
                "ai_inputs": {"capability_index": cap, "automation_pressure": press},
                "domains_adjusted": domains,
                "qoli_adjusted": round(qoli, 2),
                "delta_vs_base": round(qoli - base_output.get("qoli", 0), 2)
            }
    return out
"""

base_out_path=os.path.join(qoli_outputs,"base_working_family.json")
if os.path.exists(base_out_path):
    base_output=json.load(open(base_out_path,"r",encoding="utf-8"))
else:
    base_output={"qoli":50,"domains":{}}

ai_cap=json.load(open(os.path.join(ai_data,"ai_capability_scenarios.json"),"r",encoding="utf-8"))
rules=json.load(open(os.path.join(qoli_metrics,"ai_multiplier_rules.json"),"r",encoding="utf-8"))

def clamp(x, lo, hi): return max(lo, min(hi, x))

def apply(base_output, scen_key):
    scen=rules["scenarios"][scen_key]
    caps=scen.get("caps", {"max_domain_bonus":15,"max_domain_penalty":20})
    out={}
    for tp,vals in ai_cap["timepoints"].items():
        cap=vals["capability_index"]["base"]
        press=vals["automation_pressure"]["base"]
        domains=dict(base_output.get("domains",{}))
        for d,expr in scen["domain_adjustments"].items():
            coef=float(expr.split("*")[0].strip())
            if "automation_pressure" in expr:
                delta=coef*press
            else:
                delta=coef*cap
            if delta>=0:
                delta=clamp(delta,0,caps.get("max_domain_bonus",15))
            else:
                delta=clamp(delta,-caps.get("max_domain_penalty",20),0)
            if d in domains:
                domains[d]=clamp(domains[d]+delta,0,100)
        qoli=sum(domains.values())/len(domains) if domains else base_output.get("qoli",0)
        out[tp]={
            "ai_inputs":{"capability_index":cap,"automation_pressure":press},
            "domains_adjusted":domains,
            "qoli_adjusted":round(qoli,2),
            "delta_vs_base":round(qoli-base_output.get("qoli",0),2)
        }
    return out

ai_adjusted={
    "meta":{"generated_from":"base_working_family.json","ai_rules_version":rules.get("version","")},
    "scenarios":{
        "status_quo":{"description":rules["scenarios"]["status_quo"]["description"],"horizons":apply(base_output,"status_quo")},
        "wmr":{"description":rules["scenarios"]["wmr"]["description"],"horizons":apply(base_output,"wmr")}
    }
}
write(os.path.join(qoli_outputs,"base_working_family_ai_adjusted.json"), json.dumps(ai_adjusted, indent=2))

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

    }

      for(const h of horizons){
        html += `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${s.horizons[h].base}%</td>`;
      }
      html += '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';
    html += '<div class="note" style="margin-top:10px;">'
      + (j.interpretation || '')
      + '</div>';
    sEl.innerHTML = html;
  }catch(e){

  try{

    }

      + '<b>Formula:</b> ' + (k.formula || '') + '<br>'

      + '</div>';
    dEl.innerHTML = html2;
  }catch(e){
    dEl.textContent = 'Unable to load dividend scaffold.';
  }
})();
</script>

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v38.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v39"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")
data=os.path.join(work,"data")
qoli_dir=os.path.join(data,"qoli")
qoli_outputs=os.path.join(qoli_dir,"outputs")
qoli_metrics=os.path.join(qoli_dir,"metrics")
ai_dir=os.path.join(data,"ai")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

# Build household variants scaffolds
os.makedirs(qoli_metrics, exist_ok=True)

households = {
  "notes":"Household variants scaffold. Used to translate policy + QoLI trajectories into felt-life impact. Replace with researched parameters later.",

    {"id":"single_renter_metro","name":"Single adult renter (metro)","members":1,"housing":"renter","region":"metro","income_band":"lower-middle","baseline_hours_worked_per_week":40},
    {"id":"family4_renter_suburban","name":"Family of 4 renter (suburban)","members":4,"housing":"renter","region":"suburban","income_band":"working","baseline_hours_worked_per_week":45},
    {"id":"family4_owner_rural","name":"Family of 4 homeowner (rural)","members":4,"housing":"owner","region":"rural","income_band":"working","baseline_hours_worked_per_week":50},
    {"id":"single_owner_smalltown","name":"Single adult homeowner (small town)","members":1,"housing":"owner","region":"smalltown","income_band":"middle","baseline_hours_worked_per_week":40},
    {"id":"senior_fixed_income","name":"Senior on fixed income","members":1,"housing":"owner_or_renter","region":"any","income_band":"fixed","baseline_hours_worked_per_week":0}
  ],

      "health":{"description":"Higher score = lower medical burden + better access","unit":"stress_points"},
      "housing_stability":{"description":"Higher score = lower displacement and more ownership pathways","unit":"stability_points"},
      "affordability":{"description":"Higher score = lower net outflow burden","unit":"cash_flow_points"},

    }

  },
  "estimated_savings_per_qoli_point_per_member_usd_per_year":{
    "status_quo":120,
    "wmr":220
  },
  "time":{
    "hours_gained_per_10_time_stress_points":{
      "status_quo":0.5,
      "wmr":2.0
    }
  },

    }

}

# Use AI-adjusted QoLI output for projections
ai_out_path=os.path.join(qoli_outputs,"base_working_family_ai_adjusted.json")
ai_out=json.load(open(ai_out_path,"r",encoding="utf-8"))

# Map domain keys to our canonical names (existing keys are likely: income_work, time_stress, affordability, democratic_agency, safety_justice, plus others)
# We'll compute a "household impact" index per variant, scenario, horizon.
rules=json.load(open(os.path.join(qoli_metrics,"household_impact_rules.json"),"r",encoding="utf-8"))
variants=json.load(open(os.path.join(qoli_metrics,"household_variants.json"),"r",encoding="utf-8"))["variants"]

def clamp(x, lo, hi): return max(lo, min(hi, x))

def household_cashflow_multiplier(v):
    m=1.0
    if v["housing"]=="renter": m*=rules["cashflow"]["renters_multiplier"]
    if v["housing"]=="owner": m*=rules["cashflow"]["owners_multiplier"]
    if v["region"]=="rural": m*=rules["cashflow"]["rural_transport_penalty"]
    if v["region"]=="metro": m*=rules["cashflow"]["metro_cost_penalty"]
    return m

def compute_household(v, scen_key, horizon_key):
    h = ai_out["scenarios"][scen_key]["horizons"][horizon_key]
    base_qoli = json.load(open(os.path.join(qoli_outputs,"base_working_family.json"),"r",encoding="utf-8")).get("qoli",50)
    qoli_adj = h["qoli_adjusted"]
    delta_vs_base = qoli_adj - base_qoli

    # Estimated annual "stability value" / savings
    per_point = rules["estimated_savings_per_qoli_point_per_member_usd_per_year"][scen_key]
    annual = delta_vs_base * per_point * v["members"] * household_cashflow_multiplier(v)

    # Time gained uses time_stress domain delta vs base (approx)
    # We don't have base domain score here; approximate by using delta_vs_base as proxy scaled by 0.4
    # and then translate to hours
    # In V40 we will compute true base domain deltas.
    time_proxy_points = delta_vs_base * 0.4
    hours_per_10 = rules["time"]["hours_gained_per_10_time_stress_points"][scen_key]
    weekly_hours = (time_proxy_points/10.0) * hours_per_10

    # Health stress reduction proxy
    health_proxy_points = delta_vs_base * 0.3
    stress_per_10 = rules["health"]["stress_reduction_per_10_health_points"][scen_key]
    stress_points = (health_proxy_points/10.0) * stress_per_10

    return {
        "qoli_ai_adjusted": round(qoli_adj,2),
        "qoli_delta_vs_base": round(delta_vs_base,2),
        "estimated_household_value_usd_per_year": round(annual,2),
        "estimated_weekly_hours_gained": round(weekly_hours,2),
        "estimated_stress_reduction_points": round(stress_points,2),
        "multiplier": round(household_cashflow_multiplier(v),3)
    }

household_projection={
  "meta":{
    "generated_from":"base_working_family_ai_adjusted.json",
    "rules_version":rules["version"],
    "notes":"Scaffold household impacts derived from QoLI deltas. Replace proxies with evidence-backed domain-specific models."
  },
  "variants":{}
}

for v in variants:
    vid=v["id"]
    household_projection["variants"][vid]={"profile":v,"scenarios":{}}
    for scen in ["status_quo","wmr"]:
        household_projection["variants"][vid]["scenarios"][scen]={"horizons":{}}
        for hz in ["1","5","10","20","50"]:
            household_projection["variants"][vid]["scenarios"][scen]["horizons"][hz]=compute_household(v,scen,hz)

write(os.path.join(qoli_outputs,"household_projections_scaffold.json"), json.dumps(household_projection, indent=2))

  const horizons = ['1','5','10','20','50'];

  function fmtMoney(x){
    const n = Number(x);
    const sign = n < 0 ? '-' : '';
    return sign + '$' + Math.abs(n).toLocaleString(undefined,{maximumFractionDigits:0});
  }
  function fmt(x){ return (Math.round(Number(x)*100)/100).toFixed(2); }

  try{
    const res = await fetch('/data/qoli/outputs/household_projections_scaffold.json');
    const j = await res.json();
    const variants = j.variants;

    const list = Object.keys(variants).map(k => ({id:k, name:variants[k].profile.name}));
    list.forEach(v=>{
      const opt=document.createElement('option');
      opt.value=v.id; opt.textContent=v.name;
      sel.appendChild(opt);
    });

    function render(id){
      const v = variants[id];
      const sq = v.scenarios.status_quo.horizons;
      const w = v.scenarios.wmr.horizons;

      let html = `<div class="callout"><b>${v.profile.name}</b><br>`
        + `<span class="muted">Members: ${v.profile.members} • Region: ${v.profile.region} • Housing: ${v.profile.housing} • Multiplier: ${w['1'].multiplier}</span>`
        + `</div>`;

      html += '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
        + '<thead><tr>'
        + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Horizon</th>'
        + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Status quo value/yr</th>'
        + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR value/yr</th>'
        + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ value/yr</th>'
        + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ hours/week</th>'
        + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ stress</th>'
        + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

      for(const h of horizons){
        const a = sq[h].estimated_household_value_usd_per_year;
        const b = w[h].estimated_household_value_usd_per_year;
        const dv = (b - a);
        const dh = (w[h].estimated_weekly_hours_gained - sq[h].estimated_weekly_hours_gained);
        const ds = (w[h].estimated_stress_reduction_points - sq[h].estimated_stress_reduction_points);

        html += '<tr>'
          + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${h}y</b></td>`
          + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtMoney(a)}</td>`
          + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtMoney(b)}</td>`
          + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmtMoney(dv)}</b></td>`
          + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(dh)}</td>`
          + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(ds)}</td>`
          + '</tr>';
      }
      html += '</tbody></table>';

      html += '<div class="note" style="margin-top:10px;">'
        + 'These are scaffolds derived from QoLI deltas (AI-adjusted) using published heuristic rules. '
        + 'Next iterations will compute domain-specific cost curves, and show low/base/high bands.'
        + '</div>';

      out.innerHTML = html;
    }

    sel.addEventListener('change', ()=>render(sel.value));
    render(sel.value || list[0].id);

  }catch(e){
    out.textContent = 'Unable to load household projections.';
  }
})();
</script>
"""
make_page(
    "household-impact-views.html",
    "Household Impact Views",
    "Home / Impact Lab / Household views",
    "household-impact-views",
    cards,
    extra_scripts=script
)

import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, math

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v39.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v40"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")
data=os.path.join(work,"data")
qoli_dir=os.path.join(data,"qoli")
qoli_outputs=os.path.join(qoli_dir,"outputs")
qoli_metrics=os.path.join(qoli_dir,"metrics")
ai_dir=os.path.join(data,"ai")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

# Load AI adjusted outputs and low/high bands
ai_cap_path=os.path.join(ai_dir,"ai_capability_scenarios.json")
ai_cap=json.load(open(ai_cap_path,"r",encoding="utf-8"))
ai_out=json.load(open(os.path.join(qoli_outputs,"base_working_family_ai_adjusted.json"),"r",encoding="utf-8"))

# Expand AI adjusted outputs to include low/high using same rules
rules=json.load(open(os.path.join(qoli_metrics,"ai_multiplier_rules.json"),"r",encoding="utf-8"))
base_output=json.load(open(os.path.join(qoli_outputs,"base_working_family.json"),"r",encoding="utf-8"))

def clamp(x, lo, hi): return max(lo, min(hi, x))

def apply_rules_to_inputs(domains, scen_key, cap, press):
    scen=rules["scenarios"][scen_key]
    caps=scen.get("caps", {"max_domain_bonus":15,"max_domain_penalty":20})
    out=dict(domains)
    for d,expr in scen["domain_adjustments"].items():
        coef=float(expr.split("*")[0].strip())
        if "automation_pressure" in expr:
            delta=coef*press
        else:
            delta=coef*cap
        if delta>=0:
            delta=clamp(delta,0,caps.get("max_domain_bonus",15))
        else:
            delta=clamp(delta,-caps.get("max_domain_penalty",20),0)
        if d in out:
            out[d]=clamp(out[d]+delta,0,100)
    qoli=sum(out.values())/len(out) if out else base_output.get("qoli",0)
    return out, round(qoli,2)

# Generate ai_adjusted_bands.json
bands={"meta":{"generated_from":"base_working_family.json","ai_rules_version":rules.get("version","")},
       "scenarios":{}}
for scen in ["status_quo","wmr"]:
    bands["scenarios"][scen]={"description":rules["scenarios"][scen]["description"],"horizons":{}}
    for hz,vals in ai_cap["timepoints"].items():
        bands["scenarios"][scen]["horizons"][hz]={"low":{}, "base":{}, "high":{}}
        for band in ["low","base","high"]:
            cap=vals["capability_index"][band]
            press=vals["automation_pressure"][band]
            dom, q = apply_rules_to_inputs(base_output["domains"], scen, cap, press)
            bands["scenarios"][scen]["horizons"][hz][band]={
                "ai_inputs":{"capability_index":cap,"automation_pressure":press},
                "domains_adjusted":dom,
                "qoli_adjusted":q,
                "delta_vs_base":round(q-base_output.get("qoli",0),2)
            }
write(os.path.join(qoli_outputs,"base_working_family_ai_adjusted_bands.json"), json.dumps(bands, indent=2))

script2 = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const membersEl = document.getElementById('members');
  const membersVal = document.getElementById('membersVal');
  const regionEl = document.getElementById('region');
  const housingEl = document.getElementById('housing');
  const bandEl = document.getElementById('band');
  const out = document.getElementById('out');

  function fmtMoney(x){
    const n = Number(x);
    const sign = n < 0 ? '-' : '';
    return sign + '$' + Math.abs(n).toLocaleString(undefined,{maximumFractionDigits:0});
  }
  function fmt(x){ return (Math.round(Number(x)*100)/100).toFixed(2); }

  const horizons = ['1','5','10','20','50'];

  const rules = await (await fetch('/data/qoli/metrics/household_impact_rules.json')).json();
  const bands = await (await fetch('/data/qoli/outputs/base_working_family_ai_adjusted_bands.json')).json();
  const base = await (await fetch('/data/qoli/outputs/base_working_family.json')).json();

  function multiplier(housing, region){
    let m = 1.0;
    if(housing === 'renter') m *= rules.cashflow.renters_multiplier;
    if(housing === 'owner') m *= rules.cashflow.owners_multiplier;
    if(region === 'rural') m *= rules.cashflow.rural_transport_penalty;
    if(region === 'metro') m *= rules.cashflow.metro_cost_penalty;
    return m;
  }

  function compute(scenKey, hz, bandKey, members, housing, region){
    const q = bands.scenarios[scenKey].horizons[hz][bandKey].qoli_adjusted;
    const delta = q - base.qoli;
    const perPoint = rules.estimated_savings_per_qoli_point_per_member_usd_per_year[scenKey];
    const annual = delta * perPoint * members * multiplier(housing, region);

    const timeProxy = delta * 0.4;
    const hoursPer10 = rules.time.hours_gained_per_10_time_stress_points[scenKey];
    const weeklyHours = (timeProxy/10.0) * hoursPer10;

    const healthProxy = delta * 0.3;
    const stressPer10 = rules.health.stress_reduction_per_10_health_points[scenKey];
    const stress = (healthProxy/10.0) * stressPer10;

    return {annual, weeklyHours, stress, q};
  }

  function render(){
    const members = Number(membersEl.value);
    const region = regionEl.value;
    const housing = housingEl.value;
    const band = bandEl.value;

    membersVal.textContent = members;

    let html = `<div class="callout"><b>Parameters</b><br>`
      + `<span class="muted">Members: ${members} • Region: ${region} • Housing: ${housing} • AI band: ${band} • Multiplier: ${multiplier(housing,region).toFixed(3)}</span>`
      + `</div>`;

    html += '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Horizon</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Status quo value/yr</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR value/yr</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ value/yr</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ hours/week</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ stress</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for(const h of horizons){
      const a = compute('status_quo', h, band, members, housing, region);
      const b = compute('wmr', h, band, members, housing, region);
      const dv = b.annual - a.annual;
      const dh = b.weeklyHours - a.weeklyHours;
      const ds = b.stress - a.stress;

      html += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${h}y</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtMoney(a.annual)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtMoney(b.annual)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmtMoney(dv)}</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(dh)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(ds)}</td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';

    html += '<div class="note" style="margin-top:10px;">'
      + 'This view uses AI low/base/high bands and published heuristic rules. '
      + 'Next: income-band toggles and domain-specific cost curves (housing, healthcare, childcare).'
      + '</div>';

    out.innerHTML = html;
  }

  membersEl.addEventListener('input', render);
  regionEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  housingEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  bandEl.addEventListener('change', render);

  render();
})();
</script>
