import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, math

# Reload from v39 extracted already in /mnt/data/wmr_site_v40
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v40"
pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")
data=os.path.join(work,"data")
qoli_dir=os.path.join(data,"qoli")
qoli_outputs=os.path.join(qoli_dir,"outputs")
qoli_metrics=os.path.join(qoli_dir,"metrics")
ai_dir=os.path.join(data,"ai")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

# Load base qoli structure and define baseline
base=json.load(open(os.path.join(qoli_outputs,"base_working_family.json"),"r",encoding="utf-8"))
baseline = base["timepoints"]["1"]["renter"]["base"]["status_quo"]
baseline_out = {"qoli": baseline["qoli"], "domains": baseline["domains"], "baseline_selector":{"timepoint":"1","hh_type":"renter","range":"base","scenario":"status_quo"}}
write(os.path.join(qoli_outputs,"baseline.json"), json.dumps(baseline_out, indent=2))

# Load AI capability inputs
ai_cap=json.load(open(os.path.join(ai_dir,"ai_capability_scenarios.json"),"r",encoding="utf-8"))
ai_rules=json.load(open(os.path.join(qoli_metrics,"ai_multiplier_rules.json"),"r",encoding="utf-8"))

def clamp(x, lo, hi): return max(lo, min(hi, x))

def apply_rules(domains, scen_key, cap, press):
    scen=ai_rules["scenarios"][scen_key]
    caps=scen.get("caps", {"max_domain_bonus":15,"max_domain_penalty":20})
    out=dict(domains)
    for d,expr in scen["domain_adjustments"].items():
        coef=float(expr.split("*")[0].strip())
        delta=coef*(press if "automation_pressure" in expr else cap)
        if delta>=0:
            delta=clamp(delta,0,caps.get("max_domain_bonus",15))
        else:
            delta=clamp(delta,-caps.get("max_domain_penalty",20),0)
        if d in out:
            out[d]=clamp(out[d]+delta,0,100)
    qoli=sum(v for k,v in out.items() if k!="_meta")/len([k for k in out.keys() if k!="_meta"])
    return out, round(qoli,2)

# Generate AI adjusted bands based on baseline domains
bands={"meta":{"generated_from":"baseline.json","ai_rules_version":ai_rules.get("version","")},
       "baseline":baseline_out["baseline_selector"],
       "scenarios":{}}
for scen in ["status_quo","wmr"]:
    bands["scenarios"][scen]={"description":ai_rules["scenarios"][scen]["description"],"horizons":{}}
    for hz,vals in ai_cap["timepoints"].items():
        bands["scenarios"][scen]["horizons"][hz]={"low":{}, "base":{}, "high":{}}
        for band in ["low","base","high"]:
            cap=vals["capability_index"][band]
            press=vals["automation_pressure"][band]
            dom, q = apply_rules(baseline_out["domains"], scen, cap, press)
            bands["scenarios"][scen]["horizons"][hz][band]={
                "ai_inputs":{"capability_index":cap,"automation_pressure":press},
                "domains_adjusted":dom,
                "qoli_adjusted":q,
                "delta_vs_baseline":round(q-baseline_out["qoli"],2)
            }
write(os.path.join(qoli_outputs,"baseline_ai_adjusted_bands.json"), json.dumps(bands, indent=2))

script2 = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const membersEl = document.getElementById('members');
  const membersVal = document.getElementById('membersVal');
  const regionEl = document.getElementById('region');
  const housingEl = document.getElementById('housing');
  const bandEl = document.getElementById('band');
  const out = document.getElementById('out');

  function fmtMoney(x){
    const n = Number(x);
    const sign = n < 0 ? '-' : '';
    return sign + '$' + Math.abs(n).toLocaleString(undefined,{maximumFractionDigits:0});
  }
  function fmt(x){ return (Math.round(Number(x)*100)/100).toFixed(2); }

  const horizons = ['1','5','10','20','50'];

  const rules = await (await fetch('/data/qoli/metrics/household_impact_rules.json')).json();
  const bands = await (await fetch('/data/qoli/outputs/baseline_ai_adjusted_bands.json')).json();
  const baseline = await (await fetch('/data/qoli/outputs/baseline.json')).json();

  function multiplier(housing, region){
    let m = 1.0;
    if(housing === 'renter') m *= rules.cashflow.renters_multiplier;
    if(housing === 'owner') m *= rules.cashflow.owners_multiplier;
    if(region === 'rural') m *= rules.cashflow.rural_transport_penalty;
    if(region === 'metro') m *= rules.cashflow.metro_cost_penalty;
    return m;
  }

  function compute(scenKey, hz, bandKey, members, housing, region){
    const q = bands.scenarios[scenKey].horizons[hz][bandKey].qoli_adjusted;
    const delta = q - baseline.qoli;
    const perPoint = rules.estimated_savings_per_qoli_point_per_member_usd_per_year[scenKey];
    const annual = delta * perPoint * members * multiplier(housing, region);

    const timeProxy = delta * 0.4;
    const hoursPer10 = rules.time.hours_gained_per_10_time_stress_points[scenKey];
    const weeklyHours = (timeProxy/10.0) * hoursPer10;

    const healthProxy = delta * 0.3;
    const stressPer10 = rules.health.stress_reduction_per_10_health_points[scenKey];
    const stress = (healthProxy/10.0) * stressPer10;

    return {annual, weeklyHours, stress, q};
  }

  function render(){
    const members = Number(membersEl.value);
    const region = regionEl.value;
    const housing = housingEl.value;
    const band = bandEl.value;

    membersVal.textContent = members;

    let html = `<div class="callout"><b>Parameters</b><br>`
      + `<span class="muted">Members: ${members} • Region: ${region} • Housing: ${housing} • AI band: ${band} • Multiplier: ${multiplier(housing,region).toFixed(3)}</span>`
      + `</div>`;

    html += '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Horizon</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Status quo value/yr</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR value/yr</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ value/yr</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ hours/week</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ stress</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for(const h of horizons){
      const a = compute('status_quo', h, band, members, housing, region);
      const b = compute('wmr', h, band, members, housing, region);
      const dv = b.annual - a.annual;
      const dh = b.weeklyHours - a.weeklyHours;
      const ds = b.stress - a.stress;

      html += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${h}y</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtMoney(a.annual)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtMoney(b.annual)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmtMoney(dv)}</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(dh)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(ds)}</td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';

    html += '<div class="note" style="margin-top:10px;">'
      + 'Baseline is the 1-year renter/base status quo snapshot. Change that baseline later if desired.'
      + '</div>';

    out.innerHTML = html;
  }

  membersEl.addEventListener('input', render);
  regionEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  housingEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  bandEl.addEventListener('change', render);

  render();
})();
</script>
"""

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")
data=os.path.join(work,"data")
qoli_dir=os.path.join(data,"qoli")
qoli_metrics=os.path.join(qoli_dir,"metrics")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, math, datetime

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v42.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v43"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")
data=os.path.join(work,"data")
finance_dir=os.path.join(data,"finance")
qoli_dir=os.path.join(data,"qoli")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

os.makedirs(finance_dir, exist_ok=True)

# National debt paydown + fiscal model scaffold
fiscal = {
  "meta":{
    "version":"0.1-scaffold",
    "notes":[
      "This is a transparent scaffold, not a final forecast.",

ledger_script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const bandEl = document.getElementById('band');
  const hzEl = document.getElementById('hz');
  const out = document.getElementById('ledgerOut');

  function fmtT(n){
    const x = Number(n);
    return '$' + (x/1e12).toFixed(2) + 'T';
  }

  const j = await (await fetch('/data/finance/true_costs_ledger_scaffold.json')).json();

  function render(){
    const band = bandEl.value;
    const hz = hzEl.value; // reserved for later when we make horizon-specific cost paths
    // For scaffold v0.1, costs are horizon-invariant placeholders; we still show horizon selector to lock UX
    let html = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Category</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Status quo</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ (WMR - SQ)</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    let totSQ = 0, totW = 0;
    for(const c of j.categories){
      const sq = j.status_quo.annual_cost_usd_by_category[c.key][band];
      const w = j.wmr.annual_cost_usd_by_category[c.key][band];
      totSQ += sq; totW += w;
      const d = w - sq;
      html += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${c.name}</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtT(sq)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtT(w)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmtT(d)}</b></td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';

    const dTot = totW - totSQ;
    html += `<div class="callout" style="margin-top:10px;"><b>Total (annual, placeholder)</b><br>`
      + `<span class="muted">Band: ${band} • Horizon: ${hz}y</span><br>`
      + `Status quo: <b>${fmtT(totSQ)}</b> • WMR: <b>${fmtT(totW)}</b> • Δ: <b>${fmtT(dTot)}</b>`
      + `</div>`;

    html += '<div class="note">In v0.2 we will replace placeholders with horizon-specific paths and show cumulative totals over time.</div>';
    out.innerHTML = html;
  }

  bandEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  hzEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  render();
})();
</script>
"""

debt_script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const bandEl = document.getElementById('band');
  const out = document.getElementById('debtOut');

  const j = await (await fetch('/data/finance/fiscal_and_debt_model_scaffold.json')).json();

  function fmtT(n){
    const x = Number(n);
    return '$' + (x/1e12).toFixed(2) + 'T';
  }
  function pct(x){ return (x*100).toFixed(2) + '%'; }

  // Simple debt dynamics scaffold:
  // debt_{t+1} = debt_t + primary_deficit_t + interest_rate*debt_t
  // GDP grows by (real + inflation + uplift)
  // WMR improves primary balance via (revenue shifts + cost curve reductions) and uses surplus share for paydown.
  function simulate(band){
    const horizons = j.meta.horizons_years;
    const gdp0 = j.starting_point_placeholders.nominal_gdp_usd;
    const debt0 = j.starting_point_placeholders.debt_held_by_public_usd;

    const r_sq = j.starting_point_placeholders.interest_rate_effective[band];
    const r_wmr = Math.max(0, r_sq - j.wmr.mechanisms.interest_rate_risk_premium_reduction[band]);

    const sq_real = j.status_quo.assumptions.real_gdp_growth[band];
    const sq_inf = j.status_quo.assumptions.inflation[band];

    const w_uplift = j.wmr.mechanisms.net_growth_uplift_from_infrastructure[band];
    const w_real = sq_real + w_uplift;
    const w_inf = sq_inf;

    const prim_sq0 = j.starting_point_placeholders.primary_deficit_status_quo_usd[band];

    // WMR primary balance improvements (placeholders):
    const rev_gain = (j.wmr.mechanisms.revenue_shift_to_extraction_pct_gdp[band]
                    + j.wmr.mechanisms.financial_transaction_levy_pct_gdp[band]
                    + j.wmr.mechanisms.ai_productivity_levy_pct_gdp[band]) * gdp0;

    const cost_curve = (j.wmr.mechanisms.healthcare_cost_curve_reduction_pct[band]
                      + j.wmr.mechanisms.education_cost_curve_reduction_pct[band]) * 0.5 * 1e12; // placeholder scaling

    const waste = j.wmr.mechanisms.fraud_waste_reduction_pct[band] * 0.8e12; // placeholder

    let gdp_sq=gdp0, debt_sq=debt0;
    let gdp_w=gdp0, debt_w=debt0;

    const series=[];
    for(const H of horizons){
      // run H years in annual steps
      gdp_sq=gdp0; debt_sq=debt0;
      gdp_w=gdp0; debt_w=debt0;
      for(let t=1;t<=H;t++){
        const interest_sq = debt_sq * r_sq;
        const prim_sq = prim_sq0 * (1 + 0.02*(t-1)); // deficit worsens slowly placeholder
        debt_sq = debt_sq + prim_sq + interest_sq;
        gdp_sq = gdp_sq * (1 + sq_real + sq_inf);

        const interest_w = debt_w * r_wmr;
        // WMR invests in productivity (cost) but improves balance over time.
        const invest = j.wmr.mechanisms.productivity_investment_pct_gdp[band] * gdp_w;
        const improvement = (rev_gain + cost_curve + waste) * (1 - math.exp(-t/6)); // ramps in
        const prim_w = prim_sq0 - improvement + invest*0.25; // assume 25% of investment is deficit-financed placeholder
        debt_w = debt_w + prim_w + interest_w;

        // If primary becomes surplus, paydown share
        if(prim_w < 0){
          const surplus = -prim_w;
          const pay = surplus * j.wmr.rules.debt_paydown_commitment_share_of_surplus[band];
          debt_w = debt_w - pay;
        }
        gdp_w = gdp_w * (1 + w_real + w_inf);
      }
      series.append? None : None
      series.append({
        "horizon":H,
        "sq":{"debt":debt_sq,"gdp":gdp_sq,"debt_to_gdp":debt_sq/gdp_sq},
        "wmr":{"debt":debt_w,"gdp":gdp_w,"debt_to_gdp":debt_w/gdp_w},
        "delta_debt":debt_w - debt_sq
      })
    return series;

  }

  function render(){
    const band=bandEl.value;
    const s=simulate(band);

    let html = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Horizon</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">SQ debt</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">SQ debt/GDP</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR debt</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR debt/GDP</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ debt</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for(const r of s){
      html += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${r.horizon}y</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtT(r.sq.debt)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${pct(r.sq.debt_to_gdp)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtT(r.wmr.debt)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${pct(r.wmr.debt_to_gdp)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmtT(r.delta_debt)}</b></td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';

    html += '<div class="note" style="margin-top:10px;">'
      + 'This is placeholder math for UX and logic. Next: replace with authoritative baselines and scenario-specific fiscal paths.'
      + '</div>';
    out.innerHTML=html;
  }

  bandEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  render();
})();
</script>
"""
# Note: JS uses math.exp; not available in JS. We'll correct to Math.exp below by replacing.
debt_script = debt_script.replace("math.exp", "Math.exp")

import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, math

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v43.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v44"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")
data=os.path.join(work,"data")
finance_dir=os.path.join(data,"finance")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

""") +

    """

      <option value="20">20 years</option>
      <option value="50">50 years</option>
    </select>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="summary" class="callout" style="margin-top:12px;">Loading…</div>

<div id="ledgerOut" class="note" style="margin-top:12px;">Loading…</div>

<div class="note" style="margin-top:10px;">
<b>Interpretation tip:</b> WMR can cost more in years 1–5 because it is investing to cut recurring burdens (outages, congestion, preventable illness).
The break-even year tells you when cumulative WMR total becomes lower than cumulative status quo (under the selected band and assumptions).
</div>
""") +
    card("How this stays unbiased","Guardrails built into the model",
    """
<ul>
  <li>Same categories in both scenarios (no moving the goalposts).</li>
  <li>Growth rates and ramp costs are explicit and editable.</li>
  <li>Low/base/high bands show uncertainty.</li>
  <li>Break-even is calculated mechanically from the same ledger.</li>
</ul>
<p class="note">Next: connect these national totals to household sliders (per-family translation) and publish a Sources & Methods page.</p>
""")
    )
    script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const bandEl = document.getElementById('band');
  const hzEl = document.getElementById('hz');
  const out = document.getElementById('ledgerOut');
  const summary = document.getElementById('summary');

  function fmtT(n){
    const x = Number(n);
    const sign = x < 0 ? '-' : '';
    const a = Math.abs(x);
    return sign + '$' + (a/1e12).toFixed(2) + 'T';
  }

  const j = await (await fetch('/data/finance/true_costs_ledger_scaffold.json')).json();

  function rampAdd(key, year, band){
    const ramps = (j.wmr && j.wmr.investment_ramps_usd) ? j.wmr.investment_ramps_usd : null;
    if(!ramps || !ramps[key]) return 0;
    const years = ramps[key].years || [];
    if(years.indexOf(year) === -1) return 0;
    return (ramps[key].annual_additional && ramps[key].annual_additional[band]) ? ramps[key].annual_additional[band] : 0;
  }

  function annualCostPath(scnKey, band, years){
    // base annual cost levels are from annual_cost_usd_by_category (treated as year-0 / current baseline)
    const base = (scnKey === 'status_quo') ? j.status_quo.annual_cost_usd_by_category : j.wmr.annual_cost_usd_by_category;
    const growth = (j.growth_rates_annual && j.growth_rates_annual[scnKey]) ? j.growth_rates_annual[scnKey] : {};
    const series = []; // [{year, byCat, total}]
    for(let y=1; y<=years; y++){
      let total=0;
      const byCat={};
      for(const c of j.categories){
        const g = (growth[c.key] && typeof growth[c.key][band] === 'number') ? growth[c.key][band] : 0.03;
        const b = base[c.key][band];
        // simplistic: compound from baseline b for y-1 periods
        let val = b * Math.pow(1+g, y-1);
        if(scnKey === 'wmr'){
          val += rampAdd(c.key, y, band);
        }
        byCat[c.key]=val;
        total += val;
      }
      series.push({year:y, byCat, total});
    }
    return series;
  }

  function findBreakEven(cumSQ, cumW){
    // returns year when cumW <= cumSQ (first time), else null
    for(let i=0;i<cumSQ.length;i++){
      if(cumW[i] <= cumSQ[i]) return i+1;
    }
    return null;
  }

  function render(){
    const band = bandEl.value;
    const H = Number(hzEl.value);

    const sq = annualCostPath('status_quo', band, H);
    const w = annualCostPath('wmr', band, H);

    // cumulative totals
    const cumSQ=[], cumW=[];
    let a=0,b=0;
    for(let i=0;i<H;i++){
      a += sq[i].total;
      b += w[i].total;
      cumSQ.push(a);
      cumW.push(b);
    }
    const breakEven = findBreakEven(cumSQ, cumW);

    const deltaAnnual = w[H-1].total - sq[H-1].total;
    const deltaCum = cumW[H-1] - cumSQ[H-1];

    summary.innerHTML =
      `<b>${H}-year view</b> (band: <b>${band}</b>)<br>` +
      `Annual total in year ${H}: Status quo <b>${fmtT(sq[H-1].total)}</b> • WMR <b>${fmtT(w[H-1].total)}</b> • Δ <b>${fmtT(deltaAnnual)}</b><br>` +
      `Cumulative ${H}y: Status quo <b>${fmtT(cumSQ[H-1])}</b> • WMR <b>${fmtT(cumW[H-1])}</b> • Δ <b>${fmtT(deltaCum)}</b><br>` +
      (breakEven ? `Break-even year (cumulative): <b>${breakEven}</b>` : `Break-even year (cumulative): <b>not reached</b> (under current assumptions)`);

    // Category table at year H
    let html = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Category</th>'
      + `<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">SQ (year ${H})</th>`
      + `<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR (year ${H})</th>`
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for(const c of j.categories){
      const sqv = sq[H-1].byCat[c.key];
      const wv = w[H-1].byCat[c.key];
      const d = wv - sqv;
      html += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${c.name}</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtT(sqv)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtT(wv)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmtT(d)}</b></td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';

    // show first 10 years of cumulative deltas as a simple list
    const showN = Math.min(10, H);
    html += '<div class="note" style="margin-top:10px;"><b>Cumulative Δ (WMR - SQ) by year (first '+showN+' years)</b><br>'
      + Array.from({length:showN}).map((_,i)=>`Year ${i+1}: <b>${fmtT(cumW[i]-cumSQ[i])}</b>`).join(' • ')
      + '</div>';

    out.innerHTML = html;
  }

  bandEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  hzEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  render();
})();
</script>
"""
    make_page("true-costs-ledger.html","True Costs Ledger",
              "Home / Impact Lab / True costs ledger","true-costs-ledger", cards, extra_scripts=script)

debt_script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const bandEl = document.getElementById('band');
  const out = document.getElementById('debtOut');
  const anchorsEl = document.getElementById('anchors');

  const j = await (await fetch('/data/finance/fiscal_and_debt_model_scaffold.json')).json();

  function fmtT(n){
    const x = Number(n);
    const sign = x < 0 ? '-' : '';
    const a = Math.abs(x);
    return sign + '$' + (a/1e12).toFixed(2) + 'T';
  }
  function pct(x){ return (x*100).toFixed(1) + '%'; }

  // Anchors display
  const sp = j.starting_point_placeholders || {};
  const gdp = sp.nominal_gdp_usd_saar_q3_2025 || 0;
  const debt = sp.gross_federal_debt_usd_sep30_2025 || 0;
  const deficit = sp.fy2025_budget_deficit_usd || 0;
  const interest = sp.fy2025_interest_total_usd || 0;

  anchorsEl.innerHTML =
    `<ul>`
    + `<li><b>Nominal GDP (SAAR, Q3 2025)</b>: ${fmtT(gdp)}</li>`
    + `<li><b>Gross federal debt (Sep 30, 2025)</b>: ${fmtT(debt)}</li>`
    + `<li><b>FY 2025 deficit</b>: ${fmtT(deficit)}</li>`
    + `<li><b>FY 2025 interest</b>: ${fmtT(interest)}</li>`
    + `</ul>`
    + `<div class="note">See <a href="/pages/model-sources.html"><b>Sources & Methods</b></a> for links.</div>`;

  // Simple debt dynamics scaffold:
  // debt_{t+1} = debt_t + primary_deficit_t + interest_rate*debt_t
  // GDP grows by (real + inflation + uplift)
  // WMR improves primary balance via (revenue shifts + cost curve reductions) and uses surplus share for paydown.
  function simulate(band){
    const horizons = j.meta.horizons_years;
    const gdp0 = gdp || 27_000_000_000_000;
    const debt0 = debt || 27_000_000_000_000;

    const r_sq = j.starting_point_placeholders.interest_rate_effective[band];
    const r_wmr = Math.max(0, r_sq - j.wmr.mechanisms.interest_rate_risk_premium_reduction[band]);

    const sq_real = j.status_quo.assumptions.real_gdp_growth[band];
    const sq_inf = j.status_quo.assumptions.inflation[band];

    const w_uplift = j.wmr.mechanisms.net_growth_uplift_from_infrastructure[band];
    const w_real = sq_real + w_uplift;
    const w_inf = sq_inf;

    const prim_sq0 = j.starting_point_placeholders.primary_deficit_status_quo_usd[band];

    // WMR primary balance improvements (placeholders):
    const rev_gain = (j.wmr.mechanisms.revenue_shift_to_extraction_pct_gdp[band]
                    + j.wmr.mechanisms.financial_transaction_levy_pct_gdp[band]
                    + j.wmr.mechanisms.ai_productivity_levy_pct_gdp[band]) * gdp0;

    const cost_curve = (j.wmr.mechanisms.healthcare_cost_curve_reduction_pct[band]
                      + j.wmr.mechanisms.education_cost_curve_reduction_pct[band]) * 0.5 * 1e12; // placeholder scaling

    const waste = j.wmr.mechanisms.fraud_waste_reduction_pct[band] * 0.8e12; // placeholder

    let gdp_sq=gdp0, debt_sq=debt0;
    let gdp_w=gdp0, debt_w=debt0;

    const series=[];
    for(const H of horizons){
      gdp_sq=gdp0; debt_sq=debt0;
      gdp_w=gdp0; debt_w=debt0;
      for(let t=1;t<=H;t++){
        const interest_sq = debt_sq * r_sq;
        const prim_sq = prim_sq0 * (1 + 0.02*(t-1)); // deficit worsens slowly placeholder
        debt_sq = debt_sq + prim_sq + interest_sq;
        gdp_sq = gdp_sq * (1 + sq_real + sq_inf);

        const interest_w = debt_w * r_wmr;
        const invest = j.wmr.mechanisms.productivity_investment_pct_gdp[band] * gdp_w;
        const improvement = (rev_gain + cost_curve + waste) * (1 - Math.exp(-t/6)); // ramps in
        const prim_w = prim_sq0 - improvement + invest*0.25; // assume 25% deficit-financed placeholder
        debt_w = debt_w + prim_w + interest_w;

        if(prim_w < 0){
          const surplus = -prim_w;
          const pay = surplus * j.wmr.rules.debt_paydown_commitment_share_of_surplus[band];
          debt_w = debt_w - pay;
        }
        gdp_w = gdp_w * (1 + w_real + w_inf);
      }
      series.push({
        horizon:H,
        sq:{debt:debt_sq,gdp:gdp_sq,debt_to_gdp:debt_sq/gdp_sq},
        wmr:{debt:debt_w,gdp:gdp_w,debt_to_gdp:debt_w/gdp_w},
        delta_debt:debt_w - debt_sq
      });
    }
    return series;
  }

  function render(){
    const band=bandEl.value;
    const s=simulate(band);

    let html = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Horizon</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">SQ debt</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">SQ debt/GDP</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR debt</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR debt/GDP</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ debt</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for(const r of s){
      html += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${r.horizon}y</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtT(r.sq.debt)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${pct(r.sq.debt_to_gdp)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtT(r.wmr.debt)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${pct(r.wmr.debt_to_gdp)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmtT(r.delta_debt)}</b></td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';

    html += '<div class="note" style="margin-top:10px;">'
      + 'This is still a scaffold. v0.3 will replace placeholder primary-balance improvements with sourced budget line-item effects.'
      + '</div>';
    out.innerHTML=html;
  }

  bandEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  render();
})();
</script>
"""
make_page("national-debt-paydown.html","National Debt Paydown",
          "Home / Impact Lab / Fiscal model / Debt paydown","national-debt-paydown", debt_cards, extra_scripts=debt_script)

import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, math

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v44.zip"

    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)

    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")
data=os.path.join(work,"data")
finance_dir=os.path.join(data,"finance")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

    const sq_real = j.status_quo.assumptions.real_gdp_growth[band];
    const sq_inf = j.status_quo.assumptions.inflation[band];

    const w_uplift = j.wmr.mechanisms.net_growth_uplift_from_infrastructure[band];
    const w_real = sq_real + w_uplift;
    const w_inf = sq_inf;

    const prim_sq0 = j.starting_point_placeholders.primary_deficit_status_quo_usd[band];

    const rev_gain = (j.wmr.mechanisms.revenue_shift_to_extraction_pct_gdp[band]
                    + j.wmr.mechanisms.financial_transaction_levy_pct_gdp[band]
                    + j.wmr.mechanisms.ai_productivity_levy_pct_gdp[band]) * gdp0;

    const cost_curve = (j.wmr.mechanisms.healthcare_cost_curve_reduction_pct[band]
                      + j.wmr.mechanisms.education_cost_curve_reduction_pct[band]) * 0.5 * 1e12;

    const waste = j.wmr.mechanisms.fraud_waste_reduction_pct[band] * 0.8e12;

    let gdp_w=gdp0, debt_w=debt0;
    for(let t=1;t<=50;t++){
      const interest_w = debt_w * r_wmr;
      const invest = j.wmr.mechanisms.productivity_investment_pct_gdp[band] * gdp_w;
      const improvement = (rev_gain + cost_curve + waste) * (1 - Math.exp(-t/6));
      const prim_w = prim_sq0 - improvement + invest*0.25;
      // primary surplus if prim_w < 0
      if(prim_w < 0){
        return {year:t, primary_surplus:-prim_w, interest:interest_w, debt:debt_w, gdp:gdp_w};
      }
      debt_w = debt_w + prim_w + interest_w;
      gdp_w = gdp_w * (1 + w_real + w_inf);
    }
    return null;
  }
"""

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

items_script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const bandEl = document.getElementById('band');
  const yrEl = document.getElementById('yr');
  const yrVal = document.getElementById('yrVal');
  const totals = document.getElementById('totals');
  const table = document.getElementById('table');

  function fmtB(n){
    const x = Number(n);
    const sign = x < 0 ? '-' : '';
    const a = Math.abs(x);
    return sign + '$' + (a/1e9).toFixed(0) + 'B';
  }

  const j = await (await fetch('/data/finance/budget_line_items_scaffold.json')).json();

  function rampFactor(item, y){
    const r = item.ramp || {};
    if(r.kind === 'linear'){
      const s = r.start_year || 1;
      const e = r.end_year || s;
      if(y <= s) return 0;
      if(y >= e) return 1;
      return (y - s) / (e - s);
    }
    if(r.kind === 's_curve'){
      const m = r.midpoint_year || 8;
      const k = r.steepness || 0.6;
      // logistic scaled 0..1
      return 1/(1+Math.exp(-k*(y-m)));
    }
    if(r.kind === 'front_load'){
      const years = r.years || [];
      // ramp to 1 quickly across provided years
      if(years.length === 0) return 0;
      const maxY = Math.max(...years);
      if(y <= 1) return 0;
      if(y >= maxY) return 1;
      return Math.min(1, y / maxY);
    }
    return 1;
  }

  function render(){
    const band = bandEl.value;
    const y = Number(yrEl.value);
    yrVal.textContent = 'Year ' + y;

    let sum = 0;
    let rows = '';

    for(const item of j.wmr.items){
      const steady = item.annual_steady_state_usd[band];
      const f = rampFactor(item, y);
      const val = steady * f;
      sum += val;
      rows += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${item.name}</b><br><span class="muted">${item.type}</span></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtB(steady)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${(f*100).toFixed(0)}%</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmtB(val)}</b></td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }

    totals.innerHTML =
      `<b>Total primary-balance effect (WMR line items)</b><br>`
      + `<span class="muted">Band: ${band} • Year: ${y}</span><br>`
      + `Net effect: <b>${fmtB(sum)}</b> (positive improves primary balance; negative worsens)`;


    table.innerHTML =
      '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Item</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Steady-state</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Ramp</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Year effect</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>'
      + rows
      + '</tbody></table>';
  }

  bandEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  yrEl.addEventListener('input', render);
  render();
})();
</script>
"""

<script>
(async function(){
  const bandEl = document.getElementById('band');
  const out = document.getElementById('debtOut');
  const posOut = document.getElementById('posOut');
  const anchorsEl = document.getElementById('anchors');

  const fiscal = await (await fetch('/data/finance/fiscal_and_debt_model_scaffold.json')).json();
  const li = await (await fetch('/data/finance/budget_line_items_scaffold.json')).json();

  function fmtT(n){
    const x = Number(n);
    const sign = x < 0 ? '-' : '';
    const a = Math.abs(x);
    return sign + '$' + (a/1e12).toFixed(2) + 'T';
  }
  function fmtB(n){
    const x = Number(n);
    const sign = x < 0 ? '-' : '';
    const a = Math.abs(x);
    return sign + '$' + (a/1e9).toFixed(0) + 'B';
  }
  function pct(x){ return (x*100).toFixed(1) + '%'; }

  // Anchors
  const sp = fiscal.starting_point_placeholders || {};
  const gdp0 = sp.nominal_gdp_usd_saar_q3_2025 || 27_000_000_000_000;
  const debt0 = sp.gross_federal_debt_usd_sep30_2025 || 27_000_000_000_000;
  const deficit = sp.fy2025_budget_deficit_usd || 0;
  const interest = sp.fy2025_interest_total_usd || 0;

  anchorsEl.innerHTML =
    `<ul>`
    + `<li><b>Nominal GDP (SAAR, Q3 2025)</b>: ${fmtT(gdp0)}</li>`
    + `<li><b>Gross federal debt (Sep 30, 2025)</b>: ${fmtT(debt0)}</li>`
    + `<li><b>FY 2025 deficit</b>: ${fmtT(deficit)}</li>`
    + `<li><b>FY 2025 interest</b>: ${fmtT(interest)}</li>`
    + `</ul>`;

  function rampFactor(item, y){
    const r = item.ramp || {};
    if(r.kind === 'linear'){
      const s = r.start_year || 1;
      const e = r.end_year || s;
      if(y <= s) return 0;
      if(y >= e) return 1;
      return (y - s) / (e - s);
    }
    if(r.kind === 's_curve'){
      const m = r.midpoint_year || 8;
      const k = r.steepness || 0.6;
      return 1/(1+Math.exp(-k*(y-m)));
    }
    if(r.kind === 'front_load'){
      const years = (r.years || []);
      if(years.length === 0) return 0;
      const maxY = Math.max(...years);
      if(y <= 1) return 0;
      if(y >= maxY) return 1;
      return Math.min(1, y / maxY);
    }
    return 1;
  }

  function lineItemEffect(band, year){
    let sum = 0;
    for(const item of li.wmr.items){
      const steady = item.annual_steady_state_usd[band];
      const f = rampFactor(item, year);
      sum += steady * f;
    }
    return sum; // positive improves primary balance
  }

  // Debt dynamics:
  // debt_{t+1} = debt_t + primary_deficit_t + interest_rate*debt_t
  // status quo primary deficit grows; WMR primary deficit improves by line items
  function simulate(band){
    const horizons = fiscal.meta.horizons_years;
    const r_sq = sp.interest_rate_effective[band];
    const r_w = Math.max(0, r_sq - fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.interest_rate_risk_premium_reduction[band]);

    const sq_real = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.real_gdp_growth[band];
    const sq_inf = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.inflation[band];

    const w_uplift = fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.net_growth_uplift_from_infrastructure[band];
    const w_real = sq_real + w_uplift;
    const w_inf = sq_inf;

    const prim0 = sp.primary_deficit_status_quo_usd[band];

    const series = [];
    for(const H of horizons){
      let debt_sq = debt0, gdp_sq = gdp0;
      let debt_w = debt0, gdp_w = gdp0;
      let firstSurplus = null;

      for(let t=1;t<=H;t++){
        const interest_sq = debt_sq * r_sq;
        const prim_sq = prim0 * (1 + 0.02*(t-1));
        debt_sq = debt_sq + prim_sq + interest_sq;
        gdp_sq = gdp_sq * (1 + sq_real + sq_inf);

        const interest_w = debt_w * r_w;
        const improvement = lineItemEffect(band, t);
        // WMR primary deficit reduced by improvement (if improvement positive)
        const prim_w = prim0 * (1 + 0.01*(t-1)) - improvement;
        if(!firstSurplus && prim_w < 0){
          firstSurplus = {year:t, primary_surplus:-prim_w};
        }
        debt_w = debt_w + prim_w + interest_w;
        gdp_w = gdp_w * (1 + w_real + w_inf);
      }

      series.push({
        horizon:H,
        sq:{debt:debt_sq,gdp:gdp_sq,debt_to_gdp:debt_sq/gdp_sq},
        wmr:{debt:debt_w,gdp:gdp_w,debt_to_gdp:debt_w/gdp_w},
        delta_debt:debt_w - debt_sq,
        firstSurplus:firstSurplus
      });
    }
    return series;
  }

  function firstSurplusYear(band){
    // simulate up to 50 years stepwise and find first surplus year using line items
    const r_sq = sp.interest_rate_effective[band];
    const r_w = Math.max(0, r_sq - fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.interest_rate_risk_premium_reduction[band]);
    const sq_real = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.real_gdp_growth[band];
    const sq_inf = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.inflation[band];
    const w_uplift = fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.net_growth_uplift_from_infrastructure[band];
    const w_real = sq_real + w_uplift;
    const w_inf = sq_inf;

    const prim0 = sp.primary_deficit_status_quo_usd[band];
    let debt_w = debt0, gdp_w = gdp0;
    for(let t=1;t<=50;t++){
      const interest_w = debt_w * r_w;
      const improvement = lineItemEffect(band, t);
      const prim_w = prim0 * (1 + 0.01*(t-1)) - improvement;
      if(prim_w < 0){
        return {year:t, primary_surplus:-prim_w, interest:interest_w, debt:debt_w, gdp:gdp_w};
      }
      debt_w = debt_w + prim_w + interest_w;
      gdp_w = gdp_w * (1 + w_real + w_inf);
    }
    return null;
  }

  function render(){
    const band = bandEl.value;
    const ps = firstSurplusYear(band);
    if(ps){
      posOut.innerHTML = `<b>Positive year indicator (line-item driven)</b><br>`
        + `First primary surplus year: <b>${ps.year}</b> • Primary surplus: <b>${fmtB(ps.primary_surplus)}</b><br>`
        + `At that point: interest (annual): <b>${fmtB(ps.interest)}</b> • debt/GDP: <b>${pct(ps.debt/ps.gdp)}</b><br>`
        + `<span class="muted">Next: connect this to the Surplus Allocation Rules to show projected paydown flows.</span>`;
    } else {
      posOut.innerHTML = `<b>Positive year indicator</b><br>Primary surplus not reached within 50 years under current line-item placeholders.`;
    }

    const s = simulate(band);
    let html = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Horizon</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">SQ debt/GDP</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR debt/GDP</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ debt</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">First surplus (≤ horizon)</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for(const r of s){
      html += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${r.horizon}y</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${pct(r.sq.debt_to_gdp)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${pct(r.wmr.debt_to_gdp)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmtT(r.delta_debt)}</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${r.firstSurplus ? ('Year '+r.firstSurplus.year) : '—'}</td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';
    html += '<div class="note" style="margin-top:10px;">Debt paydown is not yet applying surplus allocation in this table. V47 will add paydown flows once surplus begins.</div>';
    out.innerHTML = html;
  }

  bandEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  render();
})();
</script>
"""
make_page("national-debt-paydown.html","National Debt Paydown",
          "Home / Impact Lab / Fiscal model / Debt paydown","national-debt-paydown", debt_cards, extra_scripts=debt_script)

import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, math

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v46.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v47"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")
data=os.path.join(work,"data")
finance_dir=os.path.join(data,"finance")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

# We'll create a new page: Surplus Allocation Projection

script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const bandEl = document.getElementById('band');
  const yearsEl = document.getElementById('years');
  const summary = document.getElementById('summary');
  const table = document.getElementById('table');

  const fiscal = await (await fetch('/data/finance/fiscal_and_debt_model_scaffold.json')).json();
  const li = await (await fetch('/data/finance/budget_line_items_scaffold.json')).json();

  function fmtB(n){
    const x = Number(n);
    const sign = x < 0 ? '-' : '';
    const a = Math.abs(x);
    return sign + '$' + (a/1e9).toFixed(0) + 'B';
  }
  function fmtT(n){
    const x = Number(n);
    const sign = x < 0 ? '-' : '';
    const a = Math.abs(x);
    return sign + '$' + (a/1e12).toFixed(2) + 'T';
  }
  function pct(x){ return (x*100).toFixed(1) + '%'; }

  const sp = fiscal.starting_point_placeholders || {};
  const gdp0 = sp.nominal_gdp_usd_saar_q3_2025 || 27_000_000_000_000;
  const debt0 = sp.gross_federal_debt_usd_sep30_2025 || 27_000_000_000_000;

  function rampFactor(item, y){
    const r = item.ramp || {};
    if(r.kind === 'linear'){
      const s = r.start_year || 1;
      const e = r.end_year || s;
      if(y <= s) return 0;
      if(y >= e) return 1;
      return (y - s) / (e - s);
    }
    if(r.kind === 's_curve'){
      const m = r.midpoint_year || 8;
      const k = r.steepness || 0.6;
      return 1/(1+Math.exp(-k*(y-m)));
    }
    if(r.kind === 'front_load'){
      const years = (r.years || []);
      if(years.length === 0) return 0;
      const maxY = Math.max(...years);
      if(y <= 1) return 0;
      if(y >= maxY) return 1;
      return Math.min(1, y / maxY);
    }
    return 1;
  }

  function lineItemEffect(band, year){
    let sum = 0;
    for(const item of li.wmr.items){
      const steady = item.annual_steady_state_usd[band];
      const f = rampFactor(item, year);
      sum += steady * f;
    }
    return sum; // positive improves primary balance
  }

  function simulateAlloc(band, years){
    const shares = (fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework && fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework.default_shares)
      ? fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework.default_shares[band]
      : (li.wmr.surplus_allocation_defaults ? li.wmr.surplus_allocation_defaults[band] : {debt_paydown:0.6,peoples_wealth_fund:0.25,reinvestment:0.15});

    const r_sq = sp.interest_rate_effective[band];
    const r_w = Math.max(0, r_sq - fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.interest_rate_risk_premium_reduction[band]);

    const sq_real = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.real_gdp_growth[band];
    const sq_inf = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.inflation[band];
    const w_uplift = fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.net_growth_uplift_from_infrastructure[band];
    const w_real = sq_real + w_uplift;
    const w_inf = sq_inf;

    const prim0 = sp.primary_deficit_status_quo_usd[band];

    let debt = debt0;
    let gdp = gdp0;
    let pwf = 0; // people's wealth fund cumulative (not invested modeling yet)
    const rows = [];

    for(let t=1;t<=years;t++){
      const interest = debt * r_w;
      const improvement = lineItemEffect(band, t);
      const prim = prim0 * (1 + 0.01*(t-1)) - improvement; // deficit positive, surplus negative
      let surplus = 0;
      let pay=0,pwfAdd=0,reinv=0;

      if(prim < 0){
        surplus = -prim;
        pay = surplus * shares.debt_paydown;
        pwfAdd = surplus * shares.peoples_wealth_fund;
        reinv = surplus * shares.reinvestment;

        debt = debt - pay; // apply paydown BEFORE adding interest & other flow? We'll apply after interest for simplicity:
        // We'll apply paydown after debt update below; here we store pay.
      }

      // Update debt with primary + interest then subtract paydown (if any)
      debt = debt + prim + interest;
      if(pay>0) debt = debt - pay;

      // Update GDP
      gdp = gdp * (1 + w_real + w_inf);

      // PWF accumulation
      pwf += pwfAdd;

      rows.push({
        year:t,
        primary_balance:-prim, // positive means surplus; negative means deficit
        surplus:surplus,
        debt_paydown:pay,
        pwf_add:pwfAdd,
        reinvest:reinv,
        debt:debt,
        debt_to_gdp:debt/gdp,
        pwf_total:pwf
      });
    }
    return {shares, rows};
  }

  function render(){
    const band = bandEl.value;
    const N = Number(yearsEl.value);
    const sim = simulateAlloc(band, N);
    const rows = sim.rows;
    const shares = sim.shares;

    // Find first surplus year
    const first = rows.find(r => r.surplus > 0);
    const last = rows[rows.length-1];

    summary.innerHTML =
      `<b>Allocation shares (band: ${band})</b><br>`
      + `Debt paydown: <b>${(shares.debt_paydown*100).toFixed(0)}%</b> • `
      + `People’s Wealth Fund: <b>${(shares.peoples_wealth_fund*100).toFixed(0)}%</b> • `
      + `Reinvestment: <b>${(shares.reinvestment*100).toFixed(0)}%</b><br>`
      + (first ? `First surplus year: <b>${first.year}</b> (surplus ${fmtB(first.surplus)})<br>` : `First surplus year: <b>not reached</b> in ${N} years<br>`)
      + `End of window (year ${N}): debt/GDP <b>${pct(last.debt_to_gdp)}</b> • People’s Wealth Fund total <b>${fmtT(last.pwf_total)}</b>`;

    let html = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Year</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Primary balance</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Surplus</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Debt paydown</th>'

})();
</script>
"""

import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, math

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v47.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v48"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")
data=os.path.join(work,"data")
finance_dir=os.path.join(data,"finance")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const bandEl = document.getElementById('band');
  const incomeEl = document.getElementById('income');
  const incomeVal = document.getElementById('incomeVal');
  const hhEl = document.getElementById('hh');
  const locEl = document.getElementById('loc');
  const housingEl = document.getElementById('housing');
  const sdebtEl = document.getElementById('sdebt');
  const mdebtEl = document.getElementById('mdebt');
  const results = document.getElementById('results');

  const j = await (await fetch('/data/finance/household_translation_scaffold.json')).json();

  function fmt(n){
    const x = Math.round(Number(n));
    return '$' + x.toLocaleString();
  }

  function rampFactor(ramp, y){
    if(!ramp) return 1;
    if(ramp.kind === 's_curve'){
      const m = ramp.midpoint_year || 10;
      const k = ramp.steepness || 0.5;
      return 1/(1+Math.exp(-k*(y-m)));
    }
    return 1;
  }

  function studentDebtScale(level){
    if(level==='none') return 0;
    if(level==='some') return 1;
    return 2.0;
  }
  function medicalDebtScale(level){
    if(level==='none') return 0;
    if(level==='some') return 1;
    return 2.0;
  }
  function locationScale(loc){
    if(loc==='urban') return {transport:0.7, broadband:1.0, housing:1.2};
    if(loc==='suburban') return {transport:1.0, broadband:1.0, housing:1.0};
    return {transport:1.3, broadband:1.0, housing:0.9}; // rural
  }

  function compute(){
    const band = bandEl.value;
    const income = Number(incomeEl.value);
    const hh = Number(hhEl.value);
    const loc = locEl.value;
    const housing = housingEl.value;
    const sd = sdebtEl.value;
    const md = mdebtEl.value;

    incomeVal.textContent = '$' + income.toLocaleString();

    const scale = locationScale(loc);

    // Status quo annual burdens (scaled)
    const sq = j.status_quo.annual_burdens_usd;
    const sqGrowth = j.status_quo.growth_rates_annual[band];

    // WMR relief
    const w = j.wmr.annual_relief_usd;
    const div = j.wmr.people_dividend_usd;
    const tax = j.wmr.transition_taxes_net_usd;

    // Convert baseline components
    function annualSQ(year){
      const g = Math.pow(1+sqGrowth, year-1);
      const hc = sq.healthcare_premiums_out_of_pocket[band] * g;
      const sl = sq.student_loan_payments[band] * studentDebtScale(sd) * g;
      const mdp = sq.medical_debt_payments[band] * medicalDebtScale(md) * g;
      const hpress = sq.housing_cost_pressure[band] * (housing==='renter' ? 1.0 : 0.6) * scale.housing * g;
      const tpress = sq.transport_cost_pressure[band] * scale.transport * g;
      const bb = sq.broadband_cost[band] * scale.broadband * g;
      return hc + sl + mdp + hpress + tpress + bb;
    }

    function annualWMR(year){
      // Relief: assume ramps: healthcare and education relief phase in over 3 years; dividend ramps over time
      const hcRel = w.healthcare_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/3);
      const eduRel = w.education_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/3) * studentDebtScale(sd);
      const medRel = w.medical_debt_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/2) * medicalDebtScale(md);
      const bbRel = w.broadband_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/4) * scale.broadband;
      const trRel = w.transport_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/6) * scale.transport;
      const hoRel = w.housing_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/6) * (housing==='renter' ? 1.0 : 0.6) * scale.housing;

      const dividend = div.steady_state[band] * rampFactor(div.ramp, year) * (0.6 + 0.2*Math.min(2,hh)); // household size modifier

      // Tax change: mild income effect (progressive in placeholder)
      const taxBase = tax[band][band]; // pick diagonal default; placeholder
      const taxAdj = (income > 120000 ? (taxBase*0.5) : (income < 50000 ? (taxBase*1.2) : taxBase));

      // Net: status quo burden minus relief minus dividend plus tax adjustment
      return annualSQ(year) - (hcRel + eduRel + medRel + bbRel + trRel + hoRel) - dividend + taxAdj;
    }

    const horizons = j.meta.horizons;
    const rows = horizons.map(H => {
      let cumSQ=0, cumW=0;
      for(let y=1;y<=H;y++){
        cumSQ += annualSQ(y);
        cumW += annualWMR(y);
      }
      return {H, cumSQ, cumW, delta: cumW - cumSQ};
    });

    // render table
    let html = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Horizon</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Status quo (cumulative burden)</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR (cumulative burden)</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ (WMR − SQ)</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for(const r of rows){
      html += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${r.H}y</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.cumSQ)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.cumW)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmt(r.delta)}</b></td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';

    // Quick headline
    const r10 = rows.find(x=>x.H===10);
    const r50 = rows.find(x=>x.H===50);
    html = `<div class="callout"><b>Headline (placeholder)</b><br>`
      + `10y Δ: <b>${fmt(r10.delta)}</b> • 50y Δ: <b>${fmt(r50.delta)}</b>`
      + `</div>` + html;

    results.innerHTML = html;
  }

  [bandEl,incomeEl,hhEl,locEl,housingEl,sdebtEl,mdebtEl].forEach(el=>{
    el.addEventListener(el===incomeEl?'input':'change', compute);
  });
  compute();
})();
</script>
"""
make_page("household-impact.html","Household Impact Simulator",
          "Home / Impact Lab / Household impact","household-impact", cards, extra_scripts=script)

)

script2 = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const bandEl = document.getElementById('band');
  const yearsEl = document.getElementById('years');
  const summary = document.getElementById('summary');
  const table = document.getElementById('table');

  const fiscal = await (await fetch('/data/finance/fiscal_and_debt_model_scaffold.json')).json();
  const li = await (await fetch('/data/finance/budget_line_items_scaffold.json')).json();

  function fmtB(n){
    const x = Number(n);
    const sign = x < 0 ? '-' : '';
    const a = Math.abs(x);
    return sign + '$' + (a/1e9).toFixed(0) + 'B';
  }
  function fmtT(n){
    const x = Number(n);
    const sign = x < 0 ? '-' : '';
    const a = Math.abs(x);
    return sign + '$' + (a/1e12).toFixed(2) + 'T';
  }
  function pct(x){ return (x*100).toFixed(1) + '%'; }

  const sp = fiscal.starting_point_placeholders || {};
  const gdp0 = sp.nominal_gdp_usd_saar_q3_2025 || 27_000_000_000_000;
  const debt0 = sp.gross_federal_debt_usd_sep30_2025 || 27_000_000_000_000;

  function rampFactor(item, y){
    const r = item.ramp || {};
    if(r.kind === 'linear'){
      const s = r.start_year || 1;
      const e = r.end_year || s;
      if(y <= s) return 0;
      if(y >= e) return 1;
      return (y - s) / (e - s);
    }
    if(r.kind === 's_curve'){
      const m = r.midpoint_year || 8;
      const k = r.steepness || 0.6;
      return 1/(1+Math.exp(-k*(y-m)));
    }
    if(r.kind === 'front_load'){
      const years = (r.years || []);
      if(years.length === 0) return 0;
      const maxY = Math.max(...years);
      if(y <= 1) return 0;
      if(y >= maxY) return 1;
      return Math.min(1, y / maxY);
    }
    return 1;
  }

  function lineItemEffect(band, year){
    let sum = 0;
    for(const item of li.wmr.items){
      const steady = item.annual_steady_state_usd[band];
      const f = rampFactor(item, year);
      sum += steady * f;
    }
    return sum;
  }

  function simulateBoth(band, years){
    const shares = (fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework && fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework.default_shares)
      ? fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework.default_shares[band]
      : (li.wmr.surplus_allocation_defaults ? li.wmr.surplus_allocation_defaults[band] : {debt_paydown:0.6,peoples_wealth_fund:0.25,reinvestment:0.15});

    const r = sp.interest_rate_effective[band];
    const r_w = Math.max(0, r - fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.interest_rate_risk_premium_reduction[band]);

    const sq_real = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.real_gdp_growth[band];
    const sq_inf = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.inflation[band];
    const w_uplift = fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.net_growth_uplift_from_infrastructure[band];
    const w_real = sq_real + w_uplift;
    const w_inf = sq_inf;

    const prim0 = sp.primary_deficit_status_quo_usd[band];

    let debtW = debt0, gdpW = gdp0, pwf=0;
    let debtSQ = debt0, gdpSQ = gdp0;

    const rows=[];
    for(let t=1;t<=years;t++){
      // Status quo
      const interestSQ = debtSQ * r;
      const primSQ = prim0 * (1 + 0.02*(t-1));
      debtSQ = debtSQ + primSQ + interestSQ;
      gdpSQ = gdpSQ * (1 + sq_real + sq_inf);

      // WMR
      const interestW = debtW * r_w;
      const improvement = lineItemEffect(band, t);
      const primW = prim0 * (1 + 0.01*(t-1)) - improvement;
      let surplus=0, pay=0, pwfAdd=0, reinv=0;

      if(primW < 0){
        surplus = -primW;
        pay = surplus * shares.debt_paydown;
        pwfAdd = surplus * shares.peoples_wealth_fund;
        reinv = surplus * shares.reinvestment;
      }

      debtW = debtW + primW + interestW;
      if(pay>0) debtW = debtW - pay;
      gdpW = gdpW * (1 + w_real + w_inf);
      pwf += pwfAdd;

      rows.push({
        year:t,
        surplus:surplus,
        debtPay:pay,
        pwfAdd:pwfAdd,
        reinv:reinv,
        debtToGdpW:debtW/gdpW,
        debtToGdpSQ:debtSQ/gdpSQ,
        deltaDebtToGdp:(debtW/gdpW) - (debtSQ/gdpSQ),
        pwfTotal:pwf
      });
    }
    return {shares, rows};
  }

  function render(){
    const band = bandEl.value;
    const N = Number(yearsEl.value);
    const sim = simulateBoth(band, N);
    const rows = sim.rows;
    const shares = sim.shares;

    const first = rows.find(r=>r.surplus>0);
    const last = rows[rows.length-1];

    summary.innerHTML =
      `<b>Shares</b> (band: ${band}) — `
      + `Debt paydown ${(shares.debt_paydown*100).toFixed(0)}% • `
      + `PWF ${(shares.peoples_wealth_fund*100).toFixed(0)}% • `
      + `Reinvest ${(shares.reinvestment*100).toFixed(0)}%<br>`
      + (first ? `First surplus year: <b>${first.year}</b> (${fmtB(first.surplus)}) • ` : `First surplus: <b>not reached</b> • `)
      + `Year ${N}: SQ debt/GDP <b>${pct(last.debtToGdpSQ)}</b> • WMR debt/GDP <b>${pct(last.debtToGdpW)}</b> • Δ <b>${pct(last.deltaDebtToGdp)}</b><br>`
      + `People’s Wealth Fund (cumulative, placeholder): <b>${fmtT(last.pwfTotal)}</b>`;

    let html = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Year</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Surplus</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Debt paydown</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">PWF add</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Reinvest</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">SQ debt/GDP</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR debt/GDP</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for(const r of rows){
      html += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${r.year}</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtB(r.surplus)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtB(r.debtPay)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtB(r.pwfAdd)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmtB(r.reinv)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${pct(r.debtToGdpSQ)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${pct(r.debtToGdpW)}</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${pct(r.deltaDebtToGdp)}</b></td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';
    table.innerHTML = html;
  }

  bandEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  yearsEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  render();
})();
</script>
"""
make_page("surplus-projection.html","Surplus Allocation Projection",
          "Home / Impact Lab / Fiscal model / Surplus projection","surplus-projection", cards2, extra_scripts=script2)

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

# Update household translation scaffold: dividend now derived from PWF model
house_path=os.path.join(finance_dir,"household_translation_scaffold.json")
house=json.loads(read(house_path))

house["meta"]["version"]="0.2-dividend-from-pwf"
house["wmr"]["people_dividend_usd"] = {
    "notes":[
        "Dividend is computed from the People’s Wealth Fund (PWF) accumulation in the fiscal model.",
        "Annual dividend = payout_rate * PWF_total / estimated_households, with a phase-in ramp.",
        "This avoids a stand-alone dividend assumption and ties household outcomes to the macro model."
    ],
    "payout_rate_annual":{"low":0.025,"base":0.03,"high":0.035},
    "estimated_households":{"notes":"Placeholder count of US households. Replace with Census estimate.",
                            "value":128_000_000},
