              '</body>', html)  # remove scripts before body close (we'll append)
# Create new script
script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const bandEl = document.getElementById('band');
  const incomeEl = document.getElementById('income');
  const incomeVal = document.getElementById('incomeVal');
  const hhEl = document.getElementById('hh');
  const locEl = document.getElementById('loc');
  const housingEl = document.getElementById('housing');
  const sdebtEl = document.getElementById('sdebt');
  const mdebtEl = document.getElementById('mdebt');
  const results = document.getElementById('results');

  const j = await (await fetch('/data/finance/household_translation_scaffold.json')).json();
  const fiscal = await (await fetch('/data/finance/fiscal_and_debt_model_scaffold.json')).json();
  const li = await (await fetch('/data/finance/budget_line_items_scaffold.json')).json();

  function fmt(n){
    const x = Math.round(Number(n));
    return '$' + x.toLocaleString();
  }
  function fmtB(n){
    const x = Number(n);
    const sign = x < 0 ? '-' : '';
    const a = Math.abs(x);
    return sign + '$' + (a/1e9).toFixed(0) + 'B';
  }

  function rampFactor(ramp, y){
    if(!ramp) return 1;
    if(ramp.kind === 's_curve'){
      const m = ramp.midpoint_year || 10;
      const k = ramp.steepness || 0.5;
      return 1/(1+Math.exp(-k*(y-m)));
    }
    return 1;
  }

  function rampFactorItem(item, y){
    const r = item.ramp || {};
    if(r.kind === 'linear'){
      const s = r.start_year || 1;
      const e = r.end_year || s;
      if(y <= s) return 0;
      if(y >= e) return 1;
      return (y - s) / (e - s);
    }
    if(r.kind === 's_curve'){
      const m = r.midpoint_year || 8;
      const k = r.steepness || 0.6;
      return 1/(1+Math.exp(-k*(y-m)));
    }
    if(r.kind === 'front_load'){
      const years = (r.years || []);
      if(years.length === 0) return 0;
      const maxY = Math.max(...years);
      if(y <= 1) return 0;
      if(y >= maxY) return 1;
      return Math.min(1, y / maxY);
    }
    return 1;
  }

  function lineItemEffect(band, year){
    let sum = 0;
    for(const item of li.wmr.items){
      const steady = item.annual_steady_state_usd[band];
      const f = rampFactorItem(item, year);
      sum += steady * f;
    }
    return sum;
  }

  function studentDebtScale(level){
    if(level==='none') return 0;
    if(level==='some') return 1;
    return 2.0;
  }
  function medicalDebtScale(level){
    if(level==='none') return 0;
    if(level==='some') return 1;
    return 2.0;
  }
  function locationScale(loc){
    if(loc==='urban') return {transport:0.7, broadband:1.0, housing:1.2};
    if(loc==='suburban') return {transport:1.0, broadband:1.0, housing:1.0};
    return {transport:1.3, broadband:1.0, housing:0.9}; // rural
  }

  // Compute PWF total each year from fiscal + line items (same logic as surplus projection)
  function pwfTotalsByYear(band, years){
    const sp = fiscal.starting_point_placeholders || {};
    const gdp0 = sp.nominal_gdp_usd_saar_q3_2025 || 27_000_000_000_000;
    const debt0 = sp.gross_federal_debt_usd_sep30_2025 || 27_000_000_000_000;

    const shares = (fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework && fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework.default_shares)
      ? fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework.default_shares[band]
      : (li.wmr.surplus_allocation_defaults ? li.wmr.surplus_allocation_defaults[band] : {debt_paydown:0.6,peoples_wealth_fund:0.25,reinvestment:0.15});

    const r = sp.interest_rate_effective[band];
    const r_w = Math.max(0, r - fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.interest_rate_risk_premium_reduction[band]);

    const sq_real = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.real_gdp_growth[band];
    const sq_inf = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.inflation[band];
    const w_uplift = fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.net_growth_uplift_from_infrastructure[band];
    const w_real = sq_real + w_uplift;
    const w_inf = sq_inf;

    const prim0 = sp.primary_deficit_status_quo_usd[band];

    let debt = debt0;
    let gdp = gdp0;
    let pwf = 0;
    const out = [];
    for(let t=1;t<=years;t++){
      const interest = debt * r_w;
      const improvement = lineItemEffect(band, t);
      const prim = prim0 * (1 + 0.01*(t-1)) - improvement; // deficit positive, surplus negative
      let surplus=0, pay=0, pwfAdd=0;
      if(prim < 0){
        surplus = -prim;
        pay = surplus * shares.debt_paydown;
        pwfAdd = surplus * shares.peoples_wealth_fund;
      }
      debt = debt + prim + interest;
      if(pay>0) debt = debt - pay;
      gdp = gdp * (1 + w_real + w_inf);
      pwf += pwfAdd;
      out.push({year:t, pwf_total:pwf});
    }
    return out;
  }

  function compute(){
    const band = bandEl.value;
    const income = Number(incomeEl.value);
    const hh = Number(hhEl.value);
    const loc = locEl.value;
    const housing = housingEl.value;
    const sd = sdebtEl.value;
    const md = mdebtEl.value;

    incomeVal.textContent = '$' + income.toLocaleString();

    const scale = locationScale(loc);

    // Status quo annual burdens (scaled)
    const sq = j.status_quo.annual_burdens_usd;
    const sqGrowth = j.status_quo.growth_rates_annual[band];

    // WMR relief
    const w = j.wmr.annual_relief_usd;

    // Dividend from PWF
    const div = j.wmr.people_dividend_usd;
    const payoutRate = div.payout_rate_annual[band];
    const households = div.estimated_households.value;
    const divRamp = div.phase_in_ramp;
    const divCap = div.cap_per_household_usd[band];

    // Net tax change
    const tax = j.wmr.transition_taxes_net_usd;
    const taxBase = tax[band][band]; // placeholder diagonal

    // Precompute PWF totals for 50y for this band
    const pwfSeries = pwfTotalsByYear(band, 50);

    function annualSQ(year){
      const g = Math.pow(1+sqGrowth, year-1);
      const hc = sq.healthcare_premiums_out_of_pocket[band] * g;
      const sl = sq.student_loan_payments[band] * studentDebtScale(sd) * g;
      const mdp = sq.medical_debt_payments[band] * medicalDebtScale(md) * g;
      const hpress = sq.housing_cost_pressure[band] * (housing==='renter' ? 1.0 : 0.6) * scale.housing * g;
      const tpress = sq.transport_cost_pressure[band] * scale.transport * g;
      const bb = sq.broadband_cost[band] * scale.broadband * g;
      return hc + sl + mdp + hpress + tpress + bb;
    }

    function annualDividend(year){
      const pwfTotal = pwfSeries[year-1].pwf_total;
      const raw = (payoutRate * pwfTotal) / households;
      const phased = raw * rampFactor(divRamp, year);
      const capped = Math.min(phased, divCap);
      // household-size modifier: acknowledges per-capita vs per-household; placeholder
      const hhMod = (0.75 + 0.1*Math.min(4, hh));
      return capped * hhMod;
    }

    function annualWMR(year){
      const hcRel = w.healthcare_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/3);
      const eduRel = w.education_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/3) * studentDebtScale(sd);
      const medRel = w.medical_debt_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/2) * medicalDebtScale(md);
      const bbRel = w.broadband_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/4) * scale.broadband;
      const trRel = w.transport_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/6) * scale.transport;
      const hoRel = w.housing_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/6) * (housing==='renter' ? 1.0 : 0.6) * scale.housing;

      const dividend = annualDividend(year);

      const taxAdj = (income > 120000 ? (taxBase*0.5) : (income < 50000 ? (taxBase*1.2) : taxBase));

      return annualSQ(year) - (hcRel + eduRel + medRel + bbRel + trRel + hoRel) - dividend + taxAdj;
    }

    const horizons = j.meta.horizons;
    const rows = horizons.map(H => {
      let cumSQ=0, cumW=0, cumDiv=0;
      for(let y=1;y<=H;y++){
        cumSQ += annualSQ(y);
        cumW += annualWMR(y);
        cumDiv += annualDividend(y);
      }
      return {H, cumSQ, cumW, delta: cumW - cumSQ, cumDiv};
    });

    const r10 = rows.find(x=>x.H===10);
    const r50 = rows.find(x=>x.H===50);

    let html = `<div class="callout"><b>Headline (placeholder)</b><br>`
      + `10y Δ: <b>${fmt(r10.delta)}</b> • 50y Δ: <b>${fmt(r50.delta)}</b><br>`
      + `<span class="muted">Dividend now derives from the People’s Wealth Fund projection (macro model), not a stand-alone assumption.</span>`
      + `</div>`;

    html += '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Horizon</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Status quo (cumulative burden)</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR (cumulative burden)</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Dividend received (cum.)</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ (WMR − SQ)</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for(const r of rows){
      html += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${r.H}y</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.cumSQ)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.cumW)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.cumDiv)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmt(r.delta)}</b></td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';

    html += `<div class="note" style="margin-top:10px;">
      <b>How dividend is computed (placeholder):</b><br>
      Dividend<sub>year</sub> = payout_rate × PWF_total<sub>year</sub> ÷ households × phase-in × (household-size modifier), with a cap.<br>
      See <a href="/pages/surplus-projection.html"><b>Surplus Allocation Projection</b></a> for the PWF accumulation.
    </div>`;

    results.innerHTML = html;
  }

  [bandEl,incomeEl,hhEl,locEl,housingEl,sdebtEl,mdebtEl].forEach(el=>{
    el.addEventListener(el===incomeEl?'input':'change', compute);
  });
  compute();
})();
</script>
"""

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")
data=os.path.join(work,"data")

qol_dir=os.path.join(data,"qol")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const bandEl = document.getElementById('band');
  const hEl = document.getElementById('H');
  const presetEl = document.getElementById('preset');
  const headline = document.getElementById('qolHeadline');
  const table = document.getElementById('qolTable');

  const qol = await (await fetch('/data/qol/quality_of_life_index_scaffold.json')).json();
  const hh = await (await fetch('/data/finance/household_translation_scaffold.json')).json();
  const fiscal = await (await fetch('/data/finance/fiscal_and_debt_model_scaffold.json')).json();
  const li = await (await fetch('/data/finance/budget_line_items_scaffold.json')).json();

  function pct(x){ return (x*100).toFixed(0) + '%'; }

  function rampFactorItem(item, y){
    const r = item.ramp || {};
    if(r.kind === 'linear'){
      const s = r.start_year || 1;
      const e = r.end_year || s;
      if(y <= s) return 0;
      if(y >= e) return 1;
      return (y - s) / (e - s);
    }
    if(r.kind === 's_curve'){
      const m = r.midpoint_year || 8;
      const k = r.steepness || 0.6;
      return 1/(1+Math.exp(-k*(y-m)));
    }
    if(r.kind === 'front_load'){
      const years = (r.years || []);
      if(years.length === 0) return 0;
      const maxY = Math.max(...years);
      if(y <= 1) return 0;
      if(y >= maxY) return 1;
      return Math.min(1, y / maxY);
    }
    return 1;
  }
  function lineItemEffect(band, year){
    let sum = 0;
    for(const item of li.wmr.items){
      const steady = item.annual_steady_state_usd[band];
      sum += steady * rampFactorItem(item, year);
    }
    return sum;
  }

  function presetConfig(p){
    // Keep aligned with household-impact scaffolding defaults.
    if(p==='urban_single') return {income:52000, hh:1, loc:'urban', housing:'renter', sdebt:'some', mdebt:'some'};
    if(p==='suburban_owner') return {income:98000, hh:4, loc:'suburban', housing:'owner', sdebt:'some', mdebt:'none'};
    if(p==='elder_fixed') return {income:42000, hh:2, loc:'rural', housing:'owner', sdebt:'none', mdebt:'heavy'};
    return {income:65000, hh:3, loc:'rural', housing:'renter', sdebt:'some', mdebt:'some'};
  }

  function studentDebtScale(level){ if(level==='none') return 0; if(level==='some') return 1; return 2.0; }
  function medicalDebtScale(level){ if(level==='none') return 0; if(level==='some') return 1; return 2.0; }
  function locationScale(loc){
    if(loc==='urban') return {transport:0.7, broadband:1.0, housing:1.2};
    if(loc==='suburban') return {transport:1.0, broadband:1.0, housing:1.0};
    return {transport:1.3, broadband:1.0, housing:0.9};
  }

  function rampFactor(ramp, y){
    if(!ramp) return 1;
    if(ramp.kind === 's_curve'){
      const m = ramp.midpoint_year || 10;
      const k = ramp.steepness || 0.5;
      return 1/(1+Math.exp(-k*(y-m)));
    }
    return 1;
  }

  // Compute household cumulative burdens for SQ and WMR at horizon H (based on same logic as household-impact, simplified)
  function householdBurden(band, H, conf){
    const scale = locationScale(conf.loc);
    const sq = hh.status_quo.annual_burdens_usd;
    const sqGrowth = hh.status_quo.growth_rates_annual[band];
    const w = hh.wmr.annual_relief_usd;

    // Dividend derived from PWF (reuse approach from household-impact)
    const div = hh.wmr.people_dividend_usd;
    const payoutRate = div.payout_rate_annual[band];
    const households = div.estimated_households.value;
    const divRamp = div.phase_in_ramp;
    const divCap = div.cap_per_household_usd[band];

    const tax = hh.wmr.transition_taxes_net_usd;
    const taxBase = tax[band][band];
    const income = conf.income;
    const hhSize = conf.hh;
    const sd = conf.sdebt;
    const md = conf.mdebt;
    const housing = conf.housing;

    const sp = fiscal.starting_point_placeholders || {};
    const debt0 = sp.gross_federal_debt_usd_sep30_2025 || 27_000_000_000_000;
    const gdp0 = sp.nominal_gdp_usd_saar_q3_2025 || 27_000_000_000_000;
    const shares = (fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework && fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework.default_shares)
      ? fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework.default_shares[band]
      : (li.wmr.surplus_allocation_defaults ? li.wmr.surplus_allocation_defaults[band] : {debt_paydown:0.6,peoples_wealth_fund:0.25,reinvestment:0.15});
    const r = sp.interest_rate_effective[band];
    const r_w = Math.max(0, r - fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.interest_rate_risk_premium_reduction[band]);
    const sq_real = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.real_gdp_growth[band];
    const sq_inf = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.inflation[band];
    const w_uplift = fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.net_growth_uplift_from_infrastructure[band];
    const w_real = sq_real + w_uplift;
    const w_inf = sq_inf;
    const prim0 = sp.primary_deficit_status_quo_usd[band];

    // Build PWF series up to H (simplified)
    let debt = debt0, gdp = gdp0, pwf=0;
    const pwfSeries=[0];
    for(let t=1;t<=H;t++){
      const interest = debt * r_w;
      const improvement = lineItemEffect(band, t);
      const prim = prim0 * (1 + 0.01*(t-1)) - improvement;
      let pay=0, pwfAdd=0;
      if(prim < 0){
        const surplus = -prim;
        pay = surplus * shares.debt_paydown;
        pwfAdd = surplus * shares.peoples_wealth_fund;
      }
      debt = debt + prim + interest;
      if(pay>0) debt -= pay;
      gdp = gdp * (1 + w_real + w_inf);
      pwf += pwfAdd;
      pwfSeries.push(pwf);
    }

    function annualSQ(y){
      const g = Math.pow(1+sqGrowth, y-1);
      const hc = sq.healthcare_premiums_out_of_pocket[band] * g;
      const sl = sq.student_loan_payments[band] * studentDebtScale(sd) * g;
      const mdp = sq.medical_debt_payments[band] * medicalDebtScale(md) * g;
      const hpress = sq.housing_cost_pressure[band] * (housing==='renter' ? 1.0 : 0.6) * scale.housing * g;
      const tpress = sq.transport_cost_pressure[band] * scale.transport * g;
      const bb = sq.broadband_cost[band] * scale.broadband * g;
      return hc + sl + mdp + hpress + tpress + bb;
    }
    function annualDividend(y){
      const pwfTot = pwfSeries[y] || pwfSeries[pwfSeries.length-1];
      const raw = (payoutRate * pwfTot) / households;
      const phased = raw * rampFactor(divRamp, y);
      const capped = Math.min(phased, divCap);
      const hhMod = (0.75 + 0.1*Math.min(4, hhSize));
      return capped * hhMod;
    }
    function annualWMR(y){
      const hcRel = w.healthcare_relief[band] * Math.min(1, y/3);
      const eduRel = w.education_relief[band] * Math.min(1, y/3) * studentDebtScale(sd);
      const medRel = w.medical_debt_relief[band] * Math.min(1, y/2) * medicalDebtScale(md);
      const bbRel = w.broadband_relief[band] * Math.min(1, y/4) * scale.broadband;
      const trRel = w.transport_relief[band] * Math.min(1, y/6) * scale.transport;
      const hoRel = w.housing_relief[band] * Math.min(1, y/6) * (housing==='renter' ? 1.0 : 0.6) * scale.housing;
      const dividend = annualDividend(y);
      const taxAdj = (income > 120000 ? (taxBase*0.5) : (income < 50000 ? (taxBase*1.2) : taxBase));
      return annualSQ(y) - (hcRel + eduRel + medRel + bbRel + trRel + hoRel) - dividend + taxAdj;
    }

    let cumSQ=0, cumW=0;
    for(let y=1;y<=H;y++){
      cumSQ += annualSQ(y);
      cumW += annualWMR(y);
    }
    return {cumSQ, cumW};
  }

  // Normalize between SQ and WMR such that SQ=0 and WMR=100 if WMR is better, else reversed.
  function normScore(sqVal, wmrVal, higherIsBetter){
    // For burdens, lower is better.
    let a = sqVal, b = wmrVal;
    if(!higherIsBetter){
      // invert: better means lower
      a = -sqVal;
      b = -wmrVal;
    }
    if(a===b) return {sq:50, wmr:50};
    // set SQ to 0, WMR to 100 in direction of improvement
    const wBetter = b > a;
    return wBetter ? {sq:0, wmr:100} : {sq:100, wmr:0};
  }

  function render(){
    const band = bandEl.value;
    const H = Number(hEl.value);
    const conf = presetConfig(presetEl.value);

    // Dimension proxy computations (simple scaffolds)
    const hb = householdBurden(band, H, conf);
    const econScores = normScore(hb.cumSQ, hb.cumW, false);

    // Placeholder proxy scores for other dimensions derived from related relief intensity + horizon
    const horizonFactor = Math.min(1, H/20);
    const healthScores = {sq: 40 + 10*horizonFactor, wmr: 60 + 20*horizonFactor}; // placeholder
    const housingScores = {sq: 45 + 10*horizonFactor, wmr: 60 + 15*horizonFactor}; // placeholder
    const mobilityScores = {sq: 45 + 10*horizonFactor, wmr: 62 + 12*horizonFactor}; // placeholder
    const eduScores = {sq: 50 + 8*horizonFactor, wmr: 70 + 12*horizonFactor}; // placeholder
    const civicScores = {sq: 45 + 6*horizonFactor, wmr: 65 + 10*horizonFactor}; // placeholder
    const futureScores = {sq: 42 + 8*horizonFactor, wmr: 66 + 14*horizonFactor}; // placeholder

    const map = {
      household_economic_burden: econScores,
      health_and_stress: healthScores,
      housing_security: housingScores,
      mobility_and_time: mobilityScores,
      education_opportunity: eduScores,
      civic_power_and_trust: civicScores,
      future_resilience: futureScores
    };

    // Composite index
    const dims = qol.dimensions;
    let sq=0, wmr=0, wsum=0;
    let rows='';
    for(const d of dims){
      const w = d.weight[band];
      wsum += w;
      const s = map[d.key];
      const sqPart = s.sq * w;
      const wPart = s.wmr * w;
      sq += sqPart;
      wmr += wPart;
      rows += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${d.name}</b><br><span class="muted">${d.proxy}</span></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${d.weight[band].toFixed(2)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${Math.round(s.sq)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${Math.round(s.wmr)}</b></td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }
    sq = sq/wsum;
    wmr = wmr/wsum;

    headline.innerHTML =
      `<b>QoL Index (scaffold)</b><br>`
      + `Band: <b>${band}</b> • Horizon: <b>${H} years</b> • Preset: <b>${presetEl.options[presetEl.selectedIndex].text}</b><br>`
      + `Status Quo: <b>${Math.round(sq)}</b> / 100 • WMR: <b>${Math.round(wmr)}</b> / 100 • Δ: <b>${Math.round(wmr - sq)}</b>`;

    table.innerHTML =
      '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Dimension</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Weight</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">SQ score</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR score</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>'
      + rows
      + '</tbody></table>'
      + `<div class="note" style="margin-top:10px;">
        <b>Economic burden proxy:</b> cumulative household burden (from simulator logic). SQ: ${Math.round(hb.cumSQ).toLocaleString()} • WMR: ${Math.round(hb.cumW).toLocaleString()} (lower is better).
        Other dimensions are placeholder score curves until sourced indicators are added.
      </div>`;
  }

  bandEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  hEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  presetEl.addEventListener('change', render);
  render();
})();
</script>
"""

What that means in practice
Cumulative zip = you can unzip it into an empty folder and it’s the whole site.

You can still treat them like “overlays” (unzip v1, then v2 over it, etc.), but you don’t need to — v50 alone is sufficient.

What I recommend going forward
Use both patterns:

Release snapshots (cumulative)

v51, v52, etc. remain full site snapshots.

This is safest and easiest to recover/rollback.

Overlay patch zips (optional)

Separate small zips that only include changed/new files (pages, data, functions).

work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v51"

    shutil.rmtree(work)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

data=os.path.join(work,"data")

qol_dir=os.path.join(data,"qol")
netlify_dir=os.path.join(work,"netlify","functions")
os.makedirs(netlify_dir, exist_ok=True)

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

# Ensure netlify.toml for functions + redirects
netlify_toml_path=os.path.join(work,"netlify.toml")
if os.path.exists(netlify_toml_path):
    toml=read(netlify_toml_path)
else:
    toml=""

if "[functions]" not in toml:
    toml += "\n[functions]\n  directory = \"netlify/functions\"\n"
if "[[redirects]]" not in toml or "from = \"/api/" not in toml:
    toml += """
[[redirects]]
  from = "/api/*"
  to = "/.netlify/functions/:splat"
  status = 200
"""
write(netlify_toml_path, toml.strip()+"\n")

# Add package.json only if needed (Netlify functions in JS don't need, but add engines)
pkg_path=os.path.join(work,"package.json")
if not os.path.exists(pkg_path):
    pkg={
        "name":"wmr-site",
        "private": True,
        "description":"Working Majority Republic static site + Netlify Functions",
        "version":"0.0.1",
        "engines":{"node":">=18"}
    }
    write(pkg_path, json.dumps(pkg, indent=2))

# Create functions: census.js, bls.js, health.js, sources.js
census_fn = r"""
/**
 * Netlify Function: /api/census
 * Secure proxy to the U.S. Census API (keeps your key server-side).
 *
 * Examples:
 *   /api/census?year=2023&dataset=acs/acs5&get=NAME,B19013_001E&for=us:1
 *   /api/census?year=2023&dataset=acs/acs5/subject&get=NAME,S2301_C04_001E&for=county:001&in=state:05
 *
 * Notes:
 * - This function passes most query params through to api.census.gov.
 * - Set environment variable: CENSUS_API_KEY
 */
const DEFAULT_BASE = "https://api.census.gov/data";

function allowlistDataset(ds) {
  // Keep this permissive but safe; user controls ds. Prevent protocol injection.
  return typeof ds === "string" && /^[a-z0-9/_-]+$/i.test(ds);
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  try {
    const q = event.queryStringParameters || {};
    const year = q.year || "2023";
    const dataset = q.dataset || "acs/acs5";
    const get = q.get || "NAME";
    const forParam = q["for"] || "us:1";
    const inParam = q["in"]; // optional
    const key = process.env.CENSUS_API_KEY || "";

    if (!allowlistDataset(dataset)) {
      return { statusCode: 400, headers: {"content-type":"application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify({error:"Invalid dataset"}) };
    }

    const url = new URL(`${DEFAULT_BASE}/${encodeURIComponent(year)}/${dataset}`);
    url.searchParams.set("get", get);
    url.searchParams.set("for", forParam);
    if (inParam) url.searchParams.set("in", inParam);
    if (key) url.searchParams.set("key", key);

    const resp = await fetch(url.toString(), { headers: { "accept": "application/json" }});
    const text = await resp.text();

    // Basic cache: 6 hours at edge/browser
    const headers = {
      "content-type": resp.headers.get("content-type") || "application/json",
      "cache-control": "public, max-age=21600"
    };

    return { statusCode: resp.status, headers, body: text };
  } catch (e) {
    return { statusCode: 500, headers: {"content-type":"application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify({error:String(e)}) };
  }
};
""".strip()

bls_fn = r"""
/**
 * Netlify Function: /api/bls
 * Secure proxy to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics API (keeps your key server-side).
 *
 * Request (POST recommended):
 *   POST /api/bls
 *   { "seriesid": ["CUUR0000SA0","LNS14000000"], "startyear":"2015", "endyear":"2025" }
 *
 * GET supported for simple usage:
 *   /api/bls?seriesid=CUUR0000SA0,LNS14000000&startyear=2015&endyear=2025
 *
 * Set environment variable: BLS_API_KEY
 */
const ENDPOINT = "https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/";

function parseBody(event) {
  try { return event.body ? JSON.parse(event.body) : null; } catch { return null; }
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  try {
    const key = process.env.BLS_API_KEY || "";
    let payload = parseBody(event);

    if (!payload) {
      const q = event.queryStringParameters || {};
      const seriesid = (q.seriesid || "").split(",").map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      payload = {
        seriesid: seriesid.length ? seriesid : ["CUUR0000SA0"],
        startyear: q.startyear || "2015",
        endyear: q.endyear || "2025"
      };
    }

    if (key) payload.registrationkey = key;

    const resp = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json", "accept":"application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    });

    const text = await resp.text();
    const headers = {
      "content-type": "application/json",
      "cache-control": "public, max-age=21600"
    };
    return { statusCode: resp.status, headers, body: text };
  } catch (e) {
    return { statusCode: 500, headers: {"content-type":"application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify({error:String(e)}) };
  }
};
""".strip()

health_fn = r"""
/**
 * Netlify Function: /api/health
 * Lightweight "is the backend alive" endpoint + lists configured env vars (redacted).
 * Useful for debugging on Netlify without exposing secrets.
 */
exports.handler = async () => {
  const hasCensus = !!process.env.CENSUS_API_KEY;
  const hasBls = !!process.env.BLS_API_KEY;
  return {
    statusCode: 200,
    headers: { "content-type":"application/json", "cache-control":"no-store" },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      ok: true,
      env: { CENSUS_API_KEY: hasCensus ? "set" : "missing", BLS_API_KEY: hasBls ? "set" : "missing" },
      time_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    })
  };
};
""".strip()

sources_fn = r"""
/**
 * Netlify Function: /api/sources
 * Returns a curated list of data pulls and intended source endpoints used by the site.
 * In V51 this is a static scaffold; later versions will persist pull logs.
 */
exports.handler = async () => {
  const sources = {
    census: {
      base: "https://api.census.gov/data",
      examples: [
        "/api/census?year=2023&dataset=acs/acs5&get=NAME,B19013_001E&for=us:1",
        "/api/census?year=2023&dataset=acs/acs5&get=NAME,B19013_001E&for=state:05"
      ]
    },
    bls: {
      endpoint: "https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/",
      examples: [
        { seriesid:["CUUR0000SA0"], startyear:"2015", endyear:"2025" }
      ]
    }
  };
  return {
    statusCode: 200,
    headers: { "content-type":"application/json", "cache-control":"public, max-age=86400" },
    body: JSON.stringify(sources)
  };
};
""".strip()

write(os.path.join(netlify_dir,"census.js"), census_fn)

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

script = """
<script>
function money(x){
  const n = Number(x);
  if(!isFinite(n)) return String(x);
  return '$' + Math.round(n).toLocaleString();
}
function pct(x){
  const n = Number(x);
  if(!isFinite(n)) return String(x);
  return (n*100).toFixed(2) + '%';
}

async function pullACS(){
  const geo = document.getElementById('geo').value;
  const year = document.getElementById('acsYear').value;
  const out = document.getElementById('acsOut');
  try{
    const geoMap = {
      us: { for: "us:1" },
      arkansas: { for: "state:05" }
    };
    const url = `/api/census?year=${encodeURIComponent(year)}&dataset=acs/acs5&get=NAME,B19013_001E&for=${encodeURIComponent(geoMap[geo].for)}`;
    const r = await fetch(url);
    const txt = await r.text();
    if(!r.ok){ out.textContent = "Error: " + txt; return; }
    const arr = JSON.parse(txt);
    const header = arr[0], row = arr[1];
    const name = row[header.indexOf("NAME")];
    const med = row[header.indexOf("B19013_001E")];
    out.innerHTML = `<b>${name}</b><br>Median household income (ACS 5y): <b>${money(med)}</b><br><span class="muted">Source: /api/census</span>`;
  }catch(e){
    out.textContent = "ACS pull unavailable (likely local/offline): " + e;
  }
}

function extractSeries(blsJson, seriesId){
  try{
    const s = blsJson.Results.series.find(x=>x.seriesID===seriesId);
    if(!s) return null;
    // Data entries are strings; take annual average by taking mean of monthly values for last year and first year
    return s.data;
  }catch{ return null; }
}

function cagr(start, end, years){
  const a = Number(start), b = Number(end);
  if(!(a>0) || !(b>0) || years<=0) return null;
  return Math.pow(b/a, 1/years)-1;
}

async function pullBLS(){
  const win = document.getElementById('win').value;
  const out = document.getElementById('blsOut');
  let startyear="2015", endyear="2025";
  if(win==="2010-2025"){ startyear="2010"; endyear="2025"; }
  try{
    const payload = {
      seriesid:["CUUR0000SA0","LNS14000000","CES0500000003"],
      startyear, endyear
    };
    const r = await fetch("/api/bls", { method:"POST", headers:{"content-type":"application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
    const txt = await r.text();
    if(!r.ok){ out.textContent = "Error: " + txt; return; }
    const j = JSON.parse(txt);

    const cpi = extractSeries(j, "CUUR0000SA0");
    const unemp = extractSeries(j, "LNS14000000");
    const earn = extractSeries(j, "CES0500000003");

    function latest(series){
      if(!series || !series.length) return null;
      return series[0]; // BLS returns most recent first
    }
    function pickYearAvg(series, year){
      if(!series) return null;
      const vals = series.filter(d=>d.year===String(year)).map(d=>Number(d.value)).filter(v=>isFinite(v));
      if(!vals.length) return null;
      return vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/vals.length;
    }

    const y0 = Number(startyear), y1 = Number(endyear);
    const cpi0 = pickYearAvg(cpi, y0);
    const cpi1 = pickYearAvg(cpi, y1);
    const cpiCAGR = cagr(cpi0, cpi1, (y1-y0));

    const uLatest = latest(unemp);
    const eLatest = latest(earn);

    out.innerHTML =
      `<b>BLS window:</b> ${startyear}–${endyear}<br>`
      + `CPI-U annualized growth (CAGR, placeholder method): <b>${cpiCAGR!==null ? pct(cpiCAGR) : "n/a"}</b><br>`
      + `Latest unemployment rate (LNS14000000): <b>${uLatest ? uLatest.value + "%" : "n/a"}</b> (${uLatest ? uLatest.periodName + " " + uLatest.year : ""})<br>`
      + `Latest avg hourly earnings (CES0500000003): <b>${eLatest ? money(eLatest.value) : "n/a"}</b> (${eLatest ? eLatest.periodName + " " + eLatest.year : ""})<br>`
      + `<span class="muted">Source: /api/bls</span>`;
  }catch(e){
    out.textContent = "BLS pull unavailable (likely local/offline): " + e;
  }
}

document.getElementById('geo').addEventListener('change', pullACS);
document.getElementById('acsYear').addEventListener('change', pullACS);
document.getElementById('win').addEventListener('change', pullBLS);

pullACS();
pullBLS();
</script>
"""
make_page("baselines.html","Observed Baselines Dashboard",
          "Home / Impact Lab / Baselines","baselines", cards, extra_scripts=script)

new_script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const modeEl = document.getElementById('mode');
  const bandEl = document.getElementById('band');
  const incomeEl = document.getElementById('income');
  const incomeVal = document.getElementById('incomeVal');
  const hhEl = document.getElementById('hh');
  const locEl = document.getElementById('loc');
  const housingEl = document.getElementById('housing');
  const sdebtEl = document.getElementById('sdebt');
  const mdebtEl = document.getElementById('mdebt');
  const results = document.getElementById('results');
  const baselineStatus = document.getElementById('baselineStatus');

  const j = await (await fetch('/data/finance/household_translation_scaffold.json')).json();
  const fiscal = await (await fetch('/data/finance/fiscal_and_debt_model_scaffold.json')).json();
  const li = await (await fetch('/data/finance/budget_line_items_scaffold.json')).json();

  function money(n){
    const x = Number(n);
    if(!isFinite(x)) return String(n);
    return '$' + Math.round(x).toLocaleString();
  }
  function fmt(n){
    const x = Math.round(Number(n));
    return '$' + x.toLocaleString();
  }
  function rampFactor(ramp, y){
    if(!ramp) return 1;
    if(ramp.kind === 's_curve'){
      const m = ramp.midpoint_year || 10;
      const k = ramp.steepness || 0.5;
      return 1/(1+Math.exp(-k*(y-m)));
    }
    return 1;
  }

  function rampFactorItem(item, y){
    const r = item.ramp || {};
    if(r.kind === 'linear'){
      const s = r.start_year || 1;
      const e = r.end_year || s;
      if(y <= s) return 0;
      if(y >= e) return 1;
      return (y - s) / (e - s);
    }
    if(r.kind === 's_curve'){
      const m = r.midpoint_year || 8;
      const k = r.steepness || 0.6;
      return 1/(1+Math.exp(-k*(y-m)));
    }
    if(r.kind === 'front_load'){
      const years = (r.years || []);
      if(years.length === 0) return 0;
      const maxY = Math.max(...years);
      if(y <= 1) return 0;
      if(y >= maxY) return 1;
      return Math.min(1, y / maxY);
    }
    return 1;
  }

  function lineItemEffect(band, year){
    let sum = 0;
    for(const item of li.wmr.items){
      const steady = item.annual_steady_state_usd[band];
      sum += steady * rampFactorItem(item, year);
    }
    return sum;
  }

  function studentDebtScale(level){ if(level==='none') return 0; if(level==='some') return 1; return 2.0; }
  function medicalDebtScale(level){ if(level==='none') return 0; if(level==='some') return 1; return 2.0; }
  function locationScale(loc){
    if(loc==='urban') return {transport:0.7, broadband:1.0, housing:1.2};
    if(loc==='suburban') return {transport:1.0, broadband:1.0, housing:1.0};
    return {transport:1.3, broadband:1.0, housing:0.9};
  }

  async function fetchACSIncome(){
    const cfg = j.observed_baseline?.census;
    if(!cfg) return null;
    const year = cfg.year || "2023";
    const varName = cfg.vars?.median_household_income || "B19013_001E";
    // In V52 we default to US-level. Later we’ll map presets to state/county.
    const url = `/api/census?year=${encodeURIComponent(year)}&dataset=${encodeURIComponent(cfg.dataset)}&get=NAME,${encodeURIComponent(varName)}&for=us:1`;
    const r = await fetch(url);
    if(!r.ok) return null;
    const arr = await r.json();
    const header = arr[0], row = arr[1];
    return { name: row[header.indexOf("NAME")], income: Number(row[header.indexOf(varName)]), year };
  }

  function extractSeries(blsJson, seriesId){
    try{ return blsJson.Results.series.find(x=>x.seriesID===seriesId)?.data || null; }catch{ return null; }
  }
  function pickYearAvg(series, year){
    if(!series) return null;
    const vals = series.filter(d=>d.year===String(year)).map(d=>Number(d.value)).filter(v=>isFinite(v));
    if(!vals.length) return null;
    return vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/vals.length;
  }
  function cagr(a,b,years){
    if(!(a>0) || !(b>0) || years<=0) return null;
    return Math.pow(b/a, 1/years)-1;
  }

  async function fetchBLSInflationCAGR(){
    const cfg = j.observed_baseline?.bls;
    if(!cfg) return null;
    const win = cfg.window || {startyear:"2015", endyear:"2025"};
    const seriesId = cfg.series?.cpi_u_all_items || "CUUR0000SA0";
    const payload = { seriesid:[seriesId], startyear:String(win.startyear), endyear:String(win.endyear) };
    const r = await fetch("/api/bls", { method:"POST", headers:{"content-type":"application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
    if(!r.ok) return null;
    const bj = await r.json();
    const s = extractSeries(bj, seriesId);
    const y0 = Number(win.startyear), y1 = Number(win.endyear);
    const v0 = pickYearAvg(s, y0);
    const v1 = pickYearAvg(s, y1);
    const g = cagr(v0, v1, (y1-y0));
    if(g===null) return null;
    return { seriesId, startyear:y0, endyear:y1, cagr:g };
  }

  function pwfTotalsByYear(band, years){
    const sp = fiscal.starting_point_placeholders || {};
    const debt0 = sp.gross_federal_debt_usd_sep30_2025 || 27_000_000_000_000;
    const gdp0 = sp.nominal_gdp_usd_saar_q3_2025 || 27_000_000_000_000;

    const shares = (fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework && fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework.default_shares)
      ? fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework.default_shares[band]
      : (li.wmr.surplus_allocation_defaults ? li.wmr.surplus_allocation_defaults[band] : {debt_paydown:0.6,peoples_wealth_fund:0.25,reinvestment:0.15});

    const r = sp.interest_rate_effective[band];
    const r_w = Math.max(0, r - fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.interest_rate_risk_premium_reduction[band]);

    const sq_real = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.real_gdp_growth[band];
    const sq_inf = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.inflation[band];
    const w_uplift = fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.net_growth_uplift_from_infrastructure[band];
    const w_real = sq_real + w_uplift;
    const w_inf = sq_inf;

    const prim0 = sp.primary_deficit_status_quo_usd[band];

    let debt = debt0, gdp=gdp0, pwf=0;
    const out=[];
    for(let t=1;t<=years;t++){
      const interest = debt * r_w;
      const improvement = lineItemEffect(band, t);
      const prim = prim0 * (1 + 0.01*(t-1)) - improvement;
      let pay=0, pwfAdd=0;
      if(prim < 0){
        const surplus = -prim;
        pay = surplus * shares.debt_paydown;
        pwfAdd = surplus * shares.peoples_wealth_fund;
      }
      debt = debt + prim + interest;
      if(pay>0) debt -= pay;
      gdp = gdp * (1 + w_real + w_inf);
      pwf += pwfAdd;
      out.push({year:t, pwf_total:pwf});
    }
    return out;
  }

  async function compute(){
    const mode = modeEl.value;
    const band = bandEl.value;
    const income = Number(incomeEl.value);
    const hhSize = Number(hhEl.value);
    const loc = locEl.value;
    const housing = housingEl.value;
    const sd = sdebtEl.value;
    const md = mdebtEl.value;

    incomeVal.textContent = money(income);

    // default scaffold growth
    let sqGrowth = j.status_quo.growth_rates_annual[band];
    let observedNote = "Mode: assumptions (offline)";

    // observed: set income default (not forcing user value if they've moved slider) and derive growth from CPI CAGR
    if(mode === "observed"){
      const [acs, infl] = await Promise.all([fetchACSIncome().catch(()=>null), fetchBLSInflationCAGR().catch(()=>null)]);
      if(acs && !Number.isNaN(acs.income) && incomeEl.dataset.userMoved !== "1"){
        incomeEl.value = String(Math.round(acs.income/1000)*1000);
      }
      if(infl && infl.cagr!=null){
        sqGrowth = infl.cagr;
      }
      observedNote = `Mode: observed baseline • Income default: ${acs ? money(acs.income) + " ("+acs.year+")" : "unavailable"} • Inflation growth: ${infl ? (infl.cagr*100).toFixed(2)+"% CAGR" : "unavailable"}`;
    }
    baselineStatus.innerHTML = `<b>Baseline</b><br>${observedNote}<br><span class="muted">If running locally, APIs may be unavailable. Deploy to Netlify and set env vars.</span>`;

    // re-read income after potential update
    const income2 = Number(incomeEl.value);
    incomeVal.textContent = money(income2);

    const scale = locationScale(loc);

    // Status quo annual burdens (scaled)
    const sq = j.status_quo.annual_burdens_usd;

    // WMR relief
    const w = j.wmr.annual_relief_usd;

    // Dividend from PWF
    const div = j.wmr.people_dividend_usd;
    const payoutRate = div.payout_rate_annual[band];
    const households = div.estimated_households.value;
    const divRamp = div.phase_in_ramp;
    const divCap = div.cap_per_household_usd[band];

    // Net tax change
    const tax = j.wmr.transition_taxes_net_usd;
    const taxBase = tax[band][band];

    const pwfSeries = pwfTotalsByYear(band, 50);

    function annualSQ(year){
      const g = Math.pow(1+sqGrowth, year-1);
      const hc = sq.healthcare_premiums_out_of_pocket[band] * g;
      const sl = sq.student_loan_payments[band] * studentDebtScale(sd) * g;
      const mdp = sq.medical_debt_payments[band] * medicalDebtScale(md) * g;
      const hpress = sq.housing_cost_pressure[band] * (housing==='renter' ? 1.0 : 0.6) * scale.housing * g;
      const tpress = sq.transport_cost_pressure[band] * scale.transport * g;
      const bb = sq.broadband_cost[band] * scale.broadband * g;
      return hc + sl + mdp + hpress + tpress + bb;
    }

    function annualDividend(year){
      const pwfTotal = pwfSeries[year-1].pwf_total;
      const raw = (payoutRate * pwfTotal) / households;
      const phased = raw * rampFactor(divRamp, year);
      const capped = Math.min(phased, divCap);
      const hhMod = (0.75 + 0.1*Math.min(4, hhSize));
      return capped * hhMod;
    }

    function annualWMR(year){
      const hcRel = w.healthcare_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/3);
      const eduRel = w.education_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/3) * studentDebtScale(sd);
      const medRel = w.medical_debt_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/2) * medicalDebtScale(md);
      const bbRel = w.broadband_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/4) * scale.broadband;
      const trRel = w.transport_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/6) * scale.transport;
      const hoRel = w.housing_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/6) * (housing==='renter' ? 1.0 : 0.6) * scale.housing;
      const dividend = annualDividend(year);
      const taxAdj = (income2 > 120000 ? (taxBase*0.5) : (income2 < 50000 ? (taxBase*1.2) : taxBase));
      return annualSQ(year) - (hcRel + eduRel + medRel + bbRel + trRel + hoRel) - dividend + taxAdj;
    }

    const horizons = j.meta.horizons;
    const rows = horizons.map(H => {
      let cumSQ=0, cumW=0, cumDiv=0;
      for(let y=1;y<=H;y++){
        cumSQ += annualSQ(y);
        cumW += annualWMR(y);
        cumDiv += annualDividend(y);
      }
      return {H, cumSQ, cumW, delta: cumW - cumSQ, cumDiv};
    });

    const r10 = rows.find(x=>x.H===10);
    const r50 = rows.find(x=>x.H===50);

    let html = `<div class="callout"><b>Headline (placeholder)</b><br>`
      + `10y Δ: <b>${fmt(r10.delta)}</b> • 50y Δ: <b>${fmt(r50.delta)}</b><br>`
      + `<span class="muted">Observed mode updates baselines (income default + inflation growth) when available.</span>`
      + `</div>`;

    html += '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Horizon</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Status quo (cumulative burden)</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR (cumulative burden)</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Dividend received (cum.)</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ (WMR − SQ)</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for(const r of rows){
      html += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${r.H}y</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.cumSQ)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.cumW)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.cumDiv)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmt(r.delta)}</b></td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';

    results.innerHTML = html;
  }

  // Track if user moved income slider (so observed baseline doesn't overwrite)
  incomeEl.addEventListener('input', () => { incomeEl.dataset.userMoved = "1"; });

  [modeEl, bandEl, hhEl, locEl, housingEl, sdebtEl, mdebtEl].forEach(el=>{
    el.addEventListener('change', compute);
  });
  // income triggers recompute without overwriting
  incomeEl.addEventListener('input', compute);

  compute();
})();
</script>
"""
hh_html = hh_html.replace("</body>", new_script+"\n</body>")
write(hh_page, hh_html)

new_script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const modeEl = document.getElementById('mode');
  const presetEl = document.getElementById('preset');
  const bandEl = document.getElementById('band');
  const incomeEl = document.getElementById('income');
  const incomeVal = document.getElementById('incomeVal');
  const hhEl = document.getElementById('hh');
  const locEl = document.getElementById('loc');
  const housingEl = document.getElementById('housing');
  const sdebtEl = document.getElementById('sdebt');
  const mdebtEl = document.getElementById('mdebt');
  const results = document.getElementById('results');
  const baselineStatus = document.getElementById('baselineStatus');

  const j = await (await fetch('/data/finance/household_translation_scaffold.json')).json();
  const fiscal = await (await fetch('/data/finance/fiscal_and_debt_model_scaffold.json')).json();
  const li = await (await fetch('/data/finance/budget_line_items_scaffold.json')).json();

  function money(n){
    const x = Number(n);
    if(!isFinite(x)) return String(n);
    return '$' + Math.round(x).toLocaleString();
  }
  function fmt(n){
    const x = Math.round(Number(n));
    return '$' + x.toLocaleString();
  }
  function pct(x){
    const n = Number(x);
    if(!isFinite(n)) return String(x);
    return (n*100).toFixed(2) + '%';
  }
  function rampFactor(ramp, y){
    if(!ramp) return 1;
    if(ramp.kind === 's_curve'){
      const m = ramp.midpoint_year || 10;
      const k = ramp.steepness || 0.5;
      return 1/(1+Math.exp(-k*(y-m)));
    }
    return 1;
  }

  function rampFactorItem(item, y){
    const r = item.ramp || {};
    if(r.kind === 'linear'){
      const s = r.start_year || 1;
      const e = r.end_year || s;
      if(y <= s) return 0;
      if(y >= e) return 1;
      return (y - s) / (e - s);
    }
    if(r.kind === 's_curve'){
      const m = r.midpoint_year || 8;
      const k = r.steepness || 0.6;
      return 1/(1+Math.exp(-k*(y-m)));
    }
    if(r.kind === 'front_load'){
      const years = (r.years || []);
      if(years.length === 0) return 0;
      const maxY = Math.max(...years);
      if(y <= 1) return 0;
      if(y >= maxY) return 1;
      return Math.min(1, y / maxY);
    }
    return 1;
  }

  function lineItemEffect(band, year){
    let sum = 0;
    for(const item of li.wmr.items){
      const steady = item.annual_steady_state_usd[band];
      sum += steady * rampFactorItem(item, year);
    }
    return sum;
  }

  function studentDebtScale(level){ if(level==='none') return 0; if(level==='some') return 1; return 2.0; }
  function medicalDebtScale(level){ if(level==='none') return 0; if(level==='some') return 1; return 2.0; }
  function locationScale(loc){
    if(loc==='urban') return {transport:0.7, broadband:1.0, housing:1.2};
    if(loc==='suburban') return {transport:1.0, broadband:1.0, housing:1.0};
    return {transport:1.3, broadband:1.0, housing:0.9};
  }

  async function pullCensus(vars, geoKey){
    const cfg = j.observed_baseline?.census;
    const geoMap = j.observed_baseline?.geo_defaults || {};
    if(!cfg || !geoMap[geoKey]) return null;
    const year = cfg.year || "2023";
    const dataset = cfg.dataset || "acs/acs5";
    const geo = geoMap[geoKey];
    const get = ["NAME"].concat(vars).join(",");
    let url = `/api/census?year=${encodeURIComponent(year)}&dataset=${encodeURIComponent(dataset)}&get=${encodeURIComponent(get)}&for=${encodeURIComponent(geo.for)}`;
    if(geo.in) url += `&in=${encodeURIComponent(geo.in)}`;
    const r = await fetch(url);
    if(!r.ok) return null;
    const arr = await r.json();
    const header = arr[0], row = arr[1];
    const out = { name: row[header.indexOf("NAME")], year };
    for(const v of vars){
      out[v] = Number(row[header.indexOf(v)]);
    }
    return out;
  }

  async function pullCensusSubject(vars, geoKey){
    // For subject table vars (like S2801...), use subject dataset
    const cfg = j.observed_baseline?.census;
    const geoMap = j.observed_baseline?.geo_defaults || {};
    if(!cfg || !geoMap[geoKey]) return null;
    const year = cfg.year || "2023";
    const dataset = cfg.subject_dataset || "acs/acs5/subject";
    const geo = geoMap[geoKey];
    const get = ["NAME"].concat(vars).join(",");
    let url = `/api/census?year=${encodeURIComponent(year)}&dataset=${encodeURIComponent(dataset)}&get=${encodeURIComponent(get)}&for=${encodeURIComponent(geo.for)}`;
    if(geo.in) url += `&in=${encodeURIComponent(geo.in)}`;
    const r = await fetch(url);
    if(!r.ok) return null;
    const arr = await r.json();
    const header = arr[0], row = arr[1];
    const out = { name: row[header.indexOf("NAME")], year };
    for(const v of vars){
      out[v] = Number(row[header.indexOf(v)]);
    }
    return out;
  }

  function extractSeries(blsJson, seriesId){
    try{ return blsJson.Results.series.find(x=>x.seriesID===seriesId)?.data || null; }catch{ return null; }
  }
  function pickYearAvg(series, year){
    if(!series) return null;
    const vals = series.filter(d=>d.year===String(year)).map(d=>Number(d.value)).filter(v=>isFinite(v));
    if(!vals.length) return null;
    return vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/vals.length;
  }
  function cagr(a,b,years){
    if(!(a>0) || !(b>0) || years<=0) return null;
    return Math.pow(b/a, 1/years)-1;
  }

  async function fetchBLSInflationCAGR(){
    const cfg = j.observed_baseline?.bls;
    if(!cfg) return null;
    const win = cfg.window || {startyear:"2015", endyear:"2025"};
    const seriesId = cfg.series?.cpi_u_all_items || "CUUR0000SA0";
    const payload = { seriesid:[seriesId], startyear:String(win.startyear), endyear:String(win.endyear) };
    const r = await fetch("/api/bls", { method:"POST", headers:{"content-type":"application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
    if(!r.ok) return null;
    const bj = await r.json();
    const s = extractSeries(bj, seriesId);
    const y0 = Number(win.startyear), y1 = Number(win.endyear);
    const v0 = pickYearAvg(s, y0);
    const v1 = pickYearAvg(s, y1);
    const g = cagr(v0, v1, (y1-y0));
    if(g===null) return null;
    return { seriesId, startyear:y0, endyear:y1, cagr:g };
  }

  function pwfTotalsByYear(band, years){
    const sp = fiscal.starting_point_placeholders || {};
    const debt0 = sp.gross_federal_debt_usd_sep30_2025 || 27_000_000_000_000;
    const gdp0 = sp.nominal_gdp_usd_saar_q3_2025 || 27_000_000_000_000;

    const shares = (fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework && fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework.default_shares)
      ? fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework.default_shares[band]
      : (li.wmr.surplus_allocation_defaults ? li.wmr.surplus_allocation_defaults[band] : {debt_paydown:0.6,peoples_wealth_fund:0.25,reinvestment:0.15});

    const r = sp.interest_rate_effective[band];
    const r_w = Math.max(0, r - fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.interest_rate_risk_premium_reduction[band]);

    const sq_real = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.real_gdp_growth[band];
    const sq_inf = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.inflation[band];
    const w_uplift = fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.net_growth_uplift_from_infrastructure[band];
    const w_real = sq_real + w_uplift;
    const w_inf = sq_inf;

    const prim0 = sp.primary_deficit_status_quo_usd[band];

    let debt = debt0, gdp=gdp0, pwf=0;
    const out=[];
    for(let t=1;t<=years;t++){
      const interest = debt * r_w;
      const improvement = lineItemEffect(band, t);
      const prim = prim0 * (1 + 0.01*(t-1)) - improvement;
      let pay=0, pwfAdd=0;
      if(prim < 0){
        const surplus = -prim;
        pay = surplus * shares.debt_paydown;
        pwfAdd = surplus * shares.peoples_wealth_fund;
      }
      debt = debt + prim + interest;
      if(pay>0) debt -= pay;
      gdp = gdp * (1 + w_real + w_inf);
      pwf += pwfAdd;
      out.push({year:t, pwf_total:pwf});
    }
    return out;
  }

  function baselineCacheKey(mode, preset, band){
    return `wmr_baseline_v53:${mode}:${preset}:${band}`;
  }

  async function compute(){
    const mode = modeEl.value;
    const band = bandEl.value;
    const preset = presetEl.value;
    const income = Number(incomeEl.value);
    const hhSize = Number(hhEl.value);
    const loc = locEl.value;
    const housing = housingEl.value;
    const sd = sdebtEl.value;
    const md = mdebtEl.value;

    incomeVal.textContent = money(income);

    // default scaffold
    let sqGrowth = j.status_quo.growth_rates_annual[band];

    // baseline anchors for housing/broadband (start from scaffold, adjust with observed where possible)
    let housingAnchor = null; // annual dollars estimate placeholder
    let broadbandAnchor = null; // annual dollars estimate placeholder
    let geoKey = "us";
    const presetMap = j.observed_baseline?.preset_geo_mapping || {};
    if(presetMap[preset]?.geo) geoKey = presetMap[preset].geo;

    let observed = { geoKey, acs:null, acsSubject:null, infl:null };

    if(mode === "observed"){
      const vars = [];
      const cfg = j.observed_baseline?.census?.vars || {};
      const vIncome = cfg.median_household_income;
      const vRent = cfg.median_gross_rent;
      const vOwnM = cfg.median_owner_cost_mortgage;
      const vOwnN = cfg.median_owner_cost_no_mortgage;
      if(vIncome) vars.push(vIncome);
      if(vRent) vars.push(vRent);
      if(vOwnM) vars.push(vOwnM);
      if(vOwnN) vars.push(vOwnN);

      const subjVars = [];
      const vBroad = cfg.broadband_subscriptions_total;
      if(vBroad) subjVars.push(vBroad);

      const [acs, acsSubj, infl] = await Promise.all([
        pullCensus(vars, geoKey).catch(()=>null),
        pullCensusSubject(subjVars, geoKey).catch(()=>null),
        fetchBLSInflationCAGR().catch(()=>null)
      ]);

      observed.acs = acs;
      observed.acsSubject = acsSubj;
      observed.infl = infl;

      // Income default from ACS (if user hasn't moved slider)
      if(acs && vIncome && !Number.isNaN(acs[vIncome]) && incomeEl.dataset.userMoved !== "1"){
        incomeEl.value = String(Math.round(acs[vIncome]/1000)*1000);
      }
      if(infl && infl.cagr!=null){
        sqGrowth = infl.cagr;
      }

      // Housing anchor: use ACS median monthly -> annual
      const rules = j.observed_baseline?.application_rules?.housing_baseline_from_acs;
      if(acs && rules){
        if(housing === "renter" && vRent && isFinite(acs[vRent])){
          housingAnchor = Number(acs[vRent]) * 12;
        } else if(housing === "owner" && vOwnM && isFinite(acs[vOwnM])) {
          // assume mortgage costs as default
          housingAnchor = Number(acs[vOwnM]) * 12;
        }
      }

      // Broadband anchor: subject variable is usually percent; we convert to a "pressure" scaler
      // Here we just store the proxy and show it in baseline status; later convert to dollars with market estimates.
      if(acsSubj && vBroad && isFinite(acsSubj[vBroad])){
        broadbandAnchor = Number(acsSubj[vBroad]);
      }

      // Save snapshot to localStorage
      try{
        const snap = {
          last_pull_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
          geo_key: geoKey,
          preset,
          acs: acs,
          acs_subject: acsSubj,
          inflation: infl
        };
        localStorage.setItem(baselineCacheKey(mode,preset,band), JSON.stringify(snap));
      }catch(e){}
    }

    // re-read income
    const income2 = Number(incomeEl.value);
    incomeVal.textContent = money(income2);

    const scale = locationScale(loc);

    // Status quo annual burdens (scaled)
    const sq = j.status_quo.annual_burdens_usd;

    // WMR relief
    const w = j.wmr.annual_relief_usd;

    // Dividend from PWF
    const div = j.wmr.people_dividend_usd;
    const payoutRate = div.payout_rate_annual[band];
    const households = div.estimated_households.value;
    const divRamp = div.phase_in_ramp;
    const divCap = div.cap_per_household_usd[band];

    // Net tax change
    const tax = j.wmr.transition_taxes_net_usd;
    const taxBase = tax[band][band];

    const pwfSeries = pwfTotalsByYear(band, 50);

    function annualSQ(year){
      const g = Math.pow(1+sqGrowth, year-1);

      // Healthcare and debts remain scaffolded in V53
      const hc = sq.healthcare_premiums_out_of_pocket[band] * g;
      const sl = sq.student_loan_payments[band] * studentDebtScale(sd) * g;
      const mdp = sq.medical_debt_payments[band] * medicalDebtScale(md) * g;

      // Housing: replace baseline anchor if observed
      let hpress_base = sq.housing_cost_pressure[band];
      if(mode==="observed" && housingAnchor && isFinite(housingAnchor)){
        // Convert annual housing median to a "pressure" around scaffold baseline by anchoring proportionally.
        // Placeholder: treat housing pressure as share of annual median housing cost vs assumed baseline.
        hpress_base = (housingAnchor * 0.12); // 12% of annual cost as "pressure" component placeholder
      }
      const hpress = hpress_base * (housing==='renter' ? 1.0 : 0.6) * scale.housing * g;

      // Transport: scaffolded
      const tpress = sq.transport_cost_pressure[band] * scale.transport * g;

      // Broadband: if observed, adjust with proxy (higher subscription proxy => lower cost pressure)
      let bb_base = sq.broadband_cost[band];
      if(mode==="observed" && broadbandAnchor && isFinite(broadbandAnchor)){
        // If proxy is percent, map [50..90] to a factor [1.2..0.85]
        const p = broadbandAnchor;
        const factor = Math.max(0.75, Math.min(1.35, 1.35 - (p/100)*0.6));
        bb_base = bb_base * factor;
      }
      const bb = bb_base * scale.broadband * g;

      return hc + sl + mdp + hpress + tpress + bb;
    }

    function annualDividend(year){
      const pwfTotal = pwfSeries[year-1].pwf_total;
      const raw = (payoutRate * pwfTotal) / households;
      const phased = raw * rampFactor(divRamp, year);
      const capped = Math.min(phased, divCap);
      const hhMod = (0.75 + 0.1*Math.min(4, hhSize));
      return capped * hhMod;
    }

    function annualWMR(year){
      const hcRel = w.healthcare_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/3);
      const eduRel = w.education_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/3) * studentDebtScale(sd);
      const medRel = w.medical_debt_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/2) * medicalDebtScale(md);
      const bbRel = w.broadband_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/4) * scale.broadband;
      const trRel = w.transport_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/6) * scale.transport;
      const hoRel = w.housing_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/6) * (housing==='renter' ? 1.0 : 0.6) * scale.housing;
      const dividend = annualDividend(year);
      const taxAdj = (income2 > 120000 ? (taxBase*0.5) : (income2 < 50000 ? (taxBase*1.2) : taxBase));
      return annualSQ(year) - (hcRel + eduRel + medRel + bbRel + trRel + hoRel) - dividend + taxAdj;
    }

    const horizons = j.meta.horizons;
    const rows = horizons.map(H => {
      let cumSQ=0, cumW=0, cumDiv=0;
      for(let y=1;y<=H;y++){
        cumSQ += annualSQ(y);
        cumW += annualWMR(y);
        cumDiv += annualDividend(y);
      }
      return {H, cumSQ, cumW, delta: cumW - cumSQ, cumDiv};
    });

    const r10 = rows.find(x=>x.H===10);
    const r50 = rows.find(x=>x.H===50);

    // Baseline status text
    let baseText = `Mode: assumptions (offline)`;
    if(mode==="observed"){
      const cfg = j.observed_baseline?.census?.vars || {};
      const vIncome = cfg.median_household_income;
      const vRent = cfg.median_gross_rent;
      const vOwnM = cfg.median_owner_cost_mortgage;
      const vBroad = cfg.broadband_subscriptions_total;
      const acs = observed.acs;
      const acsS = observed.acsSubject;
      const infl = observed.infl;
      baseText =
        `Mode: observed baseline • Preset geo: <b>${geoKey}</b><br>` +
        `Income default: ${acs && vIncome ? money(acs[vIncome]) : "unavailable"} • ` +
        `Housing anchor: ${housingAnchor ? money(housingAnchor) + "/yr" : "unavailable"} • ` +
        `Broadband proxy: ${acsS && vBroad && isFinite(acsS[vBroad]) ? String(acsS[vBroad]) : "unavailable"}<br>` +
        `Inflation growth: ${infl ? pct(infl.cagr) + " CAGR" : "unavailable"}`;
    }
    baselineStatus.innerHTML = `<b>Baseline</b><br>${baseText}<br><span class="muted">Observed mode requires Netlify deployment + env vars; dashboards: <a href="/pages/baselines.html"><b>Baselines</b></a></span>`;

    let html = `<div class="callout"><b>Headline (placeholder)</b><br>`
      + `10y Δ: <b>${fmt(r10.delta)}</b> • 50y Δ: <b>${fmt(r50.delta)}</b><br>`
      + `<span class="muted">V53 replaces housing + broadband baseline anchors when observed data is available.</span>`
      + `</div>`;

    html += '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Horizon</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Status quo (cumulative burden)</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR (cumulative burden)</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Dividend received (cum.)</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ (WMR − SQ)</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for(const r of rows){
      html += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${r.H}y</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.cumSQ)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.cumW)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.cumDiv)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmt(r.delta)}</b></td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';

    // Snapshot display
    let snapHtml = '';
    try{
      const k = baselineCacheKey(mode,preset,band);
      const v = localStorage.getItem(k);
      if(v){
        const snap = JSON.parse(v);
        snapHtml = `<div class="note" style="margin-top:10px;"><b>Baseline snapshot (local)</b><br>
          Pulled: ${snap.last_pull_utc}<br>
          Geo: ${snap.geo_key}<br>
          <span class="muted">Stored in localStorage; later versions will persist audited snapshots.</span></div>`;
      }
    }catch(e){}
    results.innerHTML = html + snapHtml;
  }

  incomeEl.addEventListener('input', () => { incomeEl.dataset.userMoved = "1"; });

  [modeEl, presetEl, bandEl, hhEl, locEl, housingEl, sdebtEl, mdebtEl].forEach(el=>{
    el.addEventListener('change', compute);
  });
  incomeEl.addEventListener('input', compute);

  compute();
})();
</script>
"""
hh_html = hh_html.replace("</body>", new_script+"\n</body>")
write(hh_page, hh_html)

                                  '<div id="blsOut" class="note" style="margin-top:12px;">Loading…</div>\n'

    script = """
<script>
function money(x){
  const n = Number(x);
  if(!isFinite(n)) return String(x);
  return '$' + Math.round(n).toLocaleString();
}
function pct(x){
  const n = Number(x);
  if(!isFinite(n)) return String(x);
  return (n*100).toFixed(2) + '%';
}

let lastACS = null;
let lastBLS = null;

async function pullACS(){
  const geo = document.getElementById('geo').value;
  const year = document.getElementById('acsYear').value;
  const out = document.getElementById('acsOut');
  try{
    const geoMap = {
      us: { for: "us:1" },
      arkansas: { for: "state:05" }
    };
    const url = `/api/census?year=${encodeURIComponent(year)}&dataset=acs/acs5&get=NAME,B19013_001E,B25064_001E,B25088_002E,B25088_003E&for=${encodeURIComponent(geoMap[geo].for)}`;
    const r = await fetch(url);
    const txt = await r.text();
    if(!r.ok){ out.textContent = "Error: " + txt; return; }
    const arr = JSON.parse(txt);
    const header = arr[0], row = arr[1];
    const name = row[header.indexOf("NAME")];
    const med = row[header.indexOf("B19013_001E")];
    const rent = row[header.indexOf("B25064_001E")];
    const ownM = row[header.indexOf("B25088_002E")];
    const ownN = row[header.indexOf("B25088_003E")];
    lastACS = { geo, year, name, median_income: Number(med), median_rent_monthly:Number(rent), owner_cost_mortgage_monthly:Number(ownM), owner_cost_no_mortgage_monthly:Number(ownN) };
    out.innerHTML = `<b>${name}</b><br>
      Median household income: <b>${money(med)}</b><br>
      Median gross rent (monthly): <b>${money(rent)}</b><br>
      Median owner cost w/ mortgage (monthly): <b>${money(ownM)}</b><br>
      Median owner cost no mortgage (monthly): <b>${money(ownN)}</b><br>
      <span class="muted">Source: /api/census</span>`;
    writeSnapshot();
  }catch(e){
    out.textContent = "ACS pull unavailable (likely local/offline): " + e;
  }
}

function extractSeries(blsJson, seriesId){
  try{
    const s = blsJson.Results.series.find(x=>x.seriesID===seriesId);
    if(!s) return null;
    return s.data;
  }catch{ return null; }
}
function pickYearAvg(series, year){
  if(!series) return null;
  const vals = series.filter(d=>d.year===String(year)).map(d=>Number(d.value)).filter(v=>isFinite(v));
  if(!vals.length) return null;
  return vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/vals.length;
}
function cagr(start, end, years){
  const a = Number(start), b = Number(end);
  if(!(a>0) || !(b>0) || years<=0) return null;
  return Math.pow(b/a, 1/years)-1;
}

async function pullBLS(){
  const win = document.getElementById('win').value;
  const out = document.getElementById('blsOut');
  let startyear="2015", endyear="2025";
  if(win==="2010-2025"){ startyear="2010"; endyear="2025"; }
  try{
    const payload = {
      seriesid:["CUUR0000SA0","LNS14000000","CES0500000003"],
      startyear, endyear
    };
    const r = await fetch("/api/bls", { method:"POST", headers:{"content-type":"application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
    const txt = await r.text();
    if(!r.ok){ out.textContent = "Error: " + txt; return; }
    const j = JSON.parse(txt);

    const cpi = extractSeries(j, "CUUR0000SA0");
    const unemp = extractSeries(j, "LNS14000000");
    const earn = extractSeries(j, "CES0500000003");

    function latest(series){
      if(!series || !series.length) return null;
      return series[0];
    }
    const y0 = Number(startyear), y1 = Number(endyear);
    const cpi0 = pickYearAvg(cpi, y0);
    const cpi1 = pickYearAvg(cpi, y1);
    const cpiCAGR = cagr(cpi0, cpi1, (y1-y0));

    const uLatest = latest(unemp);
    const eLatest = latest(earn);

    lastBLS = { startyear, endyear, cpi_cagr: cpiCAGR, unemployment_latest: uLatest, earnings_latest: eLatest };

    out.innerHTML =
      `<b>BLS window:</b> ${startyear}–${endyear}<br>`
      + `CPI-U annualized growth (CAGR, placeholder method): <b>${cpiCAGR!==null ? pct(cpiCAGR) : "n/a"}</b><br>`
      + `Latest unemployment rate: <b>${uLatest ? uLatest.value + "%" : "n/a"}</b> (${uLatest ? uLatest.periodName + " " + uLatest.year : ""})<br>`
      + `Latest avg hourly earnings: <b>${eLatest ? money(eLatest.value) : "n/a"}</b> (${eLatest ? eLatest.periodName + " " + eLatest.year : ""})<br>`
      + `<span class="muted">Source: /api/bls</span>`;
    writeSnapshot();
  }catch(e){
    out.textContent = "BLS pull unavailable (likely local/offline): " + e;
  }
}

function writeSnapshot(){
  const el = document.getElementById('baselineSnapshot');
  try{
    const snap = {
      last_pull_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      acs: lastACS,
      bls: lastBLS
    };
    localStorage.setItem("wmr_baselines_snapshot_v53", JSON.stringify(snap));
    el.innerHTML = `<b>Baseline snapshot (local)</b><br>
      Pulled: ${snap.last_pull_utc}<br>
      ACS: ${snap.acs ? snap.acs.name : "n/a"} • BLS: ${snap.bls ? (snap.bls.startyear+"–"+snap.bls.endyear) : "n/a"}<br>
      <span class="muted">Stored in localStorage; later versions will persist audited snapshots.</span>`;
  }catch(e){
    el.textContent = "Snapshot unavailable: " + e;
  }
}

document.getElementById('geo').addEventListener('change', pullACS);
document.getElementById('acsYear').addEventListener('change', pullACS);
document.getElementById('win').addEventListener('change', pullBLS);

pullACS();
pullBLS();
</script>
"""
    base_html = base_html.replace("</body>", script+"\n</body>")
    write(base_page, base_html)

if os.path.exists(ms_path):

        write(ms_path, ms)

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'
