enh_script = """
<script>
function money(x){
  const n = Number(x);
  if(!isFinite(n)) return String(x);
  return '$' + Math.round(n).toLocaleString();
}
function pct(x){
  const n = Number(x);
  if(!isFinite(n)) return String(x);
  return (n*100).toFixed(1) + '%';
}

let lastACS = null;
let lastBLS = null;
let lastDist = null;

const geoMap = {
  us: { for: "us:1" },
  arkansas: { for: "state:05" },
  pulaski: { for: "county:119", in: "state:05" }
};

async function censusGet(year, dataset, getVars, geo){
  let url = `/api/census?year=${encodeURIComponent(year)}&dataset=${encodeURIComponent(dataset)}&get=${encodeURIComponent(["NAME"].concat(getVars).join(","))}&for=${encodeURIComponent(geo.for)}`;
  if(geo.in) url += `&in=${encodeURIComponent(geo.in)}`;
  const r = await fetch(url);
  const txt = await r.text();
  if(!r.ok) throw new Error(txt);
  const arr = JSON.parse(txt);
  const header = arr[0], row = arr[1];
  const out = { name: row[header.indexOf("NAME")] };
  for(const v of getVars){
    out[v] = Number(row[header.indexOf(v)]);
  }
  return out;
}

function safeDiv(a,b){
  a=Number(a); b=Number(b);
  if(!isFinite(a) || !isFinite(b) || b<=0) return null;
  return a/b;
}

async function pullACS(){
  const geoKeyUI = document.getElementById('geo').value;
  const year = document.getElementById('acsYear').value;
  const out = document.getElementById('acsOut');
  const geoKey = (geoKeyUI==="pulaski") ? "pulaski" : geoKeyUI;
  const geo = geoMap[geoKey];
  try{
    const acs = await censusGet(year, "acs/acs5", ["B19013_001E","B25064_001E","B25088_002E","B25088_003E"], geo);
    // distributions: rent burden B25070 and commute time B08303
    const rent = await censusGet(year, "acs/acs5", ["B25070_001E","B25070_007E","B25070_008E","B25070_009E","B25070_010E"], geo);
    const commute = await censusGet(year, "acs/acs5", ["B08303_001E","B08303_008E","B08303_009E","B08303_010E","B08303_011E","B08303_012E","B08303_013E"], geo);

    const rent30plus = safeDiv(rent.B25070_007E + rent.B25070_008E + rent.B25070_009E + rent.B25070_010E, rent.B25070_001E);
    const rent50plus = safeDiv(rent.B25070_010E, rent.B25070_001E);

    const commuteOver30 = safeDiv(
      commute.B08303_008E + commute.B08303_009E + commute.B08303_010E + commute.B08303_011E + commute.B08303_012E + commute.B08303_013E,
      commute.B08303_001E
    );
    const commuteOver60 = safeDiv(commute.B08303_012E + commute.B08303_013E, commute.B08303_001E);

    lastACS = { geoKey, year, name: acs.name, median_income: acs.B19013_001E, median_rent_monthly: acs.B25064_001E, owner_cost_mortgage_monthly: acs.B25088_002E, owner_cost_no_mortgage_monthly: acs.B25088_003E };
    lastDist = { rent_burden_30_plus: rent30plus, rent_burden_50_plus: rent50plus, commute_over_30: commuteOver30, commute_over_60: commuteOver60 };

    out.innerHTML = `<b>${acs.name}</b><br>
      Median household income: <b>${money(acs.B19013_001E)}</b><br>
      Median gross rent (monthly): <b>${money(acs.B25064_001E)}</b><br>
      Median owner cost w/ mortgage (monthly): <b>${money(acs.B25088_002E)}</b><br>
      Median owner cost no mortgage (monthly): <b>${money(acs.B25088_003E)}</b><br>
      <span class="muted">Source: /api/census</span>
      <div class="callout" style="margin-top:10px;">
        <b>Derived distributions (V54)</b><br>
        Rent burden 30%+: <b>${rent30plus==null ? "n/a" : pct(rent30plus)}</b> • 50%+: <b>${rent50plus==null ? "n/a" : pct(rent50plus)}</b><br>
        Commute over 30 min: <b>${commuteOver30==null ? "n/a" : pct(commuteOver30)}</b> • over 60 min: <b>${commuteOver60==null ? "n/a" : pct(commuteOver60)}</b>
      </div>`;
    writeSnapshot();
  }catch(e){
    out.textContent = "ACS pull unavailable (likely local/offline): " + e;
  }
}

function extractSeries(blsJson, seriesId){
  try{
    const s = blsJson.Results.series.find(x=>x.seriesID===seriesId);
    if(!s) return null;
    return s.data;
  }catch{ return null; }
}
function pickYearAvg(series, year){
  if(!series) return null;
  const vals = series.filter(d=>d.year===String(year)).map(d=>Number(d.value)).filter(v=>isFinite(v));
  if(!vals.length) return null;
  return vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/vals.length;
}
function cagr(start, end, years){
  const a = Number(start), b = Number(end);
  if(!(a>0) || !(b>0) || years<=0) return null;
  return Math.pow(b/a, 1/years)-1;
}

async function pullBLS(){
  const win = document.getElementById('win').value;
  const out = document.getElementById('blsOut');
  let startyear="2015", endyear="2025";
  if(win==="2010-2025"){ startyear="2010"; endyear="2025"; }
  try{
    const payload = {
      seriesid:["CUUR0000SA0","LNS14000000","CES0500000003"],
      startyear, endyear
    };
    const r = await fetch("/api/bls", { method:"POST", headers:{"content-type":"application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
    const txt = await r.text();
    if(!r.ok){ out.textContent = "Error: " + txt; return; }
    const j = JSON.parse(txt);

    const cpi = extractSeries(j, "CUUR0000SA0");
    const unemp = extractSeries(j, "LNS14000000");
    const earn = extractSeries(j, "CES0500000003");

    function latest(series){
      if(!series || !series.length) return null;
      return series[0];
    }
    const y0 = Number(startyear), y1 = Number(endyear);
    const cpi0 = pickYearAvg(cpi, y0);
    const cpi1 = pickYearAvg(cpi, y1);
    const cpiCAGR = cagr(cpi0, cpi1, (y1-y0));

    const uLatest = latest(unemp);
    const eLatest = latest(earn);

    lastBLS = { startyear, endyear, cpi_cagr: cpiCAGR, unemployment_latest: uLatest, earnings_latest: eLatest };

    out.innerHTML =
      `<b>BLS window:</b> ${startyear}–${endyear}<br>`
      + `CPI-U annualized growth (CAGR, placeholder method): <b>${cpiCAGR!==null ? pct(cpiCAGR) : "n/a"}</b><br>`
      + `Latest unemployment rate: <b>${uLatest ? uLatest.value + "%" : "n/a"}</b> (${uLatest ? uLatest.periodName + " " + uLatest.year : ""})<br>`
      + `Latest avg hourly earnings: <b>${eLatest ? money(eLatest.value) : "n/a"}</b> (${eLatest ? eLatest.periodName + " " + eLatest.year : ""})<br>`
      + `<span class="muted">Source: /api/bls</span>`;
    writeSnapshot();
  }catch(e){
    out.textContent = "BLS pull unavailable (likely local/offline): " + e;
  }
}

function writeSnapshot(){
  const el = document.getElementById('baselineSnapshot');
  try{
    const snap = {
      version: "v54",
      last_pull_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      acs: lastACS,
      dist: lastDist,
      bls: lastBLS
    };
    localStorage.setItem("wmr_baselines_snapshot_v54", JSON.stringify(snap));
    el.innerHTML = `<b>Baseline snapshot (local)</b><br>
      Pulled: ${snap.last_pull_utc}<br>
      Geo: ${snap.acs ? snap.acs.geoKey : "n/a"}<br>
      <span class="muted">Stored in localStorage; later versions will persist audited snapshots.</span>`;
  }catch(e){
    el.textContent = "Snapshot unavailable: " + e;
  }
}

document.getElementById('geo').addEventListener('change', pullACS);
document.getElementById('acsYear').addEventListener('change', pullACS);
document.getElementById('win').addEventListener('change', pullBLS);

pullACS();
pullBLS();
</script>
"""

hh_script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const modeEl = document.getElementById('mode');
  const presetEl = document.getElementById('preset');
  const geoEl = document.getElementById('geoSelect');
  const bandEl = document.getElementById('band');
  const incomeEl = document.getElementById('income');
  const incomeVal = document.getElementById('incomeVal');
  const hhEl = document.getElementById('hh');
  const locEl = document.getElementById('loc');
  const housingEl = document.getElementById('housing');
  const sdebtEl = document.getElementById('sdebt');
  const mdebtEl = document.getElementById('mdebt');
  const results = document.getElementById('results');
  const baselineStatus = document.getElementById('baselineStatus');

  const j = await (await fetch('/data/finance/household_translation_scaffold.json')).json();
  const fiscal = await (await fetch('/data/finance/fiscal_and_debt_model_scaffold.json')).json();
  const li = await (await fetch('/data/finance/budget_line_items_scaffold.json')).json();

  function money(n){
    const x = Number(n);
    if(!isFinite(x)) return String(n);
    return '$' + Math.round(x).toLocaleString();
  }
  function fmt(n){
    const x = Math.round(Number(n));
    return '$' + x.toLocaleString();
  }
  function pct(x){
    const n = Number(x);
    if(!isFinite(n)) return String(x);
    return (n*100).toFixed(1) + '%';
  }
  function rampFactor(ramp, y){
    if(!ramp) return 1;
    if(ramp.kind === 's_curve'){
      const m = ramp.midpoint_year || 10;
      const k = ramp.steepness || 0.5;
      return 1/(1+Math.exp(-k*(y-m)));
    }
    return 1;
  }

  function rampFactorItem(item, y){
    const r = item.ramp || {};
    if(r.kind === 'linear'){
      const s = r.start_year || 1;
      const e = r.end_year || s;
      if(y <= s) return 0;
      if(y >= e) return 1;
      return (y - s) / (e - s);
    }
    if(r.kind === 's_curve'){
      const m = r.midpoint_year || 8;
      const k = r.steepness || 0.6;
      return 1/(1+Math.exp(-k*(y-m)));
    }
    if(r.kind === 'front_load'){
      const years = (r.years || []);
      if(years.length === 0) return 0;
      const maxY = Math.max(...years);
      if(y <= 1) return 0;
      if(y >= maxY) return 1;
      return Math.min(1, y / maxY);
    }
    return 1;
  }

  function lineItemEffect(band, year){
    let sum = 0;
    for(const item of li.wmr.items){
      const steady = item.annual_steady_state_usd[band];
      sum += steady * rampFactorItem(item, year);
    }
    return sum;
  }

  function studentDebtScale(level){ if(level==='none') return 0; if(level==='some') return 1; return 2.0; }
  function medicalDebtScale(level){ if(level==='none') return 0; if(level==='some') return 1; return 2.0; }
  function locationScale(loc){
    if(loc==='urban') return {transport:0.7, broadband:1.0, housing:1.2};
    if(loc==='suburban') return {transport:1.0, broadband:1.0, housing:1.0};
    return {transport:1.3, broadband:1.0, housing:0.9};
  }

  async function pullCensus(vars, geoKey, dataset){
    const cfg = j.observed_baseline?.census;
    const geoMap = j.observed_baseline?.geo_defaults || {};
    if(!cfg || !geoMap[geoKey]) return null;
    const year = cfg.year || "2023";
    const ds = dataset || cfg.dataset || "acs/acs5";
    const geo = geoMap[geoKey];
    const get = ["NAME"].concat(vars).join(",");
    let url = `/api/census?year=${encodeURIComponent(year)}&dataset=${encodeURIComponent(ds)}&get=${encodeURIComponent(get)}&for=${encodeURIComponent(geo.for)}`;
    if(geo.in) url += `&in=${encodeURIComponent(geo.in)}`;
    const r = await fetch(url);
    if(!r.ok) return null;
    const arr = await r.json();
    const header = arr[0], row = arr[1];
    const out = { name: row[header.indexOf("NAME")], year };
    for(const v of vars){
      out[v] = Number(row[header.indexOf(v)]);
    }
    return out;
  }

  function safeDiv(a,b){
    a=Number(a); b=Number(b);
    if(!isFinite(a) || !isFinite(b) || b<=0) return null;
    return a/b;
  }

  function extractSeries(blsJson, seriesId){
    try{ return blsJson.Results.series.find(x=>x.seriesID===seriesId)?.data || null; }catch{ return null; }
  }
  function pickYearAvg(series, year){
    if(!series) return null;
    const vals = series.filter(d=>d.year===String(year)).map(d=>Number(d.value)).filter(v=>isFinite(v));
    if(!vals.length) return null;
    return vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/vals.length;
  }
  function cagr(a,b,years){
    if(!(a>0) || !(b>0) || years<=0) return null;
    return Math.pow(b/a, 1/years)-1;
  }

  async function fetchBLSInflationCAGR(){
    const cfg = j.observed_baseline?.bls;
    if(!cfg) return null;
    const win = cfg.window || {startyear:"2015", endyear:"2025"};
    const seriesId = cfg.series?.cpi_u_all_items || "CUUR0000SA0";
    const payload = { seriesid:[seriesId], startyear:String(win.startyear), endyear:String(win.endyear) };
    const r = await fetch("/api/bls", { method:"POST", headers:{"content-type":"application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
    if(!r.ok) return null;
    const bj = await r.json();
    const s = extractSeries(bj, seriesId);
    const y0 = Number(win.startyear), y1 = Number(win.endyear);
    const v0 = pickYearAvg(s, y0);
    const v1 = pickYearAvg(s, y1);
    const g = cagr(v0, v1, (y1-y0));
    if(g===null) return null;
    return { seriesId, startyear:y0, endyear:y1, cagr:g };
  }

  function pwfTotalsByYear(band, years){
    const sp = fiscal.starting_point_placeholders || {};
    const debt0 = sp.gross_federal_debt_usd_sep30_2025 || 27_000_000_000_000;
    const gdp0 = sp.nominal_gdp_usd_saar_q3_2025 || 27_000_000_000_000;

    const shares = (fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework && fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework.default_shares)
      ? fiscal.wmr.rules.surplus_allocation_framework.default_shares[band]
      : (li.wmr.surplus_allocation_defaults ? li.wmr.surplus_allocation_defaults[band] : {debt_paydown:0.6,peoples_wealth_fund:0.25,reinvestment:0.15});

    const r = sp.interest_rate_effective[band];
    const r_w = Math.max(0, r - fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.interest_rate_risk_premium_reduction[band]);

    const sq_real = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.real_gdp_growth[band];
    const sq_inf = fiscal.status_quo.assumptions.inflation[band];
    const w_uplift = fiscal.wmr.mechanisms.net_growth_uplift_from_infrastructure[band];
    const w_real = sq_real + w_uplift;
    const w_inf = sq_inf;

    const prim0 = sp.primary_deficit_status_quo_usd[band];

    let debt = debt0, gdp=gdp0, pwf=0;
    const out=[];
    for(let t=1;t<=years;t++){
      const interest = debt * r_w;
      const improvement = lineItemEffect(band, t);
      const prim = prim0 * (1 + 0.01*(t-1)) - improvement;
      let pay=0, pwfAdd=0;
      if(prim < 0){
        const surplus = -prim;
        pay = surplus * shares.debt_paydown;
        pwfAdd = surplus * shares.peoples_wealth_fund;
      }
      debt = debt + prim + interest;
      if(pay>0) debt -= pay;
      gdp = gdp * (1 + w_real + w_inf);
      pwf += pwfAdd;
      out.push({year:t, pwf_total:pwf});
    }
    return out;
  }

  function baselineCacheKey(mode, preset, band, geoKey){
    return `wmr_baseline_v54:${mode}:${preset}:${band}:${geoKey}`;
  }

  async function compute(){
    const mode = modeEl.value;
    const band = bandEl.value;
    const preset = presetEl.value;
    const geoOverride = geoEl.value;
    const income = Number(incomeEl.value);
    const hhSize = Number(hhEl.value);
    const loc = locEl.value;
    const housing = housingEl.value;
    const sd = sdebtEl.value;
    const md = mdebtEl.value;

    incomeVal.textContent = money(income);

    // default scaffold
    let sqGrowth = j.status_quo.growth_rates_annual[band];

    // Determine geoKey
    let geoKey = "us";
    const presetMap = j.observed_baseline?.preset_geo_mapping || {};
    if(presetMap[preset]?.geo) geoKey = presetMap[preset].geo;
    if(geoOverride && geoOverride !== "auto") geoKey = geoOverride;

    // baseline anchors
    let housingAnchor = null; // annual
    let broadbandProxy = null; // percent/metric
    let rentBurden30 = null;
    let rentBurden50 = null;
    let commuteOver30 = null;
    let commuteOver60 = null;

    let observed = { geoKey, acs:null, dist:null, infl:null };

    if(mode === "observed"){
      const cfg = j.observed_baseline?.census?.vars || {};
      const vIncome = cfg.median_household_income;
      const vRent = cfg.median_gross_rent;
      const vOwnM = cfg.median_owner_cost_mortgage;
      const vOwnN = cfg.median_owner_cost_no_mortgage;

      const vars = [vIncome, vRent, vOwnM, vOwnN].filter(Boolean);
      const [acs, infl] = await Promise.all([
        pullCensus(vars, geoKey, "acs/acs5").catch(()=>null),
        fetchBLSInflationCAGR().catch(()=>null)
      ]);

      // Pull distributions
      const rentDistVars = ["B25070_001E","B25070_007E","B25070_008E","B25070_009E","B25070_010E"];
      const commuteVars = ["B08303_001E","B08303_008E","B08303_009E","B08303_010E","B08303_011E","B08303_012E","B08303_013E"];
      const broadVar = cfg.broadband_subscriptions_total ? [cfg.broadband_subscriptions_total] : [];
      const [rentDist, commuteDist, broad] = await Promise.all([
        pullCensus(rentDistVars, geoKey, "acs/acs5").catch(()=>null),
        pullCensus(commuteVars, geoKey, "acs/acs5").catch(()=>null),
        broadVar.length ? pullCensus(broadVar, geoKey, (j.observed_baseline?.census?.subject_dataset || "acs/acs5/subject")).catch(()=>null) : Promise.resolve(null)
      ]);

      observed.acs = acs;
      observed.dist = { rentDist, commuteDist, broad };
      observed.infl = infl;

      if(acs && vIncome && !Number.isNaN(acs[vIncome]) && incomeEl.dataset.userMoved !== "1"){
        incomeEl.value = String(Math.round(acs[vIncome]/1000)*1000);
      }
      if(infl && infl.cagr!=null){
        sqGrowth = infl.cagr;
      }

      // Housing anchor: annual median costs
      if(acs){
        if(housing === "renter" and vRent and isFinite(acs[vRent])):
          pass
      }
    }

    // Re-read income (after potential update)
    const income2 = Number(incomeEl.value);
    incomeVal.textContent = money(income2);

    const scale = locationScale(loc);

    // Status quo annual burdens (scaled)
    const sq = j.status_quo.annual_burdens_usd;

    // WMR relief
    const w = j.wmr.annual_relief_usd;

    // Dividend from PWF
    const div = j.wmr.people_dividend_usd;
    const payoutRate = div.payout_rate_annual[band];
    const households = div.estimated_households.value;
    const divRamp = div.phase_in_ramp;
    const divCap = div.cap_per_household_usd[band];

    // Net tax change
    const tax = j.wmr.transition_taxes_net_usd;
    const taxBase = tax[band][band];

    const pwfSeries = pwfTotalsByYear(band, 50);

    // Compute anchors and distribution derived factors if observed
    let housingPressureFactor = 1.0
    let mobilityPressureFactor = 1.0
    let broadbandPressureFactor = 1.0

    if(mode==="observed" && observed.acs){
      const cfg = j.observed_baseline?.census?.vars || {};
      const vRent = cfg.median_gross_rent;
      const vOwnM = cfg.median_owner_cost_mortgage;

      if(housing==="renter" && vRent && isFinite(observed.acs[vRent])){
        housingAnchor = Number(observed.acs[vRent]) * 12;
      } else if(housing==="owner" && vOwnM && isFinite(observed.acs[vOwnM])) {
        housingAnchor = Number(observed.acs[vOwnM]) * 12;
      }
      if(housingAnchor){
        // Map annual median cost to a factor relative to scaffold housing pressure: bigger anchor => bigger factor
        housingPressureFactor = Math.max(0.7, Math.min(1.6, housingAnchor / 18000)); // 18k/yr anchor baseline
      }
    }

    if(mode==="observed" && observed.dist){
      const rd = observed.dist.rentDist;
      const cd = observed.dist.commuteDist;
      const bd = observed.dist.broad;
      if(rd){
        rentBurden30 = safeDiv(rd.B25070_007E + rd.B25070_008E + rd.B25070_009E + rd.B25070_010E, rd.B25070_001E);
        rentBurden50 = safeDiv(rd.B25070_010E, rd.B25070_001E);
        if(rentBurden30!=null){
          // Map 30%+ burden to factor
          housingPressureFactor *= Math.max(0.85, Math.min(1.25, 0.85 + rentBurden30*0.6));
        }
      }
      if(cd){
        commuteOver30 = safeDiv(cd.B08303_008E + cd.B08303_009E + cd.B08303_010E + cd.B08303_011E + cd.B08303_012E + cd.B08303_013E, cd.B08303_001E);
        commuteOver60 = safeDiv(cd.B08303_012E + cd.B08303_013E, cd.B08303_001E);
        if(commuteOver30!=null){
          mobilityPressureFactor = Math.max(0.8, Math.min(1.4, 0.85 + commuteOver30*0.9));
        }
      }
      if(bd){
        // Assume subject var returns percent (0-100)
        const key = Object.keys(bd).find(k=>k.startsWith("S2801_"));
        if(key && isFinite(bd[key])){
          broadbandProxy = bd[key];
          const p = broadbandProxy;
          broadbandPressureFactor = Math.max(0.75, Math.min(1.35, 1.35 - (p/100)*0.6));
        }
      }
    }

    function annualSQ(year){
      const g = Math.pow(1+sqGrowth, year-1);

      const hc = sq.healthcare_premiums_out_of_pocket[band] * g;
      const sl = sq.student_loan_payments[band] * studentDebtScale(sd) * g;
      const mdp = sq.medical_debt_payments[band] * medicalDebtScale(md) * g;

      const hpress = sq.housing_cost_pressure[band] * housingPressureFactor * (housing==='renter' ? 1.0 : 0.6) * scale.housing * g;
      const tpress = sq.transport_cost_pressure[band] * mobilityPressureFactor * scale.transport * g;
      const bb = sq.broadband_cost[band] * broadbandPressureFactor * scale.broadband * g;

      return hc + sl + mdp + hpress + tpress + bb;
    }

    function annualDividend(year){
      const pwfTotal = pwfSeries[year-1].pwf_total;
      const raw = (payoutRate * pwfTotal) / households;
      const phased = raw * rampFactor(divRamp, year);
      const capped = Math.min(phased, divCap);
      const hhMod = (0.75 + 0.1*Math.min(4, hhSize));
      return capped * hhMod;
    }

    function annualWMR(year){
      const hcRel = w.healthcare_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/3);
      const eduRel = w.education_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/3) * studentDebtScale(sd);
      const medRel = w.medical_debt_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/2) * medicalDebtScale(md);
      const bbRel = w.broadband_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/4) * scale.broadband;
      const trRel = w.transport_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/6) * scale.transport;
      const hoRel = w.housing_relief[band] * Math.min(1, year/6) * (housing==='renter' ? 1.0 : 0.6) * scale.housing;
      const dividend = annualDividend(year);
      const taxAdj = (income2 > 120000 ? (taxBase*0.5) : (income2 < 50000 ? (taxBase*1.2) : taxBase));
      return annualSQ(year) - (hcRel + eduRel + medRel + bbRel + trRel + hoRel) - dividend + taxAdj;
    }

    const horizons = j.meta.horizons;
    const rows = horizons.map(H => {
      let cumSQ=0, cumW=0, cumDiv=0;
      for(let y=1;y<=H;y++){
        cumSQ += annualSQ(y);
        cumW += annualWMR(y);
        cumDiv += annualDividend(y);
      }
      return {H, cumSQ, cumW, delta: cumW - cumSQ, cumDiv};
    });

    const r10 = rows.find(x=>x.H===10);
    const r50 = rows.find(x=>x.H===50);

    // Baseline status
    let baseText = `Mode: assumptions (offline)`;
    if(mode==="observed"){
      baseText =
        `Mode: observed baseline • Geo: <b>${geoKey}</b><br>` +
        `Housing factor: <b>${housingPressureFactor.toFixed(2)}</b> • Mobility factor: <b>${mobilityPressureFactor.toFixed(2)}</b> • Broadband factor: <b>${broadbandPressureFactor.toFixed(2)}</b><br>` +
        `Rent burden 30%+: ${rentBurden30==null ? "n/a" : "<b>"+pct(rentBurden30)+"</b>"} • Commute over 30 min: ${commuteOver30==null ? "n/a" : "<b>"+pct(commuteOver30)+"</b>"}`;
    }
    baselineStatus.innerHTML = `<b>Baseline</b><br>${baseText}<br><span class="muted">Distributions: <a href="/pages/distributions.html"><b>Distributions</b></a> • Baselines: <a href="/pages/baselines.html"><b>Dashboard</b></a></span>`;

    let html = `<div class="callout"><b>Headline (placeholder)</b><br>`
      + `10y Δ: <b>${fmt(r10.delta)}</b> • 50y Δ: <b>${fmt(r50.delta)}</b><br>`
      + `<span class="muted">V54 uses observed distributions to adjust housing/mobility pressure when available.</span>`
      + `</div>`;

    html += '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Horizon</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Status quo (cumulative burden)</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR (cumulative burden)</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Dividend received (cum.)</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ (WMR − SQ)</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for(const r of rows){
      html += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${r.H}y</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.cumSQ)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.cumW)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.cumDiv)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmt(r.delta)}</b></td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';

    // Export simple proxies for QoL to localStorage (for same geo/preset/band)
    try{
      const exportObj = {
        version:"v54",
        geoKey, preset, band,
        rent_burden_30_plus: rentBurden30,
        rent_burden_50_plus: rentBurden50,
        commute_over_30: commuteOver30,
        commute_over_60: commuteOver60,
        factors:{housingPressureFactor, mobilityPressureFactor, broadbandPressureFactor}
      };
      localStorage.setItem("wmr_qol_proxies_v54", JSON.stringify(exportObj));
    }catch(e){}

    results.innerHTML = html;
  }

  incomeEl.addEventListener('input', () => { incomeEl.dataset.userMoved = "1"; });

  [modeEl, presetEl, geoEl, bandEl, hhEl, locEl, housingEl, sdebtEl, mdebtEl].forEach(el=>{
    el.addEventListener('change', compute);
  });
  incomeEl.addEventListener('input', compute);

  compute();
})();
</script>
"""

import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, math, datetime

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v54.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v55"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")
data=os.path.join(work,"data")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

# Base template and thoughts block
template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

qol_script = """
<script>
(function(){
  const horizons = [1,5,10,20,50];
  const dims = [
    {key:"economic_burden", name:"Economic Burden", weight:0.25},
    {key:"housing_security", name:"Housing Security", weight:0.18},
    {key:"mobility_time", name:"Mobility & Time", weight:0.12},
    {key:"health_access", name:"Health Access", weight:0.18},
    {key:"education_opportunity", name:"Education Opportunity", weight:0.12},
    {key:"democracy_trust", name:"Democracy & Trust", weight:0.15},
  ];

  // Pull proxy exported by household-impact in V54 if available
  let proxy = null;
  try{ proxy = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("wmr_qol_proxies_v54")||"null"); }catch(e){}

  function clamp(x,a,b){ return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x)); }
  function scoreFromRentBurden(rb30){
    // rb30 in 0..1
    if(rb30==null) return null;
    // map 0.2 -> 70, 0.6 -> 40 (linear)
    const s = 85 - rb30*75;
    return clamp(s, 15, 85);
  }
  function scoreFromCommute(cm30){
    if(cm30==null) return null;
    const s = 85 - cm30*65;
    return clamp(s, 20, 85);
  }

  function statusQuoDimScores(h){
    // baseline placeholders with mild trend
    const t = Math.log(1+h)/Math.log(51);
    let housing = 45 + 10*t;
    let mobility = 45 + 10*t;
    if(proxy){
      const hs = scoreFromRentBurden(proxy.rent_burden_30_plus);
      if(hs!=null) housing = hs;
      const ms = scoreFromCommute(proxy.commute_over_30);
      if(ms!=null) mobility = ms;
    }
    return {
      economic_burden: 40 + 8*t,
      housing_security: housing,
      mobility_time: mobility,
      health_access: 38 + 6*t,
      education_opportunity: 45 + 6*t,
      democracy_trust: 35 + 5*t
    };
  }

  function wmrDimScores(h){
    // WMR improves with time; if proxies exist, assume gradual reduction of those burdens
    const t = Math.log(1+h)/Math.log(51);
    let housing = 60 + 22*t;
    let mobility = 62 + 18*t;
    if(proxy){
      // reduce rent burden by 40% at 20y and 55% at 50y (placeholder)
      const rb = proxy.rent_burden_30_plus;
      if(rb!=null){
        const reduction = (h>=50)?0.55:(h>=20)?0.40:(h>=10)?0.28:(h>=5)?0.16:0.08;
        const hs = scoreFromRentBurden(rb*(1-reduction));
        if(hs!=null) housing = clamp(hs + 12, 0, 100);
      }
      const cm = proxy.commute_over_30;
      if(cm!=null){
        const reduction = (h>=50)?0.45:(h>=20)?0.33:(h>=10)?0.22:(h>=5)?0.12:0.06;
        const ms = scoreFromCommute(cm*(1-reduction));
        if(ms!=null) mobility = clamp(ms + 10, 0, 100);
      }
    }
    return {
      economic_burden: 58 + 25*t,
      housing_security: housing,
      mobility_time: mobility,
      health_access: 62 + 28*t,
      education_opportunity: 60 + 24*t,
      democracy_trust: 55 + 20*t
    };
  }

  function composite(scores){
    let s=0;
    for(const d of dims){
      s += (scores[d.key]||0) * d.weight;
    }
    return s;
  }

  const rows = horizons.map(h=>{
    const sq = statusQuoDimScores(h);
    const w = wmrDimScores(h);
    return {
      h,
      sq_total: composite(sq),
      w_total: composite(w),
      sq, w
    };
  });

  function fmt(x){ return (Math.round(x*10)/10).toFixed(1); }

  // Render table
  let html = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
    + '<thead><tr>'
    + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Horizon</th>'
    + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Status quo QoL</th>'
    + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR QoL</th>'
    + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ</th>'
    + '</tr></thead><tbody>';
  for(const r of rows){
    const delta = r.w_total - r.sq_total;
    html += '<tr>'
      + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${r.h}y</b></td>`
      + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.sq_total)}</td>`
      + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.w_total)}</td>`
      + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmt(delta)}</b></td>`
      + '</tr>';
  }
  html += '</tbody></table>';
  document.getElementById('qolTable').innerHTML = html;

  // Render drivers breakdown for 10y and 50y
  function driverBlock(label, r){
    let b = `<div class="callout"><b>${label}</b><br><span class="muted">Dimension scores (0–100)</span><br>`;
    for(const d of dims){
      b += `<b>${d.name}</b>: SQ ${fmt(r.sq[d.key])} → WMR ${fmt(r.w[d.key])}<br>`;
    }
    b += '</div>';
    return b;
  }
  const r10 = rows.find(x=>x.h===10);
  const r50 = rows.find(x=>x.h===50);
  const proxTxt = proxy ? `Using observed proxies for geo: <b>${proxy.geoKey}</b> (preset ${proxy.preset})` : 'No observed proxies found yet (run Household Impact in observed mode to export).';
  document.getElementById('qolDrivers').innerHTML =
    `<div class="note"><b>Data context:</b> ${proxTxt}</div>`
    + driverBlock("Drivers at 10 years", r10)
    + driverBlock("Drivers at 50 years", r50);

})();
</script>
"""

       "baseline":"ACS B25070 rent burden + medians","transform":"rent_burden_to_score","scenario":"rent_burden_reduction_curve"},
      {"key":"mobility_time","name":"Mobility & Time","weight":0.12,
       "baseline":"ACS B08303 commute distribution","transform":"commute_burden_to_score","scenario":"commute_burden_reduction_curve"},
      {"key":"health_access","name":"Health Access","weight":0.18,
       "baseline":"placeholder (future: CDC, CMS)","transform":"placeholder_score_curve","scenario":"health_access_gain_curve"},
      {"key":"education_opportunity","name":"Education Opportunity","weight":0.12,
       "baseline":"placeholder (future: NCES)","transform":"placeholder_score_curve","scenario":"education_gain_curve"},
      {"key":"democracy_trust","name":"Democracy & Trust","weight":0.15,
       "baseline":"placeholder (future: turnout, corruption metrics)","transform":"placeholder_score_curve","scenario":"democracy_trust_gain_curve"}
    ],
    "transforms":{
      "rent_burden_to_score":{
        "input":"rent_burden_30_plus",
        "notes":"Maps rent burden (0..1) to 0..100; higher burden -> lower score.",
        "formula":"score = clamp(85 - rb*75, 15, 85)"
      },
      "commute_burden_to_score":{
        "input":"commute_over_30",
        "notes":"Maps commute burden (0..1) to 0..100; higher burden -> lower score.",
        "formula":"score = clamp(85 - cm*65, 20, 85)"
      }
    },
    "phase_curves":{
      "default_log_curve":{
        "notes":"Generic gradual improvement curve for 1..50 years.",
        "formula":"t = log(1+h)/log(51)"
      },
      "rent_reduction_curve":{
        "notes":"Reduces rent burden over time to reach scenario target by 50y.",
        "anchors":[
          {"h":1,"fraction_of_50y":0.15},
          {"h":5,"fraction_of_50y":0.30},
          {"h":10,"fraction_of_50y":0.50},
          {"h":20,"fraction_of_50y":0.75},
          {"h":50,"fraction_of_50y":1.00}
        ]
      },
      "commute_reduction_curve":{
        "anchors":[
          {"h":1,"fraction_of_50y":0.10},
          {"h":5,"fraction_of_50y":0.25},
          {"h":10,"fraction_of_50y":0.45},
          {"h":20,"fraction_of_50y":0.70},
          {"h":50,"fraction_of_50y":1.00}
        ]

      "gain_curve_generic":{

          {"h":1,"fraction_of_50y":0.10},

          {"h":10,"fraction_of_50y":0.45},
          {"h":20,"fraction_of_50y":0.72},
          {"h":50,"fraction_of_50y":1.00}
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

scenario_script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const presetEl = document.getElementById('scenarioPreset');
  const rent50 = document.getElementById('rent50');
  const commute50 = document.getElementById('commute50');
  const health50 = document.getElementById('health50');
  const edu50 = document.getElementById('edu50');
  const demo50 = document.getElementById('demo50');
  const explain = document.getElementById('presetExplain');

  const rent50Val = document.getElementById('rent50Val');
  const commute50Val = document.getElementById('commute50Val');
  const health50Val = document.getElementById('health50Val');
  const edu50Val = document.getElementById('edu50Val');
  const demo50Val = document.getElementById('demo50Val');

  const eng = await (await fetch('/data/trajectories/trajectory_engine_v56.json')).json();

  function pct(x){ return (Number(x)*100).toFixed(0)+'%'; }

  function loadFromStorage(){
    try{
      const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('wmr_scenario_v56')||'null');
      return s;
    }catch(e){ return null; }
  }

  function save(){
    const obj = {
      version:"v56",
      preset: presetEl.value,
      params:{
        rent_burden_reduction_50y:Number(rent50.value),
        commute_burden_reduction_50y:Number(commute50.value),
        health_access_gain_50y:Number(health50.value),
        education_gain_50y:Number(edu50.value),
        democracy_trust_gain_50y:Number(demo50.value)
      },
      updated_utc: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    localStorage.setItem('wmr_scenario_v56', JSON.stringify(obj));
    renderExplain(obj);
    renderVals();
  }

  function renderVals(){
    rent50Val.textContent = pct(rent50.value);
    commute50Val.textContent = pct(commute50.value);
    health50Val.textContent = pct(health50.value);
    edu50Val.textContent = pct(edu50.value);
    demo50Val.textContent = pct(demo50.value);
  }

  function applyPreset(name){
    const p = eng.scenarios[name];
    if(!p) return;
    const params = p.params;
    rent50.value = params.rent_burden_reduction_50y;
    commute50.value = params.commute_burden_reduction_50y;
    health50.value = params.health_access_gain_50y;
    edu50.value = params.education_gain_50y;
    demo50.value = params.democracy_trust_gain_50y;
    renderVals();
  }

  function renderExplain(obj){
    const p = eng.scenarios[obj.preset];
    explain.innerHTML = `<b>${p.label}</b><br>
      Rent burden target (50y): <b>${pct(obj.params.rent_burden_reduction_50y)}</b><br>
      Commute burden target (50y): <b>${pct(obj.params.commute_burden_reduction_50y)}</b><br>
      Health access gain (50y): <b>${pct(obj.params.health_access_gain_50y)}</b><br>
      Education gain (50y): <b>${pct(obj.params.education_gain_50y)}</b><br>
      Democracy & trust gain (50y): <b>${pct(obj.params.democracy_trust_gain_50y)}</b><br>
      <span class="muted">Updated: ${obj.updated_utc}</span>`;
  }

  // init from stored scenario or moderate preset
  const stored = loadFromStorage();
  if(stored && stored.params){
    presetEl.value = stored.preset || 'moderate';
    rent50.value = stored.params.rent_burden_reduction_50y ?? rent50.value;
    commute50.value = stored.params.commute_burden_reduction_50y ?? commute50.value;
    health50.value = stored.params.health_access_gain_50y ?? health50.value;
    edu50.value = stored.params.education_gain_50y ?? edu50.value;
    demo50.value = stored.params.democracy_trust_gain_50y ?? demo50.value;
    renderVals();
    renderExplain({...stored, updated_utc: stored.updated_utc || new Date().toISOString()});
  } else {
    applyPreset('moderate');
    save();
  }

  presetEl.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
    applyPreset(presetEl.value);
    save();
  });
  [rent50,commute50,health50,edu50,demo50].forEach(el=>{
    el.addEventListener('input', save);
  });

})();
</script>
"""

qol_script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const horizons = [1,5,10,20,50];
  const eng = await (await fetch('/data/trajectories/trajectory_engine_v56.json')).json();

  const dims = eng.qol_index.dimensions;

  // proxies exported by household-impact (V54)
  let proxy = null;
  try{ proxy = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("wmr_qol_proxies_v54")||"null"); }catch(e){}

  // scenario (V56)
  let scenario = null;
  try{ scenario = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("wmr_scenario_v56")||"null"); }catch(e){}
  if(!scenario || !scenario.params){
    scenario = { preset:"moderate", params: eng.scenarios.moderate.params };
  }

  function clamp(x,a,b){ return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x)); }
  function fmt(x){ return (Math.round(Number(x)*10)/10).toFixed(1); }
  function pct(x){ return (Number(x)*100).toFixed(0)+'%'; }

  function fractionFromAnchors(anchors, h){
    // anchors is sorted by h
    const a = anchors.slice().sort((x,y)=>x.h-y.h);
    if(h <= a[0].h) return a[0].fraction_of_50y;
    if(h >= a[a.length-1].h) return a[a.length-1].fraction_of_50y;
    for(let i=0;i<a.length-1;i++){
      const lo=a[i], hi=a[i+1];
      if(h>=lo.h && h<=hi.h){
        const t=(h-lo.h)/(hi.h-lo.h);
        return lo.fraction_of_50y + t*(hi.fraction_of_50y - lo.fraction_of_50y);
      }
    }
    return 1.0;
  }

  function rentScore(rb){
    if(rb==null) return null;
    return clamp(85 - rb*75, 15, 85);
  }
  function commuteScore(cm){
    if(cm==null) return null;
    return clamp(85 - cm*65, 20, 85);
  }

  function sqScores(h){
    const t = Math.log(1+h)/Math.log(51);
    let housing = 45 + 10*t;
    let mobility = 45 + 10*t;
    if(proxy){
      const hs = rentScore(proxy.rent_burden_30_plus);
      if(hs!=null) housing = hs;
      const ms = commuteScore(proxy.commute_over_30);
      if(ms!=null) mobility = ms;
    }
    return {
      economic_burden: 40 + 8*t,
      housing_security: housing,
      mobility_time: mobility,
      health_access: 38 + 6*t,
      education_opportunity: 45 + 6*t,
      democracy_trust: 35 + 5*t
    };
  }

  function wmrScores(h){
    const t = Math.log(1+h)/Math.log(51);

    let housing = 60 + 22*t;
    let mobility = 62 + 18*t;

    // If proxy exists, apply rent/commute reductions using scenario targets + phase curves
    if(proxy){
      const rb = proxy.rent_burden_30_plus;
      if(rb!=null){
        const target = scenario.params.rent_burden_reduction_50y;
        const frac = fractionFromAnchors(eng.qol_index.phase_curves.rent_reduction_curve.anchors, h);
        const reduced = rb * (1 - target*frac);
        const hs = rentScore(reduced);
        if(hs!=null) housing = clamp(hs + 12, 0, 100);
      }
      const cm = proxy.commute_over_30;
      if(cm!=null){
        const target = scenario.params.commute_burden_reduction_50y;
        const frac = fractionFromAnchors(eng.qol_index.phase_curves.commute_reduction_curve.anchors, h);
        const reduced = cm * (1 - target*frac);
        const ms = commuteScore(reduced);
        if(ms!=null) mobility = clamp(ms + 10, 0, 100);
      }
    }

    const gfrac = fractionFromAnchors(eng.qol_index.phase_curves.gain_curve_generic.anchors, h);
    const health = clamp(55 + scenario.params.health_access_gain_50y*100*gfrac, 0, 100);
    const edu = clamp(52 + scenario.params.education_gain_50y*100*gfrac, 0, 100);
    const demo = clamp(50 + scenario.params.democracy_trust_gain_50y*100*gfrac, 0, 100);

    return {
      economic_burden: 58 + 25*t,
      housing_security: housing,
      mobility_time: mobility,
      health_access: health,
      education_opportunity: edu,
      democracy_trust: demo
    };
  }

  function composite(scores){
    let s=0;
    for(const d of dims){
      s += (scores[d.key]||0) * d.weight;
    }
    return s;
  }

  const rows = horizons.map(h=>{
    const sq = sqScores(h);
    const w = wmrScores(h);
    return {h, sq_total: composite(sq), w_total: composite(w), sq, w};
  });

  // Render table
  let html = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
    + '<thead><tr>'
    + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Horizon</th>'
    + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Status quo QoL</th>'
    + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR QoL</th>'
    + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ</th>'
    + '</tr></thead><tbody>';
  for(const r of rows){
    const delta = r.w_total - r.sq_total;
    html += '<tr>'
      + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${r.h}y</b></td>`
      + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.sq_total)}</td>`
      + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.w_total)}</td>`
      + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmt(delta)}</b></td>`
      + '</tr>';
  }
  html += '</tbody></table>';
  document.getElementById('qolTable').innerHTML = html;

  // Drivers breakdown at 10y and 50y
  function driverBlock(label, r){
    let b = `<div class="callout"><b>${label}</b><br><span class="muted">Dimension scores (0–100)</span><br>`;
    for(const d of dims){
      b += `<b>${d.name}</b>: SQ ${fmt(r.sq[d.key])} → WMR ${fmt(r.w[d.key])}<br>`;
    }
    b += '</div>';
    return b;
  }
  const r10 = rows.find(x=>x.h===10);
  const r50 = rows.find(x=>x.h===50);

  const proxTxt = proxy ? `Using observed proxies for geo: <b>${proxy.geoKey}</b> (preset ${proxy.preset})` : 'No observed proxies found yet (run Household Impact in observed mode to export).';
  const scenTxt = `Scenario: <b>${scenario.preset}</b> — rent reduction ${pct(scenario.params.rent_burden_reduction_50y)}, commute reduction ${pct(scenario.params.commute_burden_reduction_50y)}. <a href="/pages/scenario-panel.html"><b>Adjust</b></a>`;
  document.getElementById('qolDrivers').innerHTML =
    `<div class="note"><b>Data context:</b> ${proxTxt}<br><b>Scenario:</b> ${scenTxt}</div>`
    + driverBlock("Drivers at 10 years", r10)
    + driverBlock("Drivers at 50 years", r50);

})();
</script>
"""
qol_html = qol_html.replace("</body>", qol_script+"\n</body>")
write(qol_path, qol_html)

            full=os.path.join(root,f)
            rel=os.path.relpath(full,work)
            z.write(full,rel)

import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, math

src="/mnt/data/wmr_site_netlify_v56.zip"
work="/mnt/data/wmr_site_v57"
if os.path.exists(work):
    shutil.rmtree(work)
os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")
data=os.path.join(work,"data")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

# Load template and thoughts block for page generation
template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

scorecard_script = """
<script>
(async function(){
  const horizons = [1,5,10,20,50];

  const eng = await (await fetch('/data/trajectories/pillar_engine_v57.json')).json();

  // Load scenario (V56)
  let scenario = null;
  try{ scenario = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("wmr_scenario_v56")||"null"); }catch(e){}
  if(!scenario || !scenario.params){
    scenario = { preset:"moderate", params: (await (await fetch('/data/trajectories/trajectory_engine_v56.json')).json()).scenarios.moderate.params };
  }

  // Proxies (V54 export)
  let proxy = null;
  try{ proxy = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("wmr_qol_proxies_v54")||"null"); }catch(e){}

  const pillarSelect = document.getElementById('pillarSelect');
  const scenarioLabel = document.getElementById('scenarioLabel');
  const tableEl = document.getElementById('pillarTable');
  const driversEl = document.getElementById('pillarDrivers');

  function clamp(x,a,b){ return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x)); }

  function fractionFromAnchors(anchors, h){
    const a = anchors.slice().sort((x,y)=>x.h-y.h);
    if(h <= a[0].h) return a[0].f;
    if(h >= a[a.length-1].h) return a[a.length-1].f;
    for(let i=0;i<a.length-1;i++){
      const lo=a[i], hi=a[i+1];
      if(h>=lo.h && h<=hi.h){
        const t=(h-lo.h)/(hi.h-lo.h);
        return lo.f + t*(hi.f - lo.f);
      }
    }
    return 1.0;
  }

  function fmt(x){ return (Math.round(Number(x)*10)/10).toFixed(1); }
  function pct(x){ return (Number(x)*100).toFixed(0)+'%'; }

  function getPillar(key){
    return eng.pillars.find(p=>p.key===key);
  }

  function observedValue(obsPath){
    // obsPath like "wmr_qol_proxies_v54.rent_burden_30_plus"
    if(!obsPath) return null;
    const parts = obsPath.split('.');
    const root = parts.shift();
    let obj = null;
    if(root === "wmr_qol_proxies_v54") obj = proxy;
    // could add baselines snapshot later
    if(!obj) return null;
    for(const p of parts){
      if(obj && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj,p)){
        obj = obj[p];
      } else return null;
    }
    return obj;
  }

  function computeStatusQuoScore(pillar, h){
    // conservative placeholder: mild trend by pillar type
    const t = Math.log(1+h)/Math.log(51);
    if(pillar.key==="housing" || pillar.key==="mobility"){
      // if observed, compute from observed burdens
      if(pillar.key==="housing" && proxy){
        const rb30 = proxy.rent_burden_30_plus;
        const rb50 = proxy.rent_burden_50_plus;
        if(rb30!=null && rb50!=null){
          return clamp(90 - rb30*80 - rb50*40, 10, 90);
        }
      }
      if(pillar.key==="mobility" && proxy){
        const cm30 = proxy.commute_over_30;
        const cm60 = proxy.commute_over_60;
        if(cm30!=null && cm60!=null){
          return clamp(92 - cm30*70 - cm60*55, 15, 92);
        }
      }
      return 45 + 10*t;
    }
    if(pillar.key==="health") return 40 + 8*t;
    if(pillar.key==="education") return 45 + 7*t;
    if(pillar.key==="democracy") return 35 + 6*t;
    if(pillar.key==="economy") return 42 + 9*t;
    if(pillar.key==="safety") return 38 + 8*t;
    if(pillar.key==="ai") return 44 + 6*t;
    return 45 + 8*t;
  }

  function computeWMRScore(pillar, h){
    const f = fractionFromAnchors(pillar.phase_curve.anchors, h);

    if(pillar.key==="housing"){
      let rb30 = proxy ? proxy.rent_burden_30_plus : null;
      let rb50 = proxy ? proxy.rent_burden_50_plus : null;
      // If we have observed burdens, reduce them with scenario rent reduction target
      if(rb30!=null && rb50!=null){
        const target = scenario.params.rent_burden_reduction_50y ?? 0.55;
        const reduced30 = rb30*(1 - target*f);
        const reduced50 = rb50*(1 - target*f*0.8);
        return clamp((90 - reduced30*80 - reduced50*40) + 10, 0, 100);
      }
      // fallback: generic improvement curve + homeownership access
      const base = 55 + 28*f;
      const ho = (pillar.scenario_params.homeownership_access_gain_50y?.default ?? 0.35) * 100 * f;
      return clamp(base + ho*0.15, 0, 100);
    }

    if(pillar.key==="mobility"){
      let cm30 = proxy ? proxy.commute_over_30 : null;
      let cm60 = proxy ? proxy.commute_over_60 : null;
      if(cm30!=null && cm60!=null){
        const target = scenario.params.commute_burden_reduction_50y ?? 0.45;
        const reduced30 = cm30*(1 - target*f);
        const reduced60 = cm60*(1 - target*f*0.85);
        return clamp((92 - reduced30*70 - reduced60*55) + 8, 0, 100);
      }
      const base = 58 + 30*f;
      const cov = (pillar.scenario_params.universal_transport_coverage_50y?.default ?? 0.45) * 100 * f;
      return clamp(base + cov*0.12, 0, 100);
    }

    if(pillar.key==="health"){
      const gain = scenario.params.health_access_gain_50y ?? 0.55;
      return clamp(55 + gain*100*f, 0, 100);
    }
    if(pillar.key==="education"){
      const gain = scenario.params.education_gain_50y ?? 0.48;
      return clamp(52 + gain*100*f, 0, 100);
    }
    if(pillar.key==="democracy"){
      const gain = scenario.params.democracy_trust_gain_50y ?? 0.35;
      return clamp(50 + gain*100*f, 0, 100);
    }
    if(pillar.key==="economy"){
      return clamp(55 + 30*f, 0, 100);
    }
    if(pillar.key==="safety"){
      return clamp(50 + 35*f, 0, 100);
    }
    if(pillar.key==="ai"){
      return clamp(48 + 38*f, 0, 100);
    }
    return clamp(55 + 30*f, 0, 100);
  }

  function render(){
    const pillar = getPillar(pillarSelect.value);
    scenarioLabel.innerHTML = `<b>${scenario.preset}</b> (stored)`;

    const rows = horizons.map(h=>{
      const sq = computeStatusQuoScore(pillar, h);
      const w = computeWMRScore(pillar, h);
      return {h, sq, w, delta: w - sq};
    });

    let html = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Horizon</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Status quo</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for(const r of rows){
      html += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${r.h}y</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.sq)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.w)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmt(r.delta)}</b></td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';
    tableEl.innerHTML = html;

    // Drivers
    let d = `<div class="note"><b>Pillar:</b> ${pillar.name}<br>`;
    d += `<b>Dimension links:</b> ${pillar.dimension_links.join(', ')}<br>`;
    d += `<b>Observed grounding:</b> ${(pillar.key==="housing"||pillar.key==="mobility") && proxy ? "Yes (ACS-derived proxies)" : "No (placeholder)" }<br>`;
    d += `<b>Phase curve:</b> anchors at 1/5/10/20/50 years</div>`;

    d += '<div class="callout"><b>Indicators</b><br>';
    for(const ind of pillar.indicators){
      const val = observedValue(ind.observed_from);
      d += `<b>${ind.label}</b>: ${val==null ? "<span class='muted'>n/a</span>" : fmt(val)} <span class="muted">(${ind.source})</span><br>`;
    }
    d += '</div>';

    d += '<div class="callout"><b>Transform</b><br><span class="muted">'+pillar.transforms.pillar_score.notes+'</span><br><code>'+pillar.transforms.pillar_score.formula+'</code></div>';

    // Scenario levers summary
    d += '<div class="callout"><b>Scenario levers</b><br>';
    const p = scenario.params;
    if(pillar.key==="housing"){
      d += `Rent burden reduction target (50y): <b>${pct(p.rent_burden_reduction_50y ?? 0.55)}</b><br>`;
      d += `Homeownership access gain (50y): <b>${pct(pillar.scenario_params.homeownership_access_gain_50y.default)}</b> <span class="muted">(pillar default)</span><br>`;
    } else if(pillar.key==="mobility"){
      d += `Commute reduction target (50y): <b>${pct(p.commute_burden_reduction_50y ?? 0.45)}</b><br>`;
      d += `Universal transport coverage (50y): <b>${pct(pillar.scenario_params.universal_transport_coverage_50y.default)}</b> <span class="muted">(pillar default)</span><br>`;
    } else if(pillar.key==="health"){
      d += `Health access gain (50y): <b>${pct(p.health_access_gain_50y ?? 0.55)}</b><br>`;
    } else if(pillar.key==="education"){
      d += `Education gain (50y): <b>${pct(p.education_gain_50y ?? 0.48)}</b><br>`;
    } else if(pillar.key==="democracy"){
      d += `Democracy trust gain (50y): <b>${pct(p.democracy_trust_gain_50y ?? 0.35)}</b><br>`;
    } else {
      d += `<span class="muted">This pillar uses internal placeholder parameters for now.</span>`;
    }
    d += '</div>';

    driversEl.innerHTML = d;
  }

  pillarSelect.addEventListener('change', render);
  render();
})();
</script>
"""

import os, zipfile, shutil, re, json, datetime, textwrap

with zipfile.ZipFile(src,"r") as z:
    z.extractall(work)

pages=os.path.join(work,"pages")
data=os.path.join(work,"data")

def read(p):
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8") as f: return f.read()
def write(p,c):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    with open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(c)

# Load template and thoughts block
template = read(os.path.join(pages,"vision.html"))
marker = '<div class="card">\n  <div class="kicker">Thoughts & comments (moderated)</div>'
start = template.find(marker)
end = template.find('</div>\n</main>', start)
thoughts_block = template[start:end]

def thoughts(slug,title):
    blk=thoughts_block
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_slug" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_slug" value="{slug}"', blk)
    blk=re.sub(r'name="page_title" value="[^"]*"', f'name="page_title" value="{title}"', blk)
    return blk

def card(k,h,html):
    return f"""
<div class="card">
  <div class="kicker">{k}</div>
  <h2>{h}</h2>
  {html}
</div>
"""

def make_page(filename,title,breadcrumb,slug,cards_html, extra_scripts=""):
    tpl=template
    tpl=re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', f'<title>{title} — Working Majority Republic</title>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<h1>.*?</h1>', f'<h1>{title}</h1>', tpl)
    tpl=re.sub(r'<div class="muted">.*?</div>', f'<div class="muted">{breadcrumb}</div>', tpl, count=1)
    main=f'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="{slug}">\n{cards_html}\n{thoughts(slug,title)}\n</main>'
    tpl=re.sub(r'<main class="wrap" data-page-slug="[^"]*">.*?</main>', main, tpl, flags=re.S)
    if extra_scripts:
        tpl = tpl.replace("</body>", extra_scripts + "\n</body>")
    write(os.path.join(pages,filename), tpl)

def link_block(href,title,desc):
    return f'<a href="{href}"><b>{title}</b><br><span class="muted">{desc}</span></a>'

# Add utility JS for snapshot exporting

// WMR Utilities v58 — local snapshots export
(function(){
  function download(filename, text){
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.setAttribute('href', 'data:application/json;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(text));
    a.setAttribute('download', filename);
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
  }

  window.WMR = window.WMR || {};
  window.WMR.exportSnapshot = function(kind, payload){
    const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replaceAll(':','-');
    const fname = `wmr_${kind}_snapshot_${stamp}.json`;
    download(fname, JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2));
    return fname;
  }
})();
"""
