             r'\1'+controls_html+r'\3', psc, flags=re.S)

psc_script = r"""
<script src="/assets/wmr_utils_v58.js"></script>
<script>
(async function(){
  const horizons = [1,5,10,20,50];

  const pillarEng = await (await fetch('/data/trajectories/pillar_engine_v57.json')).json();
  const trajEng = await (await fetch('/data/trajectories/trajectory_engine_v56.json')).json();

  // Load scenario (V56)
  let scenario = null;
  try{ scenario = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("wmr_scenario_v56")||"null"); }catch(e){}
  if(!scenario || !scenario.params){
    scenario = { preset:"moderate", params: trajEng.scenarios.moderate.params };
  }

  // Proxies (V54 export)
  let proxy = null;
  try{ proxy = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("wmr_qol_proxies_v54")||"null"); }catch(e){}

  // Pillar params storage (V58)
  const PARAM_KEY = "wmr_pillar_params_v58";
  function loadPillarParams(){
    try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PARAM_KEY) || "{}"); }catch(e){ return {}; }
  }
  function savePillarParams(obj){
    localStorage.setItem(PARAM_KEY, JSON.stringify(obj));
  }
  let pillarParamsAll = loadPillarParams();

  const pillarSelect = document.getElementById('pillarSelect');
  const scenarioLabel = document.getElementById('scenarioLabel');
  const tableEl = document.getElementById('pillarTable');
  const driversEl = document.getElementById('pillarDrivers');
  const paramsEl = document.getElementById('pillarParams');
  const exportBtn = document.getElementById('exportSnapshotBtn');
  const exportStatus = document.getElementById('exportStatus');

  function clamp(x,a,b){ return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x)); }
  function fmt(x){ return (Math.round(Number(x)*10)/10).toFixed(1); }
  function pct(x){ return (Number(x)*100).toFixed(0)+'%'; }

  function fractionFromAnchors(anchors, h){
    const a = anchors.slice().sort((x,y)=>x.h-y.h);
    if(h <= a[0].h) return a[0].f;
    if(h >= a[a.length-1].h) return a[a.length-1].f;
    for(let i=0;i<a.length-1;i++){
      const lo=a[i], hi=a[i+1];
      if(h>=lo.h && h<=hi.h){
        const t=(h-lo.h)/(hi.h-lo.h);
        return lo.f + t*(hi.f - lo.f);
      }
    }
    return 1.0;
  }

  function getPillar(key){
    return pillarEng.pillars.find(p=>p.key===key);
  }

  function observedValue(obsPath){
    if(!obsPath) return null;
    const parts = obsPath.split('.');
    const root = parts.shift();
    let obj = null;
    if(root === "wmr_qol_proxies_v54") obj = proxy;
    if(!obj) return null;
    for(const p of parts){
      if(obj && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj,p)){
        obj = obj[p];
      } else return null;
    }
    return obj;
  }

  // Default pillar params (can be overridden)
  function ensureDefaults(pillarKey){
    pillarParamsAll = loadPillarParams();
    if(!pillarParamsAll[pillarKey]) pillarParamsAll[pillarKey] = {};
    const p = pillarParamsAll[pillarKey];

    // Set defaults by pillar
    if(pillarKey==="housing"){
      if(p.homeownership_access_gain_50y==null) p.homeownership_access_gain_50y = 0.35;
      if(p.public_housing_floor_strength_50y==null) p.public_housing_floor_strength_50y = 0.30;
    } else if(pillarKey==="mobility"){
      if(p.universal_transport_coverage_50y==null) p.universal_transport_coverage_50y = 0.45;
      if(p.rural_urban_link_strength_50y==null) p.rural_urban_link_strength_50y = 0.40;
    } else if(pillarKey==="health"){
      if(p.medical_debt_retirement_strength_10y==null) p.medical_debt_retirement_strength_10y = 0.75;
      if(p.preventive_care_uptake_50y==null) p.preventive_care_uptake_50y = 0.55;
    } else if(pillarKey==="education"){
      if(p.free_education_scope_10y==null) p.free_education_scope_10y = 0.80;
      if(p.apprenticeship_scale_50y==null) p.apprenticeship_scale_50y = 0.55;
    } else if(pillarKey==="democracy"){
      if(p.transparency_enforcement_10y==null) p.transparency_enforcement_10y = 0.75;
      if(p.money_in_politics_reduction_50y==null) p.money_in_politics_reduction_50y = 0.55;
    } else if(pillarKey==="economy"){
      if(p.anti_monopoly_strength_50y==null) p.anti_monopoly_strength_50y = 0.55;
      if(p.worker_dividend_strength_50y==null) p.worker_dividend_strength_50y = 0.50;
    } else if(pillarKey==="safety"){
      if(p.incarceration_reduction_50y==null) p.incarceration_reduction_50y = 0.45;
      if(p.community_policing_quality_50y==null) p.community_policing_quality_50y = 0.55;
    } else if(pillarKey==="ai"){
      if(p.ai_regulation_quality_50y==null) p.ai_regulation_quality_50y = 0.60;
      if(p.shared_ai_gains_50y==null) p.shared_ai_gains_50y = 0.55;
      if(p.ai_job_transition_support_20y==null) p.ai_job_transition_support_20y = 0.60;
    }

    pillarParamsAll[pillarKey] = p;
    savePillarParams(pillarParamsAll);
    return p;
  }

  function sliderRow(id,label,min,max,step,value,help){
    return `
      <div style="margin:10px 0;">
        <label class="muted"><b>${label}</b></label><br>
        <input id="${id}" type="range" min="${min}" max="${max}" step="${step}" value="${value}" style="width:100%;">
        <div class="muted">${help}: <span id="${id}_val"></span></div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function renderPillarParams(pillarKey){
    const p = ensureDefaults(pillarKey);

    let html = '';
    if(pillarKey==="housing"){
      html += sliderRow("pp_homeown","Homeownership access gain (50y)",0.10,0.70,0.01,p.homeownership_access_gain_50y,"Target");
      html += sliderRow("pp_floor","Public housing floor strength (50y)",0.05,0.60,0.01,p.public_housing_floor_strength_50y,"Target");
    } else if(pillarKey==="mobility"){
      html += sliderRow("pp_cov","Universal transport coverage (50y)",0.10,0.75,0.01,p.universal_transport_coverage_50y,"Target");
      html += sliderRow("pp_link","Rural↔urban link strength (50y)",0.05,0.70,0.01,p.rural_urban_link_strength_50y,"Target");
    } else if(pillarKey==="health"){
      html += sliderRow("pp_meddebt","Medical debt retirement strength (10y)",0.10,1.00,0.01,p.medical_debt_retirement_strength_10y,"Target");
      html += sliderRow("pp_prev","Preventive care uptake (50y)",0.10,0.85,0.01,p.preventive_care_uptake_50y,"Target");
    } else if(pillarKey==="education"){
      html += sliderRow("pp_freeedu","Free education scope (10y)",0.20,1.00,0.01,p.free_education_scope_10y,"Target");
      html += sliderRow("pp_appr","Apprenticeship scale (50y)",0.10,0.85,0.01,p.apprenticeship_scale_50y,"Target");
    } else if(pillarKey==="democracy"){
      html += sliderRow("pp_trans","Transparency enforcement (10y)",0.20,1.00,0.01,p.transparency_enforcement_10y,"Target");
      html += sliderRow("pp_money","Money-in-politics reduction (50y)",0.10,0.80,0.01,p.money_in_politics_reduction_50y,"Target");
    } else if(pillarKey==="economy"){
      html += sliderRow("pp_antimono","Anti-monopoly strength (50y)",0.10,0.85,0.01,p.anti_monopoly_strength_50y,"Target");
      html += sliderRow("pp_div","Worker dividend strength (50y)",0.10,0.80,0.01,p.worker_dividend_strength_50y,"Target");
    } else if(pillarKey==="safety"){
      html += sliderRow("pp_incarc","Incarceration reduction (50y)",0.10,0.80,0.01,p.incarceration_reduction_50y,"Target");
      html += sliderRow("pp_comm","Community policing quality (50y)",0.10,0.85,0.01,p.community_policing_quality_50y,"Target");
    } else if(pillarKey==="ai"){
      html += sliderRow("pp_airule","AI governance quality (50y)",0.10,0.90,0.01,p.ai_regulation_quality_50y,"Target");
      html += sliderRow("pp_share","Shared AI gains (50y)",0.10,0.90,0.01,p.shared_ai_gains_50y,"Target");
      html += sliderRow("pp_trans20","Job transition support (20y)",0.10,0.95,0.01,p.ai_job_transition_support_20y,"Target");
    }
    paramsEl.innerHTML = html;

    // wire values
    function setVal(id){
      const el=document.getElementById(id);
      const out=document.getElementById(id+"_val");
      if(!el || !out) return;
      out.textContent = pct(el.value);
    }
    Array.from(paramsEl.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]')).forEach(inp=>{
      setVal(inp.id);
      inp.addEventListener('input', ()=>{
        setVal(inp.id);
        // Save to storage mapped by pillar
        const cur = ensureDefaults(pillarKey);
        const id=inp.id;
        const v=Number(inp.value);
        if(pillarKey==="housing"){
          if(id==="pp_homeown") cur.homeownership_access_gain_50y=v;
          if(id==="pp_floor") cur.public_housing_floor_strength_50y=v;
        } else if(pillarKey==="mobility"){
          if(id==="pp_cov") cur.universal_transport_coverage_50y=v;
          if(id==="pp_link") cur.rural_urban_link_strength_50y=v;
        } else if(pillarKey==="health"){
          if(id==="pp_meddebt") cur.medical_debt_retirement_strength_10y=v;
          if(id==="pp_prev") cur.preventive_care_uptake_50y=v;
        } else if(pillarKey==="education"){
          if(id==="pp_freeedu") cur.free_education_scope_10y=v;
          if(id==="pp_appr") cur.apprenticeship_scale_50y=v;
        } else if(pillarKey==="democracy"){
          if(id==="pp_trans") cur.transparency_enforcement_10y=v;
          if(id==="pp_money") cur.money_in_politics_reduction_50y=v;
        } else if(pillarKey==="economy"){
          if(id==="pp_antimono") cur.anti_monopoly_strength_50y=v;
          if(id==="pp_div") cur.worker_dividend_strength_50y=v;
        } else if(pillarKey==="safety"){
          if(id==="pp_incarc") cur.incarceration_reduction_50y=v;
          if(id==="pp_comm") cur.community_policing_quality_50y=v;
        } else if(pillarKey==="ai"){
          if(id==="pp_airule") cur.ai_regulation_quality_50y=v;
          if(id==="pp_share") cur.shared_ai_gains_50y=v;
          if(id==="pp_trans20") cur.ai_job_transition_support_20y=v;
        }
        pillarParamsAll[pillarKey]=cur;
        savePillarParams(pillarParamsAll);
        render(); // live recompute
      });
    });
  }

  function computeStatusQuoScore(pillar, h){
    const t = Math.log(1+h)/Math.log(51);
    if(pillar.key==="housing" || pillar.key==="mobility"){
      if(pillar.key==="housing" && proxy){
        const rb30 = proxy.rent_burden_30_plus;
        const rb50 = proxy.rent_burden_50_plus;
        if(rb30!=null && rb50!=null){
          return clamp(90 - rb30*80 - rb50*40, 10, 90);
        }
      }
      if(pillar.key==="mobility" && proxy){
        const cm30 = proxy.commute_over_30;
        const cm60 = proxy.commute_over_60;
        if(cm30!=null && cm60!=null){
          return clamp(92 - cm30*70 - cm60*55, 15, 92);
        }
      }
      return 45 + 10*t;
    }
    if(pillar.key==="health") return 40 + 8*t;
    if(pillar.key==="education") return 45 + 7*t;
    if(pillar.key==="democracy") return 35 + 6*t;
    if(pillar.key==="economy") return 42 + 9*t;
    if(pillar.key==="safety") return 38 + 8*t;
    if(pillar.key==="ai") return 44 + 6*t;
    return 45 + 8*t;
  }

  function computeWMRScore(pillar, h, pparams){
    const f = fractionFromAnchors(pillar.phase_curve.anchors, h);

    if(pillar.key==="housing"){
      const homeown = pparams.homeownership_access_gain_50y ?? 0.35;
      const floor = pparams.public_housing_floor_strength_50y ?? 0.30;

      let rb30 = proxy ? proxy.rent_burden_30_plus : null;
      let rb50 = proxy ? proxy.rent_burden_50_plus : null;
      if(rb30!=null && rb50!=null){
        const target = scenario.params.rent_burden_reduction_50y ?? 0.55;
        const reduced30 = rb30*(1 - target*f);
        const reduced50 = rb50*(1 - target*f*0.8);
        return clamp((90 - reduced30*80 - reduced50*40) + 10 + (homeown*8*f) + (floor*6*f), 0, 100);
      }
      const base = 55 + 28*f;
      return clamp(base + homeown*25*f + floor*18*f, 0, 100);
    }

    if(pillar.key==="mobility"){
      const cov = pparams.universal_transport_coverage_50y ?? 0.45;
      const link = pparams.rural_urban_link_strength_50y ?? 0.40;

      let cm30 = proxy ? proxy.commute_over_30 : null;
      let cm60 = proxy ? proxy.commute_over_60 : null;
      if(cm30!=null && cm60!=null){
        const target = scenario.params.commute_burden_reduction_50y ?? 0.45;
        const reduced30 = cm30*(1 - target*f);
        const reduced60 = cm60*(1 - target*f*0.85);
        return clamp((92 - reduced30*70 - reduced60*55) + 8 + cov*7*f + link*6*f, 0, 100);
      }
      const base = 58 + 30*f;
      return clamp(base + cov*20*f + link*18*f, 0, 100);
    }

    if(pillar.key==="health"){
      const gain = scenario.params.health_access_gain_50y ?? 0.55;
      const meddebt10 = pparams.medical_debt_retirement_strength_10y ?? 0.75;
      const prev = pparams.preventive_care_uptake_50y ?? 0.55;
      // extra early bump from debt retirement (10y target) scaled by min(f, h/10)
      const early = Math.min(1, h/10) * meddebt10 * 12;
      return clamp(55 + gain*100*f + prev*10*f + early, 0, 100);
    }

    if(pillar.key==="education"){
      const gain = scenario.params.education_gain_50y ?? 0.48;
      const free10 = pparams.free_education_scope_10y ?? 0.80;
      const appr = pparams.apprenticeship_scale_50y ?? 0.55;
      const early = Math.min(1, h/10) * free10 * 10;
      return clamp(52 + gain*100*f + appr*12*f + early, 0, 100);
    }

    if(pillar.key==="democracy"){
      const gain = scenario.params.democracy_trust_gain_50y ?? 0.35;
      const trans10 = pparams.transparency_enforcement_10y ?? 0.75;
      const money = pparams.money_in_politics_reduction_50y ?? 0.55;
      const early = Math.min(1, h/10) * trans10 * 12;
      return clamp(50 + gain*100*f + money*10*f + early, 0, 100);
    }

    if(pillar.key==="economy"){
      const anti = pparams.anti_monopoly_strength_50y ?? 0.55;
      const div = pparams.worker_dividend_strength_50y ?? 0.50;
      return clamp(55 + 30*f + anti*12*f + div*14*f, 0, 100);
    }

    if(pillar.key==="safety"){
      const inc = pparams.incarceration_reduction_50y ?? 0.45;
      const comm = pparams.community_policing_quality_50y ?? 0.55;
      return clamp(50 + 35*f + inc*10*f + comm*10*f, 0, 100);
    }

    if(pillar.key==="ai"){
      const rule = pparams.ai_regulation_quality_50y ?? 0.60;
      const share = pparams.shared_ai_gains_50y ?? 0.55;
      const trans20 = pparams.ai_job_transition_support_20y ?? 0.60;
      const mid = Math.min(1, h/20) * trans20 * 14;
      return clamp(48 + 38*f + rule*12*f + share*12*f + mid, 0, 100);
    }

    return clamp(55 + 30*f, 0, 100);
  }

  function render(){
    const pillar = getPillar(pillarSelect.value);
    const pparams = ensureDefaults(pillar.key);
    renderPillarParams(pillar.key);

    scenarioLabel.innerHTML = `<b>${scenario.preset}</b> (stored)`;

    const rows = horizons.map(h=>{
      const sq = computeStatusQuoScore(pillar, h);
      const w = computeWMRScore(pillar, h, pparams);
      return {h, sq, w, delta: w - sq};
    });

    let html = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
      + '<thead><tr>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Horizon</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Status quo</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR</th>'
      + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ</th>'
      + '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for(const r of rows){
      html += '<tr>'
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${r.h}y</b></td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.sq)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.w)}</td>`
        + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmt(r.delta)}</b></td>`
        + '</tr>';
    }
    html += '</tbody></table>';
    tableEl.innerHTML = html;

    // Drivers
    let d = `<div class="note"><b>Pillar:</b> ${pillar.name}<br>`;
    d += `<b>Dimension links:</b> ${pillar.dimension_links.join(', ')}<br>`;
    d += `<b>Observed grounding:</b> ${(pillar.key==="housing"||pillar.key==="mobility") && proxy ? "Yes (ACS-derived proxies)" : "No (placeholder)" }<br>`;
    d += `<b>Phase curve:</b> anchors at 1/5/10/20/50 years</div>`;

    d += '<div class="callout"><b>Indicators</b><br>';
    for(const ind of pillar.indicators){
      const val = observedValue(ind.observed_from);
      d += `<b>${ind.label}</b>: ${val==null ? "<span class='muted'>n/a</span>" : fmt(val)} <span class="muted">(${ind.source})</span><br>`;
    }
    d += '</div>';

    d += '<div class="callout"><b>Scenario + pillar levers used</b><br>';
    if(pillar.key==="housing"){
      d += `Scenario rent reduction (50y): <b>${pct(scenario.params.rent_burden_reduction_50y ?? 0.55)}</b><br>`;
      d += `Pillar homeownership access (50y): <b>${pct(pparams.homeownership_access_gain_50y)}</b><br>`;
      d += `Pillar public housing floor (50y): <b>${pct(pparams.public_housing_floor_strength_50y)}</b><br>`;
    } else if(pillar.key==="mobility"){
      d += `Scenario commute reduction (50y): <b>${pct(scenario.params.commute_burden_reduction_50y ?? 0.45)}</b><br>`;
      d += `Pillar transport coverage (50y): <b>${pct(pparams.universal_transport_coverage_50y)}</b><br>`;
      d += `Pillar rural↔urban link (50y): <b>${pct(pparams.rural_urban_link_strength_50y)}</b><br>`;
    } else if(pillar.key==="health"){
      d += `Scenario health access gain (50y): <b>${pct(scenario.params.health_access_gain_50y ?? 0.55)}</b><br>`;
      d += `Pillar medical debt retirement (10y): <b>${pct(pparams.medical_debt_retirement_strength_10y)}</b><br>`;
      d += `Pillar preventive uptake (50y): <b>${pct(pparams.preventive_care_uptake_50y)}</b><br>`;
    } else if(pillar.key==="education"){
      d += `Scenario education gain (50y): <b>${pct(scenario.params.education_gain_50y ?? 0.48)}</b><br>`;
      d += `Pillar free education scope (10y): <b>${pct(pparams.free_education_scope_10y)}</b><br>`;
      d += `Pillar apprenticeship scale (50y): <b>${pct(pparams.apprenticeship_scale_50y)}</b><br>`;
    } else if(pillar.key==="democracy"){
      d += `Scenario trust gain (50y): <b>${pct(scenario.params.democracy_trust_gain_50y ?? 0.35)}</b><br>`;
      d += `Pillar transparency enforcement (10y): <b>${pct(pparams.transparency_enforcement_10y)}</b><br>`;
      d += `Pillar money reduction (50y): <b>${pct(pparams.money_in_politics_reduction_50y)}</b><br>`;
    } else if(pillar.key==="economy"){
      d += `Pillar anti-monopoly (50y): <b>${pct(pparams.anti_monopoly_strength_50y)}</b><br>`;
      d += `Pillar worker dividend (50y): <b>${pct(pparams.worker_dividend_strength_50y)}</b><br>`;
    } else if(pillar.key==="safety"){
      d += `Pillar incarceration reduction (50y): <b>${pct(pparams.incarceration_reduction_50y)}</b><br>`;
      d += `Pillar community policing quality (50y): <b>${pct(pparams.community_policing_quality_50y)}</b><br>`;
    } else if(pillar.key==="ai"){
      d += `Pillar AI governance (50y): <b>${pct(pparams.ai_regulation_quality_50y)}</b><br>`;
      d += `Pillar shared AI gains (50y): <b>${pct(pparams.shared_ai_gains_50y)}</b><br>`;
      d += `Pillar job transition support (20y): <b>${pct(pparams.ai_job_transition_support_20y)}</b><br>`;
    }
    d += '</div>';

    driversEl.innerHTML = d;

    // Return computed for export
    return {pillar, params: pparams, rows};
  }

  // Export snapshot
  exportBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const computed = render();
    const payload = {
      kind:"pillar_scorecards",
      version:"v58",
      exported_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
      geo: proxy ? { geoKey: proxy.geoKey, preset: proxy.preset } : null,
      observed_proxies: proxy || null,
      scenario: scenario,
      pillar_key: pillarSelect.value,
      pillar_params: computed.params,
      outputs: computed.rows
    };
    const fname = window.WMR.exportSnapshot("pillar_scorecards_v58", payload);
    exportStatus.textContent = "Exported: " + fname;
  });

  pillarSelect.addEventListener('change', ()=>{ render(); });
  render();

})();
</script>
"""
psc = psc.replace("</body>", psc_script + "\n</body>")
write(psc_path, psc)

# Add snapshot export capability to QoL Timeline page too
qol_path=os.path.join(pages,"qol-timeline.html")
qol=read(qol_path)
# Insert an Export card if not present
if "Export snapshot JSON" not in qol:
    # Add card after Timeline card block content
    export_card = card("Export","Save an auditable snapshot",
"""
<button id="exportQolBtn" style="padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer; background:white;">
  Export snapshot JSON
</button>
<div id="exportQolStatus" class="muted" style="margin-top:6px;"></div>
<p class="muted" style="margin-top:6px;">Exports: geo/proxies, scenario, dimension scores, composite values, timestamp.</p>
""")
    # Insert before Assumptions card in body
    qol = re.sub(r'(<div class="card">\s*\n\s*<div class="kicker">Assumptions</div>)', export_card + r'\1', qol, count=1)

# Replace QoL script with export-enabled version (keep the v56 engine logic)
qol = re.sub(r'<script[\s\S]*?</script>\s*</body>', '</body>', qol, flags=re.S)

qol_script = r"""
<script src="/assets/wmr_utils_v58.js"></script>
<script>
(async function(){
  const horizons = [1,5,10,20,50];
  const eng = await (await fetch('/data/trajectories/trajectory_engine_v56.json')).json();
  const dims = eng.qol_index.dimensions;

  // proxies
  let proxy = null;
  try{ proxy = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("wmr_qol_proxies_v54")||"null"); }catch(e){}

  // scenario
  let scenario = null;
  try{ scenario = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("wmr_scenario_v56")||"null"); }catch(e){}
  if(!scenario || !scenario.params){
    scenario = { preset:"moderate", params: eng.scenarios.moderate.params };
  }

  function clamp(x,a,b){ return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, x)); }
  function fmt(x){ return (Math.round(Number(x)*10)/10).toFixed(1); }
  function pct(x){ return (Number(x)*100).toFixed(0)+'%'; }

  function fractionFromAnchors(anchors, h){
    const a = anchors.slice().sort((x,y)=>x.h-y.h);
    if(h <= a[0].h) return a[0].fraction_of_50y;
    if(h >= a[a.length-1].h) return a[a.length-1].fraction_of_50y;
    for(let i=0;i<a.length-1;i++){
      const lo=a[i], hi=a[i+1];
      if(h>=lo.h && h<=hi.h){
        const t=(h-lo.h)/(hi.h-lo.h);
        return lo.fraction_of_50y + t*(hi.fraction_of_50y - lo.fraction_of_50y);
      }
    }
    return 1.0;
  }

  function rentScore(rb){
    if(rb==null) return null;
    return clamp(85 - rb*75, 15, 85);
  }
  function commuteScore(cm){
    if(cm==null) return null;
    return clamp(85 - cm*65, 20, 85);
  }

  function sqScores(h){
    const t = Math.log(1+h)/Math.log(51);
    let housing = 45 + 10*t;
    let mobility = 45 + 10*t;
    if(proxy){
      const hs = rentScore(proxy.rent_burden_30_plus);
      if(hs!=null) housing = hs;
      const ms = commuteScore(proxy.commute_over_30);
      if(ms!=null) mobility = ms;
    }
    return {
      economic_burden: 40 + 8*t,
      housing_security: housing,
      mobility_time: mobility,
      health_access: 38 + 6*t,
      education_opportunity: 45 + 6*t,
      democracy_trust: 35 + 5*t
    };
  }

  function wmrScores(h){
    const t = Math.log(1+h)/Math.log(51);
    let housing = 60 + 22*t;
    let mobility = 62 + 18*t;

    if(proxy){
      const rb = proxy.rent_burden_30_plus;
      if(rb!=null){
        const target = scenario.params.rent_burden_reduction_50y;
        const frac = fractionFromAnchors(eng.qol_index.phase_curves.rent_reduction_curve.anchors, h);
        const reduced = rb * (1 - target*frac);
        const hs = rentScore(reduced);
        if(hs!=null) housing = clamp(hs + 12, 0, 100);
      }
      const cm = proxy.commute_over_30;
      if(cm!=null){
        const target = scenario.params.commute_burden_reduction_50y;
        const frac = fractionFromAnchors(eng.qol_index.phase_curves.commute_reduction_curve.anchors, h);
        const reduced = cm * (1 - target*frac);
        const ms = commuteScore(reduced);
        if(ms!=null) mobility = clamp(ms + 10, 0, 100);
      }
    }

    const gfrac = fractionFromAnchors(eng.qol_index.phase_curves.gain_curve_generic.anchors, h);
    const health = clamp(55 + scenario.params.health_access_gain_50y*100*gfrac, 0, 100);
    const edu = clamp(52 + scenario.params.education_gain_50y*100*gfrac, 0, 100);
    const demo = clamp(50 + scenario.params.democracy_trust_gain_50y*100*gfrac, 0, 100);

    return {
      economic_burden: 58 + 25*t,
      housing_security: housing,
      mobility_time: mobility,
      health_access: health,
      education_opportunity: edu,
      democracy_trust: demo
    };
  }

  function composite(scores){
    let s=0;
    for(const d of dims){
      s += (scores[d.key]||0) * d.weight;
    }
    return s;
  }

  const rows = horizons.map(h=>{
    const sq = sqScores(h);
    const w = wmrScores(h);
    return {h, sq_total: composite(sq), w_total: composite(w), sq, w};
  });

  // Render table
  let html = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">'
    + '<thead><tr>'
    + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Horizon</th>'
    + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Status quo QoL</th>'
    + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">WMR QoL</th>'
    + '<th style="text-align:left; padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;">Δ</th>'
    + '</tr></thead><tbody>';
  for(const r of rows){
    const delta = r.w_total - r.sq_total;
    html += '<tr>'
      + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${r.h}y</b></td>`
      + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.sq_total)}</td>`
      + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${fmt(r.w_total)}</td>`
      + `<td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>${fmt(delta)}</b></td>`
      + '</tr>';
  }
  html += '</tbody></table>';
  document.getElementById('qolTable').innerHTML = html;

  // Drivers breakdown at 10y and 50y
  function driverBlock(label, r){
    let b = `<div class="callout"><b>${label}</b><br><span class="muted">Dimension scores (0–100)</span><br>`;
    for(const d of dims){
      b += `<b>${d.name}</b>: SQ ${fmt(r.sq[d.key])} → WMR ${fmt(r.w[d.key])}<br>`;
    }
    b += '</div>';
    return b;
  }
  const r10 = rows.find(x=>x.h===10);
  const r50 = rows.find(x=>x.h===50);

  const proxTxt = proxy ? `Using observed proxies for geo: <b>${proxy.geoKey}</b> (preset ${proxy.preset})` : 'No observed proxies found yet (run Household Impact in observed mode to export).';
  const scenTxt = `Scenario: <b>${scenario.preset}</b> — rent ${pct(scenario.params.rent_burden_reduction_50y)}, commute ${pct(scenario.params.commute_burden_reduction_50y)}. <a href="/pages/scenario-panel.html"><b>Adjust</b></a>`;
  document.getElementById('qolDrivers').innerHTML =
    `<div class="note"><b>Data context:</b> ${proxTxt}<br><b>Scenario:</b> ${scenTxt}</div>`
    + driverBlock("Drivers at 10 years", r10)
    + driverBlock("Drivers at 50 years", r50);

  // Export snapshot
  const btn = document.getElementById('exportQolBtn');
  const status = document.getElementById('exportQolStatus');
  if(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const payload = {
        kind:"qol_timeline",
        version:"v58",
        exported_utc: new Date().toISOString(),
        geo: proxy ? { geoKey: proxy.geoKey, preset: proxy.preset } : null,
        observed_proxies: proxy || null,
        scenario: scenario,
        dimensions: dims,
        outputs: rows
      };
      const fname = window.WMR.exportSnapshot("qol_timeline_v58", payload);
